title: QA Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
We are looking for a technically strong and detail-oriented QA Engineer to take ownership of product quality for Bondsmart, our digital debt investment platform.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for ensuring the reliability, accuracy, security, and performance of our web applications, backend APIs, database operations, and third-party integrations.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have strong manual testing fundamentals, hands-on API testing and SQL skills, and practical exposure to test automation. They should be capable of independently identifying defects, analysing complex business workflows, and working closely with developers and product stakeholders to prevent issues from reaching production.
  
  
As a startup operating in the debt investment segment, we are looking for someone who takes ownership, thinks beyond predefined test cases, adapts quickly to changing requirements, and helps establish scalable QA processes as the platform grows.
  
  
**Skills And Knowledge**
**Functional & End-to-End Testing**

* Test end-to-end investor journeys, including registration, login, OTP verification, KYC, bank verification, and profile management.
* Test investment workflows, including bond discovery, investment calculations, order placement, payment processing, order status updates, and transaction history.
* Prepare and execute test plans, test scenarios, test cases, and regression suites based on business requirements.
* Perform functional, integration, regression, smoke, exploratory, and user acceptance testing.
* Identify edge cases, missing validations, inconsistent behaviour, and potential production risks.
* Verify business rules, field validations, error messages, boundary conditions, and application behaviour across different scenarios.
* Ensure that new features and bug fixes do not negatively impact existing functionality.

**API & Backend Testing**

* Independently test RESTful APIs using Postman or equivalent tools.
* Validate API request and response payloads, HTTP status codes, authentication, authorization, and error handling.
* Perform positive, negative, boundary, and invalid-input testing.
* Validate integration behaviour across backend services and third-party providers.
* Test webhook processing, API timeouts, retries, duplicate requests, delayed responses, and failure scenarios.
* Analyse API responses and application logs to identify the root cause of defects.
* Collaborate with developers to reproduce issues, validate fixes, and improve backend reliability.

**Database Testing & Data Integrity**

* Write SQL queries to validate application data and business transactions.
* Verify data consistency across users, KYC records, investment orders, payments, holdings, and related database entities.
* Identify duplicate records, missing data, incorrect status updates, and inconsistent relationships.
* Validate database constraints, transaction records, and data integrity across interconnected workflows.
* Independently verify backend behaviour using database queries rather than relying solely on the user interface.
* Support investigation of production issues by analysing relevant records and identifying data discrepancies.

**Fintech & Financial Workflow Testing**

* Test payment gateway integrations, payment success and failure scenarios, cancellations, delayed payments, and reconciliation workflows.
* Validate investment amounts, bond units, price calculations, applicable charges, rounding, and accrued interest wherever applicable.
* Verify order lifecycle transitions and ensure that invalid or duplicate status changes do not occur.
* Test scenarios involving payment expiry, delayed webhooks, repeated callbacks, concurrent requests, and duplicate order submissions.
* Ensure transaction records remain consistent across application services and payment providers.
* Test integrations with KYC providers, banking services, exchanges, and other external financial service providers.
* Develop an understanding of fixed-income products, including corporate bonds, NCDs, government securities, and secondary-market transactions.

**Test Automation & Quality Engineering**

* Develop and maintain automated test cases for critical application workflows.
* Build automated API test suites and UI regression tests using suitable frameworks.
* Use Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, Postman/Newman, or equivalent tools to reduce repetitive manual testing.
* Identify suitable candidates for automation based on business criticality, frequency, and regression risk.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines in collaboration with the engineering team.
* Maintain reusable test scripts, test data, and automation documentation.
* Continuously improve test coverage, execution efficiency, and defect detection.

**Security, Performance & Production Testing**

* Perform basic security testing covering authentication, authorization, session management, input validation, and access-control vulnerabilities.
* Understand common web application security risks, including OWASP Top 10.
* Perform basic performance and load testing using tools such as JMeter or k6, where required.
* Test application behaviour under high traffic, concurrent requests, timeouts, and service failures.
* Assist in investigating production issues using logs, monitoring tools, and browser developer tools.
* Work with developers to improve application reliability, data protection, and overall user experience.

**Defect Management & Release Quality**

* Identify, document, prioritise, and track defects using Jira or equivalent tools.
* Provide clear reproduction steps, expected and actual results, severity, business impact, screenshots, and supporting API or database evidence.
* Perform retesting and regression testing after defect resolution.
* Participate in release planning, pre-release validation, smoke testing, and production verification.
* Define release acceptance criteria and communicate quality risks to relevant stakeholders.
* Investigate recurring defects and recommend preventive measures.
* Maintain QA documentation, test reports, and release sign-off records.

**Product & Business Collaboration**

* Work closely with developers, product managers, business teams, and operations to understand requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Identify ambiguities, missing business rules, and potential edge cases before development is completed.
* Provide early feedback on requirements and proposed solutions from a quality and risk perspective.
* Participate in sprint planning, requirement discussions, and release retrospectives.
* Take ownership of QA activities from requirement analysis through final release verification.
* Help establish practical testing standards and processes suitable for a growing startup.

Skills & Competencies
  
  
**Technical Skills**

* Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, SDLC, and STLC.
* Hands-on experience in manual testing, functional testing, regression testing, integration testing, and exploratory testing.
* Strong experience in API testing using Postman or equivalent tools.
* Good understanding of REST APIs, JSON, HTTP methods, status codes, headers, authentication, and authorization.
* Ability to write SQL queries involving SELECT, JOIN, WHERE, GROUP BY, subqueries, and data validation.
* Working knowledge of relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL.
* Practical experience with at least one UI automation framework, preferably Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium.
* Familiarity with API automation and test framework development.
* Understanding of web application architecture, client-server communication, and browser developer tools.
* Familiarity with Git, Jira, bug tracking, and test management practices.
* Basic understanding of CI/CD pipelines and automated regression testing.
* Good debugging, analytical, and root-cause investigation skills.
* Knowledge of performance testing tools such as JMeter or k6 is an advantage.
* Understanding of application security and OWASP Top 10 is an advantage.
* Familiarity with AWS-hosted applications, logs, and monitoring tools is an advantage.

**Fintech & Domain Skills**

* Understanding of payment gateway integrations, transaction processing, and webhook-based systems.
* Ability to test financial calculations, order processing, payment statuses, and transaction consistency.
* Understanding of idempotency, duplicate requests, concurrency issues, retries, and asynchronous processing.
* Familiarity with banking, stockbroking, investment platforms, payment systems, or financial services is preferred.
* Knowledge of debt instruments, bonds, NCDs, fixed-income products, or capital markets is an advantage.
* Ability to understand complex business workflows and translate them into comprehensive test scenarios.

**Behavioural & Professional Competencies**

* Strong ownership and accountability for product quality.
* Excellent analytical thinking and attention to detail.
* Ability to identify edge cases and anticipate failures beyond predefined test scenarios.
* Proactive approach to defect identification and risk prevention.
* Ability to work independently in a fast-paced startup environment.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to prioritise testing based on business impact and risk.
* Willingness to learn financial products, new technologies, and evolving business requirements.
* Focus on continuous improvement, process efficiency, and test automation.
* Key Expectations from the Role
* Own Product Quality – Take responsibility for the quality of Bondsmart’s applications, APIs, integrations, and critical business workflows.
* Ensure Financial Accuracy – Help prevent incorrect investment calculations, duplicate orders, inconsistent payment statuses, and transaction data discrepancies.
* Build Reliable QA Processes – Establish structured test cases, regression suites, release checklists, and practical quality standards.
* Strengthen API & Database Testing – Independently validate backend behaviour and database records to identify issues beyond the user interface.
* Drive Test Automation – Automate repetitive and business-critical test scenarios to improve regression coverage and release confidence.
* Identify Risks Early – Proactively identify missing requirements, edge cases, integration failures, and potential production issues.
* Support Safe Releases – Ensure critical workflows are adequately tested before deployment and communicate unresolved risks clearly.
* Collaborate with Engineering – Work closely with developers and product stakeholders to investigate root causes and prevent recurring defects.
* Adapt to a Startup Environment – Take initiative, work with evolving requirements, and help build QA practices that can scale with the business.

Experience Background
  
  

* Manual testing of web applications and end-to-end business workflows.
* Functional, regression, integration, exploratory, and UAT testing.
* API testing using Postman or equivalent tools.
* Backend testing and database validation using SQL.
* Test case design, test planning, defect tracking, and test documentation.
* Automation testing using Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or equivalent frameworks.
* Testing RESTful APIs, third-party integrations, and asynchronous workflows.
* Testing payment gateways, transaction processing, and webhook-based integrations.
* Experience with Agile development methodologies and cross-functional teams.
* Experience in fintech, banking, stockbroking, payments, investment platforms, or financial services is preferred.

title: Software Test Engineer (dSPACE OR Vector Toolchain)
description:

* Ability to analyse test results, identify system-level issues, and support problem diagnosis through a structured engineering approach.
* Strong technical communication and documentation skills, with the ability to clearly present findings and verification results.
* Ability to manage assigned testing activities, prioritize deliverables, and meet project timelines with minimal supervision.
* Demonstrates effective verbal and written communication while working seamlessly across multidisciplinary and cross-functional teams.
* Effectively managing stakeholder expectations, prioritizes work, and balances multiple tasks to meet project timelines and objectives.
* Exhibits learning agility, embraces new technologies and methodologies, and adapts quickly to evolving project needs and environments.
* Maintains a strong commitment to quality, process compliance, continuous improvement, engineering excellence, and alignment with customer and business objectives.

title: CSV & Software Validation Lead / Specialist
description:
**Designation: CSV & Software Validation Lead / Specialist**

**Preferred Experience: 3+ Years**

**Job Summary**

Aventior is seeking a CSV & Software Validation Specialist with experience in the biopharmaceutical, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or life sciences industry. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of regulatory compliance, quality management, computerized system validation (CSV), and software testing within regulated environments.

The role involves ensuring that software applications and computerized systems meet applicable regulatory requirements, quality standards, and business specifications. The candidate will be responsible for developing and executing test cases, validating system functionality, documenting test results, managing defects, and supporting compliance activities in accordance with GxP, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, GAMP 5, and other relevant regulatory frameworks.

The candidate will collaborate with Quality Assurance, Software Development, Clinical Operations, IT, and Regulatory Affairs teams to ensure software quality, data integrity, and regulatory compliance throughout the software development and validation lifecycle.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Regulatory Compliance & Quality Assurance**

* Ensure adherence to applicable GxP requirements, including GMP, GCP, and GLP, based on project and system requirements.
* Support compliance with FDA 21 CFR Part 11, EU and UK regulations for electronic records, electronic signatures, audit trails, and access controls.
* Apply GAMP 5 principles and risk-based approaches to computerized system validation and software testing.
* Review and maintain SOPs, work instructions, validation documents, and quality records.
* Support compliance assessments, internal and external audits, client audits, and regulatory inspection readiness.
* Assist with deviation management, CAPA, change control, risk assessments, and compliance remediation activities.
* Support data integrity, security, traceability, and documentation requirements for regulated systems.

**2. Software Testing & Quality Engineering**

* Review business requirements, functional specifications, and technical documentation to identify test scenarios and acceptance criteria.
* Prepare and execute test plans, test cases, test scripts, and test scenarios for software applications used in biopharma and life sciences.
* Perform functional, integration, regression, system, and user acceptance testing (UAT), as applicable.
* Validate application workflows, data processing, user permissions, audit trails, electronic signatures, and system interfaces.
* Identify, document, track, and retest software defects in collaboration with development and QA teams.
* Maintain requirements traceability matrices (RTMs) to establish traceability between requirements, risks, test cases, and test results.
* Ensure testing activities are documented, reproducible, and aligned with approved procedures and validation protocols.
* Support test execution, defect triage, root-cause analysis, and resolution verification.
* Participate in release testing, regression testing, and post-implementation verification.

**3. Computerized System Validation (CSV)**

* Support validation activities for GxP-regulated software applications and computerized systems.
* Prepare and maintain validation lifecycle documentation, including User Requirements Specifications (URS), risk assessments, validation plans, and test protocols.
* Execute or support Installation Qualification (IQ), Operational Qualification (OQ), and Performance Qualification (PQ), where applicable.
* Assist with validation of new systems, system upgrades, configuration changes, integrations, and software releases.
* Ensure validation evidence is complete, accurate, approved, and audit-ready.
* Support periodic reviews, change impact assessments, and revalidation activities based on risk and regulatory requirements.
* Apply risk-based validation principles in accordance with GAMP 5 and organizational quality procedures.

**4. Biopharma & Life Sciences Application Testing**

* Test and validate applications supporting clinical trials, clinical data management, pharmaceutical quality processes, laboratory operations, and regulatory workflows.
* Understand regulated-system requirements relating to patient data, clinical trial records, laboratory data, and electronic documentation.
* Verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, access controls, audit trails, and system-generated records.
* Support testing of integrations between clinical, laboratory, quality management, and other enterprise applications.
* Help ensure that software changes do not compromise patient safety, product quality, data integrity, or regulatory compliance.
* Support HIPAA-related privacy and security requirements when applications handle protected health information (PHI).

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, Computer Science, Information Technology, Quality Management, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in compliance, software testing, quality assurance, or computerized system validation within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, clinical research, or life sciences environments.
* Strong understanding of GxP regulations, including GMP, GCP, and GLP.
* Working knowledge of FDA 21 CFR Part 11, GAMP 5, EU and UK regulations, and electronic records and electronic signature requirements.
* Hands-on experience in manual software testing, test case preparation, test execution, defect tracking, and regression testing.
* Hands on experience with QMS platforms like ServiceNow, Veeva, Master Control a huge plus.
* Experience preparing or executing validation protocols and maintaining validation documentation, including URS, IQ, OQ, PQ, and RTMs, as applicable.
* Knowledge of SDLC, STLC, requirements traceability, risk-based testing, and change management.
* Experience with CAPA, deviation management, change control, and audit documentation.
* Understanding of data integrity, audit trails, access controls, and security requirements in regulated systems.
* Strong analytical, documentation, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple testing and compliance activities.

**Company Overview:**

**Aventior**

is a leading provider of innovative, end-to-end technology solutions, empowering businesses across diverse industries to solve complex challenges and accelerate growth. We harness the power of cutting-edge technologies such as
**artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), MLOps, and DevOps**

to build scalable, future-ready solutions that drive measurable business outcomes for the life science industry.

Our expertise extends across the entire data lifecycle. We offer comprehensive data development and management services, including
**cloud data architecture, universal data models, Data Transformation & ETL, data lakes, user management, Analytics & visualization,**

and
**automated data capture**

for unstructured and semi-structured sources such as scanned documents. These capabilities enable organizations to unlock the full value of their data and make faster, more informed decisions.

At Aventior, our strength lies in combining
**deep industry expertise**

with
**advanced technical capabilities**

. Our teams work closely with clients to design and deliver tailored solutions that align with their unique business needs—whether it’s optimizing operations, enhancing customer experiences, or driving strategic decision-making.

We bring a
**holistic, cross-industry perspective**

to every engagement, supported by a strong foundation in
**design, implementation, innovation, migration, and ongoing support**

. With a
**global delivery model**

, a
**multi-country presence**

, and a team of highly skilled professionals, Aventior is well-positioned to deliver consistent, high-quality outcomes at scale.

title: Support Engineer
description:
About
**think**
bridge

**think**
bridge builds the business systems growing companies run on: ERP replacements, connected systems, AI agents inside real workflows and modernized legacy software.
We have built custom software for growing companies for more than 12 years.

Today we deliver every system with
**think**
One, our method that pairs our experts with our agentic engineering and delivery platform. The platform writes much of the code. Our people understand the client's business, work out the right solution and take it to production. A typical system goes live in about four months.
Our commitments to clients
are written into the contract before a build starts.

Why work at
**think**
bridge

* About 80% of the job is thinking and problem solving
  : the rest is building.
* Our clients stay with us for four to five years on average, so you get to know their business well.
* Part of the working week is set aside for learning, so it doesn't eat into your evenings.
* You can move into a different role inside
  **think**
  bridge.
* We are Great Place to Work Certified and have an employee NPS above 90.
  See what our people say
  and
  the industry firsts behind our certification.

**Benefits:**

Benefits built for remote-first work

* Work from anywhere.
* Shape your day around your life, as long as the work lands on time.
* Take time off when you need it.
* A work laptop of your own, set up the way you like it within our security guidelines.
* Weeks when the team gets together in person to work side by side.
* Learning time in working hours, and paid certifications.

**Five values**
guide how we build for clients and how we work with each other:
**Outcomes, Quality, Accountability, Communication and Care.**

In practice:

* We take software to production.
* We check our work before anyone else has to.
* We stand by our commitments.
* We keep people informed in plain language.
* We treat a problem as ours to solve.

We hire curious people who own the outcome.
Meet the team that leads thinkbridge.

**About Role:**

**Experience Level:**
Mid-level, 2–4 years of relevant experience in the AI-Enabled Care Engineer is responsible for maintaining, improving, and supporting live production software by understanding client needs, identifying root causes, and delivering reliable solutions using AI-powered development tools. The role involves end-to-end ownership of client issues, from understanding business requirements to implementing, testing, and communicating solutions.

**What You'll Do**

**As part of the job**

* Build product and domain knowledge continuously through client interactions, product documentation, system exploration, and previous issue resolutions.
* Investigate client issues, identify root causes, clarify requirements, and distinguish between defects, maintenance requests, and new features.
* Use AI-powered development tools to analyze existing code, implement fixes and enhancements, and validate solutions against business requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Review AI-generated code critically and perform testing, regression checks, and edge-case validation to ensure production quality.
* Resolve issues independently wherever possible and involve developers only when specialist technical expertise is required.
* Challenge unclear or potentially harmful requirements constructively, recommend better solutions, and escalate complex issues with evidence and specific technical questions.
* Build client confidence through clear communication, sound judgment, timely updates, and reliable follow-through.
* Maintain accurate and detailed records of investigations, decisions, implementations, and validations in Harmony to ensure resolutions are traceable.
* Collaborate with developers when specialist expertise is required, follow security guidelines, and access production systems only with explicit authorization.
* Continuously strengthen product knowledge, technical skills, AI tool proficiency, and client relationships through sound decision-making and reliable follow-through.

**Requirements:**

**Must have technical skills**

* Strong logical reasoning, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills to investigate unfamiliar issues and identify practical solutions independently.
* Good understanding of product workflows, business rules, user requirements, application architecture, and system dependencies.
* Working knowledge of software development, APIs, databases, debugging, and relevant technology stacks.
* Proficiency in using AI-assisted development tools to investigate issues, understand existing code, implement solutions, and develop enhancements.
* Ability to critically review AI-generated code and validate solutions through testing, regression checks, and edge-case analysis.
* Familiarity with application maintenance, production troubleshooting, issue resolution, and assessing the impact of changes on existing functionality.
* Strong ownership and decision-making skills to manage issues from investigation to resolution while ensuring solution quality.
* Clear verbal and written communication skills to interact with clients and internal teams, clarify requirements, and define acceptance criteria.
* Ability to conduct product demonstrations, explain technical solutions, and communicate business outcomes effectively.
* Ability to challenge unclear requirements constructively, recommend suitable alternatives, and recognize when specialist engineering support is required.
* Understanding of security boundaries, data protection, and authorized access to production systems.
* Willingness to learn new technologies, understand unfamiliar applications, and adapt to project-specific technologies, including Firebase or the applicable backend framework.

**Good to have technical skills**

* Relevant experience in software development, application support, QA, or client-facing delivery.
* Degree or equivalent practical experience in software engineering, computer science, or a related technical discipline.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and learning abilities.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools is preferred.
* Relevant domain experience is an advantage.

**What This Role Is Not:**

* A ticket-logging or ticket-routing role.
* A conventional support role that escalates every unfamiliar issue to developers.
* A role that blindly follows client instructions without understanding their intent.
* A role that accepts AI-generated code without reviewing and testing it.
* A replacement for specialist engineers when deep architectural, infrastructure, security, or complex engineering expertise is required.

**Experience and Qualifications:**

* 1-3 years of relevant experience in software development, application support, QA, or client-facing delivery.
* Degree or equivalent practical experience in software engineering, computer science, or a related technical discipline.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and learning abilities.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools is preferred.
* Relevant domain experience is an advantage.

bridge is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on skills and character, and we treat every applicant fairly.

* Provide production support, issue troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and ServiceNow ticket resolution for platform and integration issues.
* Design, troubleshoot, and support integrations between Icertis and enterprise systems, including Salesforce and SAP Ariba.
* Analyze integration failures, identify root causes, coordinate with cross-functional teams, and support corrective actions to restore and stabilize services.
* Support data migration, deployment activities, release management, business training, and post-production stabilization efforts.

* Act as a bridge between business users such as Legal, Procurement, Sales, and Finance and technical teams supporting Icertis solutions.
* Gather and document business requirements for Icertis CLM and related enterprise solution needs.
* Analyze contract workflows, clauses, approvals, obligations, and related business processes to define effective solutions.

* Prepare or oversee the preparation of user requirements, solution documentation, support documentation, and training materials for delivered capabilities.
* Support configuration tasks, issue resolution, enhancements, and deployment activities across multiple workstreams and priorities.
* Provide solution recommendations and participate in architecture and design discussions to ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable, and aligned to platform standards.
* Monitor and support platform usage, production issues, and operational processes to improve system stability and user experience.

Solution Design
  
  

* Design fit-for-purpose solutions by collaborating with business users and leveraging the capabilities of the Icertis platform to meet functional and operational requirements.
* Validate solutions for feasibility, scalability, maintainability, and operational readiness across the delivery lifecycle.
* Guide the creation and refinement of functional specifications, user stories, process documents, test scenarios, and support documentation.

Configuration
  
  

* Execute configuration activities across templates, clauses, business rules, workflows, metadata, and related Icertis components.
* Support configuration updates and technical changes required for enhancements, fixes, deployments, and support activities.
* Assist in data migration, mapping, and validation activities during implementations, enhancements, and release cycles.

Platform Maintenance
  
  

* Support post-implementation activities such as upgrades, enhancements, issue resolution, user support, and training.
* Troubleshoot incidents and service requests, perform root cause analysis, and work toward timely resolution of production and support issues.
* Identify opportunities for process improvements, automation, and operational efficiencies across platform support and delivery.

Communication Management
  
  

* Collaborate effectively with business stakeholders, developers, testing teams, integration teams, and support teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
* Contribute to knowledge sharing, documentation, and continuous improvement initiatives within the team.
* Support stakeholder communication and help drive alignment across business and technical groups.

**Experience**

* Strong experience in requirements gathering, stakeholder management, business process analysis, and solution documentation.
* Experience with Icertis Contract Intelligence (ICI) or other Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) platforms is preferred.
* Strong capabilities in system configuration, testing, troubleshooting, and solution design/solutioning.
* Experience with production support, ServiceNow ticket management, and incident resolution is advantageous.
* Knowledge of Salesforce and SAP Ariba integrations, including failure analysis, issue troubleshooting, and cross-functional team coordination, is highly desirable.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and organizational skills.
* Good understanding of end-to-end testing and regression testing in lower environments, with the ability to: Execute and document test scenarios and results. title: Data Quality Analyst - Senior 1
description:
**Job Summary**
Leads, develops, and implements project(s) of varying complexity and size in assigned functional area. Partners with business stakeholders to ensure a successful project completion and organizational improved capability to data quality standards.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Leads the quality and integrity of the data within the assigned functional area. Serves as an expert on data quality tools. Conducts data profiling for data. Develops Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to measure data quality. Creates and executes action plans to resolve data quality issues. Maintains existing rules and develops new rules to support a robust data quality process. Escalates issues and critical conflicts in a timely fashion. Identifies and mitigates data quality risks. Reports data quality risks and KPI measurement statistics to data governance council. Manages metadata and data standards to ensure adherence, working closely with IT. Coordinates activities of data stewards located within the business, working closely with the business process owner. Supports business data analysis and proposal creation as a member of a data governance council. Guides the business to prepare data. Leads initial data exploration steps (binning, pivoting, summarizing and finding correlations, for example). Catalogues business attributes to enable data discovery. Coaches business to establish and enforce guidelines for data collection, integration and processes. Leads data and systems analysis as required to support data governance processes. Understands data governance roles and processes, and ensures that they are followed. Prepares and presents communications to leaders and stakeholders.
  
  
**Competencies**
Balances stakeholders - Anticipating and balancing the needs of multiple stakeholders.
  
  
Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.
  
  
Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
  
  
Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.
  
  
Interpersonal savvy - Relating openly and comfortably with diverse groups of people.
  
  
Manages ambiguity - Operating effectively, even when things are not certain or the way forward is not clear.
  
  
Data Analytics - Discovers, interprets and communicates qualitative and quantitative data; determines conclusions relying on knowledge of business or functional frameworks; simultaneously applies statistics, data validity, data visualization, and problem solving approaches to effectively extract meaningful patterns and business insights; presents conclusions and outcomes that enable data driven business decisions.
  
  
Data Mining - Extracts insights from data by identifying relationships and patterns through use of a suite of data exploration and data visualization techniques to understand the underlying structure of the data and enable sound conclusions upon model building.
  
  
Data Modeling - Creates, writes and tests data models, test scripts and build scripts using industry standards and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.
  
  
Data Communication and Visualization - Constructs a tale of the business problem, root cause, solution options, and opportunities through illustrating data visually, including reports and dashboards.
  
  
Data Governance - Assures definition, ownership, metadata management, and security for Cummins data.
  
  
Data Literacy - Expresses data in context, including data sources and constructs, analytical methods and applied techniques; describes the use-case application and resulting value.
  
  
Data Profiling - Assesses data issues and cleansing requirements to perform data extraction, mapping, collection, and testing; establishes good, quality data.
  
  
Data Quality - Identifies, understands and corrects flaws in data that supports effective information governance across operational business processes and decision making.
  
  
Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
  
  
**Education, Licenses, Certifications**
College, university, or equivalent degree in statistics, information systems or related field required.
  
  
This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.
  
  
**Experience**
Intermediate level of relevant work experience required.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities Unique To The Role**

* Lead the design, implementation, and continuous evolution of the Enterprise Data Quality Framework across the data ecosystem(ingestion pipelines, data warehouses, semantic layers, and Data Products). Establish scalable standards, policies, controls, and best practices that ensure enterprise data is trusted, governed, certified, and AI-ready. 2) Establish and operationalize data quality capabilities by implementing automated data profiling, validation, reconciliation, monitoring, observability, issue management, and scorecard processes. Define measurable data quality KPIs, SLAs, and governance mechanisms that improve the accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, validity, and reliability of critical enterprise data assets. 3) Partner with Data Engineering, Solution Engineering, Enterprise Data Management (EDM), Architecture, Product Management, cross functional teams and Business teams to embed Data-as-a-Product quality practices throughout the data lifecycle, including business rule management, metadata standards, lineage validation, certification processes, root cause analysis, and proactive remediation of data quality issues.

**Required Skills, Education, Or Experience**

* Strong hands-on experience designing, implementing, and leading enterprise Data Quality programs and frameworks, including data profiling, validation, reconciliation, root cause analysis, monitoring, issue management, scorecards, and continuous improvement initiatives across large-scale Data Warehouse, Lakehouse, and Data Product environments. 2) Strong expertise in Data Quality, Data Governance, Metadata Management, Data Lineage, Data Stewardship, Master Data Management (MDM), Business Glossary Management, and Data-as-a-Product practices, with experience establishing quality standards, controls, certification processes, and governance frameworks for enterprise data assets. 3) Proven experience implementing and automating data quality controls across the end-to-end data lifecycle, including Source Systems, Data Ingestion, Raw/Bronze, Curated/Silver, Business/Gold, Semantic Models, and Enterprise Data Products, utilizing capabilities such as data profiling, rule-based validations, reconciliations, anomaly detection, exception management, data observability, and quality KPI monitoring. 4) Hands-on expertise with modern cloud data platforms and data engineering technologies, such as Snowflake, Databricks, SQL, Matillion, dbt, and Power BI, with the ability to design scalable data quality solutions and embed quality controls within enterprise data pipelines. 5) Experience with enterprise Data Quality and Governance platforms, and data observability solutions to implement data quality frameworks, metadata management, lineage, cataloging, certification, and governance capabilities across enterprise data products.

**Preferred (Nice To Have) Skills, Education, Or Experience**

* Experience implementing data quality frameworks for Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, Product Lifecycle, and other Enterprise Products domains within large-scale Data Modernization or Data-as-a-Product initiatives. 2) Experience applying AI/ML and Data Observability capabilities to Data Quality, including anomaly detection, predictive quality monitoring, automated root cause analysis, AI-ready data certification, and governance controls supporting Analytics, Machine Learning, and GenAI solutions.

title: Design Quality Engineer
description:
Job Title
  
  
Design Quality Engineer
  
  
**Job Description**
DQE is responsible for the implementation of comprehensive process validation plans, ensuring smooth transitions of new products to production, working under general supervision. The role supports in the design control process, from validating design inputs to managing verification, validation, and design transfer, ensuring compliance with regulatory and quality standards. The role reviews and refines quality engineering documents, initiates quality improvement projects, and provides expertise in risk management. The role resolves complex quality issues, utilizes post-market analytics for continuous improvement, and prepares for quality audits to maintain adherence to internal and external standards.
  
  
**In this role, you have the opportunity to**

* The Quality Engineer is accountable for oversight of system and hardware quality and risk management
* throughout the product life cycle.
* The Quality Engineer provides independent oversight of the design input process, design V&V activities,
* design transfer and product realization, and performance in the field to ensure that all design
* requirements are effectively met.
* The Quality Engineer also provides analytics to the Business on the efficacy and efficiency of the design
* and product realization processes

**You are responsible to**

* Be responsible for the design control in Sustaining Project Quality Assurance
* Ensures that appropriate Quality Plans are made that include all stages of the life cycle of the product
* and supports Quality Plan design
* Validates key design inputs like: usability, reliability, performance, supportability, manufacturability,
* localizability, safety, security, privacy, serviceability, sustainability, and costs
* Provides effective oversight of the execution of the Quality Plan, any Risk Management activities, and all
* design-related activities during the product/system life cycle
* Performs independent technical assessment of product quality performance and post-market product
* quality analysis
* Can Lead quality related problem-solving and root cause analysis during design and manufacturing
* Uses post-market analytics and statistics to report on product quality performance in the field (provide
* feedback to manufacturing, suppliers, or design teams) and initiates field actions when required
* Act as a single point of contact (the person assigned to the project team) responsible for ensuring that
* hardware design meets quality and compliance standards for every milestone
* Ensure product-development processes and documentation meet Quality System requirements in
* relevant regulations, e.g. CFR 820.30, and ISO13485.
* Drive project decision direction toward compliance, cross-functionally and globally. (Process)
* Ensure that program documentation (Design History File) is created, controlled, and archived per the
* Quality System. (Process)
* Lead, prepare, and participate/be the main escort in internal and external audits
* Frequently interacts with supervisors and functional peer groups. Interaction normally requires the
* ability to gain the cooperation of others, conducting presentations of technical information concerning
* specific projects or schedules.

**To succeed in this role, you should have the following background, basic skills or experience**

* BE in Engineering
* Strong quality assurance management experience, minimum 8 years in quality assurance
* Strong design control and new product development experience
* Strong analytical abilities
* Professional knowledge in the area of ISO 13485, FDA 820, ISO14971, FDA/MDR/MDSAP
* Strong communication, problem-solving, and continuous improvement.
* Fluent in English both in writing and speaking
* Have experience in the medical industry or highly regulated industry (preferred)
* Strong Influence Skills, Presentation Skills and Dispute solving Skills

**How We Work Together**
We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week.
  
  
Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities.
  
  
Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.
  
  
This role is an office role.
  
  
**About Philips**
We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help the lives of others.
  
  

* Learn more about our business.
* Discover our rich and exciting history.
* Learn more about our purpose.

If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care here.

title: Delivery Manager-Test Lead
description:
**Job Purpose**
Looking for a Test Lead / Data QA Engineer to drive and oversee data validation, manual testing, and regression testing activities across capital markets data pipelines spanning both legacy and modern platforms. The role is responsible for ensuring data accuracy, completeness, consistency, integrity, and adherence to business rules through source-to-target validation, schema verification, data reconciliation, lineage analysis, and automation-led regression testing.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong data QA and testing expertise, hands-on automation skills, capital markets domain knowledge, and a proactive ownership mindset to ensure data quality, consistency, and reliability across environments.
  
  
The successful candidate will lead test delivery, manage and coordinate offshore QA resources, and engage closely with business and technology stakeholders to maintain high-quality data across post-trade and enterprise data ecosystems. Key responsibilities include building reusable Python- and SQL-based validation frameworks, supporting batch and cloud-based execution models, identifying data anomalies, validating end-to-end data flows, and embedding robust data quality controls throughout the development lifecycle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end test planning, execution, and delivery for data validation and regression testing initiatives, ensuring quality, schedule, and stakeholder expectations are met.
* Manage and mentor offshore/onshore QA teams, including resource planning, task allocation, deliverable reviews, and adherence to testing best practices.
* Drive test governance, including test strategy, defect management, risk tracking, quality metrics, status reporting, and release readiness assessments.
* Collaborate with business, engineering, and product teams to define requirements, resolve issues, ensure test coverage, and embed quality controls across the delivery lifecycle.
* Perform source-to-target data validation across legacy and modern systems, including SQL Server and cloud-based data environments.
* Validate data accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, duplication handling, referential integrity, schema structures, metadata, lineage, and business-rule conformance.
* Build and maintain automation-first regression testing frameworks using Python, PySpark, SQL, and reusable validation utilities.
* Execute field-level, dataset-level, transformation-level, and aggregate-level data checks across source, staging, warehouse, data lake, and downstream systems.
* Validate ETL/ELT pipelines, post-trade data flows, stored procedures, batch jobs, and cloud-based execution workflows.
* Design reusable test cases, validation scenarios, reconciliation checks, automated scripts, and regression packs for repeatable data-quality assurance.
* Write, optimize, and troubleshoot complex SQL queries and stored procedures across SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, or similar platforms.
* Translate business rules, stored procedure logic, and post-trade process flows into automated validation scripts and assertions.
* Build Python-based utilities, APIs, CLI tools, and reusable frameworks to support data validation, orchestration, API integrations, and reporting workflows.
* Integrate regression tests, data validation checks, SQL deployables, and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab, or equivalent tools.
* Automate execution of AutoSys jobs, batch processes, stored procedures, and validation scripts across development, UAT, and production environments.
* Work with engineering teams to embed data quality controls into pipelines, releases, and operational workflows.
* Identify data anomalies, schema mismatches, duplicate records, null-handling issues, transformation failures, reconciliation breaks, and integrity violations.
* Log defects with clear evidence, impact analysis, root-cause observations, and business context.
* Support capital markets and post-trade validation across allocations, clearing, settlement, confirmations, reconciliations, market data, reference data, and downstream reporting.

**Key competencies**

* 8–12 years of hands-on experience in Data QA, Data Engineering QA, or Python-based automation roles and proven experience leading QA teams, test planning, estimation, execution, defect management, and end-to-end test delivery across complex data programs.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to communicate test status, risks, quality metrics, and release readiness to business and technology leadership.
* Experience establishing test strategies, governance frameworks, quality standards, resource planning, and mentoring distributed QA teams.
* Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional collaboration, manage competing priorities, mitigate delivery risks, and ensure

successful project outcomes in Agile environments.
  
  

* Strong Python skills for data validation, automation framework development, regression testing, and pipeline verification.
* Working knowledge of PySpark for validating large-scale data pipelines and distributed datasets.
* Solid SQL skills for source-to-target validation, reconciliation, complex queries, stored procedures, schema checks, and defect analysis.
* Experience in data QA, ETL/ELT testing, data pipeline testing, and regression testing across legacy and modern platforms.
* Proven experience building automation-first regression frameworks, reusable validation scripts, test cases, and data verification utilities.
* Strong understanding of data quality dimensions including accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, uniqueness, referential integrity, and business-rule conformance.
* Experience validating metadata, schema structures, data types, constraints, lineage, transformation logic, and downstream outputs.
* Exposure to CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or GitLab, with the ability to integrate automated tests and quality gates into deployment pipelines.
* Familiarity with batch orchestration tools such as AutoSys, Control-M, or Airflow.
* Good analytical skills to understand post-trade, financial, market data, or reference data and translate them into repeatable validation scenarios.
* Experience with JIRA, XRay, agile delivery practices, defect management, and QA process governance.
* Proficiency in leveraging AI-assisted tools such as Claude or GitHub Copilot to accelerate test case generation, SQL development, data validation, defect analysis, documentation, and test data creation.
* Strong communication, problem-solving, attention to detail, and cross-functional collaboration skills. Domain Experience (Must Have)
* Strong experience in Fixed Income Capital Markets domain
* Good understanding of Fixed Income products, reference data, pricing, securities, positions, settlements, and trade lifecycle concepts
* Experience working with market data, reference data, and regulatory reporting-related data sets

**Nice to Have**

* Exposure to Azure, AWS, ADF, containers, Kubernetes, or cloud-based data platforms.
* Experience with relational and NoSQL databases such as SQL Server, MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB, or similar platforms.
* Exposure to Hadoop, Spark, Databricks, cloud data lakes, and Big Data validation.
* Experience validating batch, streaming, real-time, and Kafka-based ingestion pipelines.
* Capital markets domain exposure, especially post-trade, market data, reference data, trade data, or ION/blotter platform

integrations.
  
  

* Exposure to DevSecOps, infrastructure as code, and code quality tools such as Terraform, Bicep, Sonar, Mend, or ZAP.

title: Performance Engineering Architect
description:
**About Avaya**
Avaya is an enterprise software leader that helps the world’s largest organizations and government agencies forge unbreakable connections.
  
  
The Avaya Infinity™ platform unifies fragmented customer experiences, connecting the channels, insights, technologies, and workflows that together create enduring customer and employee relationships.

**About The Job**
We are seeking a Performance Architect – QA to join our R&D team as a senior individual contributor. The ideal candidate is a hands-on performance engineering expert with a deep architectural pedigree in core products, platforms, or large-scale enterprise software. You will shape our overarching performance strategy and partner closely with Product Engineering, Architecture, SRE, DevOps, and R&D teams to deliver highly scalable, resilient, and low-latency products.
  
  
In this role, you will own the performance engineering domain from an architectural perspective—driving strategies that build performance into the core system design. While performance remains your primary focus, you will also bring critical insights into end-to-end, system-level Quality Assurance. By bridging the gap between functional automation and non-functional engineering, you will ensure a holistic approach to system reliability, helping elevate our entire QA framework. This role involves technical ownership and cross-functional influence, with no people-management responsibilities.
  
  
**About You**

* Experience: 15+ years in QA, software/performance engineering, and automation, with 10+ years of hands-on SaaS experience. Mandatory background in a Core Product or R&D organization.
* Architecture & Systems: Expertise in distributed systems, microservices, cloud-native patterns, multi-tenant platforms, and load balancing (e.g., Istio service mesh).
* Performance & Reliability: Experience establishing data-driven SLOs/SLIs and error budgets. Proven ability to lead chaos engineering initiatives (fault injection, failovers) and capacity planning using real-time SRE/APM telemetry.
* Testing & Tooling: Expert in performance testing frameworks (K6, JMeter, Gatling, or custom simulators) and stateful/protocol-level fuzzing (HTTP/2, gRPC, WebSocket). Advanced proficiency in functional automation (Playwright, Cypress, Selenium).
* Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on with Docker, Terraform, and Kubernetes (AKS preferred) for autoscaling and high availability.
* Development & CI/CD: Strong programming skills in Java, Python, C#, or Go. Seamless integration of continuous verification into CI/CD pipelines.
* Observability: Mastery of APM tools, distributed tracing, database tuning, Prometheus, and Grafana.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

**Why Join & Who Should Apply**
This is a high-impact role focused heavily on technical depth, engineering judgment, and cross-functional mentorship. You are a strong fit if you:
  
  

* Have scaled complex, distributed products in an R&D environment and deeply understand the entire product lifecycle.
* Can authoritatively influence architectural decisions using data-driven performance insights.
* Possess a big-picture vision for end-to-end QA, optimizing both functional boundaries and non-functional baselines.
* Can perfectly balance hands-on coding, debugging, and production analysis with strategic architecture ownership.

Bachelor degree or equivalent experience
  
  
Advance Degree preferred
  
  
**Preferred Certifications**

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

description:
Intellectsoft is a software development company delivering innovative solutions since 2007. We operate across North America, Latin America, the Nordic region, the UK, and Europe. We specialize in industries like Fintech, Healthcare, EdTech, Construction, Hospitality, and more, partnering with startups, mid-sized businesses, and Fortune 500 companies to drive innovation and scalability. Our clients include Jaguar Motors, Universal Pictures, Harley-Davidson, and many more where our teams are making daily impactTogether, our team delivers solutions that make a difference. Learn more at www.intellectsoft.net
  
  
Our customer advises global pharmaceutical and life sciences clients across commercial strategy, clinical development, regulatory operations, and medical affairs. An increasing share of this work is powered by AI agents designed to handle complex scientific and commercial datasets. This role is split roughly evenly between internal research (developing reusable agent harness components, benchmark evaluations, and reliability frameworks) and client delivery (architecting, deploying, and scaling production-ready agentic systems).
  
  
**Requirements**

* Professional Experience: 2-3 years of professional software engineering experience, including substantive work building LLM-based or agentic systems (beyond prompt-level experimentation)
* Production Deployment: Proven track record of deploying user-facing AI applications to production, including operational experience with monitoring, versioning, rate limiting, cost control, and incident response
* Core Software Engineering & Python: Strong Python skills with production-grade test coverage, typing, asyncio, Pydantic, Pytest, packaging, version control, CI/CD, and robust API design
* LLM & Agent Frameworks: Hands-on experience with LLM APIs, function/tool calling, structured outputs, streaming, and context window management. Experience building or extending orchestration frameworks (such as LangGraph, deepagents, OpenAI Agents SDK, or custom harnesses) with a clear view on framework utility
* Non-Deterministic Evaluation: Ability to define success criteria, design evaluation datasets, and systematically evaluate non-deterministic AI outputs
* Cloud & Shipping: Working knowledge of containerization and at least one major cloud provider to ship and maintain services independently
* Communication & Adaptability: Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to represent technical positions credibly and thrive amid shifting project priorities.

**Nice to have**

* Domain Knowledge: Prior exposure to healthcare, pharma, or biotech data (clinical trial data, real-world evidence, regulatory submissions, pharmacovigilance, or commercial analytics) and standards (CDISC, SNOMED, MedDRA)
* Regulated Environments: Familiarity with GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, HIPAA, GDPR, audit logging, and formal system validation
* Observability & Protocols: Hands-on experience with LLM tracing tools (LangSmith, Langfuse, Braintrust, OpenTelemetry) or developing and hosting MCP servers
* Retrieval & Models: Experience with RAG pipelines, vector search (pgvector, Qdrant, Weaviate), fine-tuning, distillation, or model serving (vLLM, Bedrock, Vertex AI)
* DevOps & Data Engineering: Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, GitHub Actions, AWS/Azure) alongside large-scale data processing using Polars, Pandas, DuckDB, and advanced SQL
* Consulting & Ecosystem Engagement: Prior consulting/client services experience, active use of agentic developer tooling (such as Claude Code), or open-source contributions/publications in agent architectures and evaluations

**Responsibilities**

* Harness & Orchestration Architecture: Design and build core agent harnesses, covering function calling, tool interfaces, context assembly, retrieval integration, subagent delegation, retry logic, and failure handling
* Prototype to Production Delivery: Take agentic systems from initial concept to scalable production, managing deployment, monitoring, cost, latency, and operational support against live enterprise client data
* Evaluation Infrastructure: Build and maintain rigorous evaluation suites, task benchmarks, scoring rubrics, and regression tests using tools like Langfuse, Pydantic Logfire, or custom SDKs to drive architectural decisions
* System & Tool Integration: Integrate client enterprise systems, data sources, and internal APIs as accessible agent tools, including building and managing Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers
* Solution Consulting & Requirements Translation: Translate ambiguous client requirements into robust agent architectures, clearly advising stakeholders when an agentic pattern is—or is not—the right solution
* Stakeholder Communication: Interface directly with client stakeholders and articulate technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical audiences
* Tooling Transfer & Documentation: Contribute reusable harness components to shared internal tooling and document design decisions to meet audit, validation, and handover standards

**Benefits**

* Employment-based cooperation
* Comprehensive insurance for you and your family (health, life, and accident)
* Paid PTO policy (vacation, sick leaves, and public holidays)
* Tech equipment provided
* Udemy courses, workshops, trainings & expert knowledge-sharing
* Flexible hours & work setup

In partnership with our business leaders, we develop and deliver seamless technology experiences to our employees across the entire employee lifecycle. Our vision and mission is to create innovative, transformative and contemporary technology solutions to empower our leaders and employees so they can focus on what matters most, our customers. We are technologists with strong business acumen focused on developing our talent to continually transform and innovate.
  
  
We are seeking a detail-oriented
**Sr.**
**Technical Functional Analyst**
who can provide support in the execution of projects that include a technical component. This is a hands-on delivery role focused on functional analysis, system behavior definition, and technical collaboration within MetLife’s technology landscape. The role translates business requirements into precise techno functional designs that can be implemented, tested, and operated reliably. Acting at the intersection of business, IT delivery, and vendors, the analyst ensures solutions are technically feasible, well-specified, and aligned with MetLife’s New Frontier strategy by improving solution quality, reducing rework, and enabling predictable delivery.

Internal Stake Holder – EMEA ART Leader, ART Leadership team, India EMEA Technology AVP, and Business process Owners for EMEA Technology.

title: Director - Quality Assurance
description:
We are seeking a talented individual to join our Training & Quality team at Mercer, a Marsh business. This role will be based in Pune. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.
  
  
**Director- Quality Assurance (Training & Quality Assurance)**
**We will count on you to:**
This role encompasses managing the team (currently 20+ colleagues) who ensure quality excellence and develop training programs for Marsh Agencycolleagues. The team's activities include designing and delivering training programs, conducting quality assurance reviews, performing data quality validation across local country offices, creating training deliverables for team members and clients, and maintaining standards.
  
  
**Supervise team and develop training excellence across the organization**

* Oversee team responsible for designing, developing, and delivering comprehensive training programs for Marsh Agency operations
* Ensure team has appropriate resources and instructional design tools to create high-quality training content
* Develop and implement a training strategy that addresses skill gaps and supports career progression
* Plan for and execute staff development, including development plans for all levels of employees
* Draft and implement career path progression, beginning at level C and progressing from there
* Coach team members on training delivery, assessment, and continuous learning methodologies
* Handle escalations from team members and stakeholders regarding training effectiveness and quality concerns

**Drive quality assurance and continuous improvement**

* Establish and maintain robust quality assurance frameworks and metrics across all team activities
* Conduct regular quality audits of processes, deliverables, and data validation procedures
* Identify quality gaps, root causes, and implement corrective actions
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives using quality management tools and methodologies
* Develop and communicate quality standards and best practices across the COE
* Monitor key quality metrics and prepare reporting for stakeholders
* Build a culture of quality excellence and accountability within the team

**Liaison with Marsh Agency stakeholders to develop training and quality strategy**

* Regularly schedule calls and meetings with stakeholders for strategic planning of training programs and quality initiatives
* Conduct annual forecasting of training needs, resource requirements, and budgeting for the team
* Develop training roadmap aligned with Marsh Agency delivery objectives and client needs
* Sit on steering groups with various stakeholders as appropriate to align training and quality initiatives
* Partner with local country offices to identify training gaps and quality improvement opportunities

**Marsh Agency intellectual capital and knowledge management**

* Work with stakeholders to determine training materials and intellectual capital the team will own and develop
* Ensure training content is up to date, appropriate for all audience levels, and accessible to colleagues
* Lead standardization initiatives for training templates, delivery formats, and quality documentation
* Champion the development of knowledge repositories and best practice libraries
* Maintain alignment with Mercer's learning and development standards

Note: Applicants should be flexible working in shifts
  
  
**What you need to have?**

* Graduate with minimum 15+ years' experience overall, with 5+ years in training and/or quality management roles
* Demonstrated experience in designing and delivering training programs or managing quality assurance functions
* Strong leadership and people management skills with proven ability to develop high-performing teams
* Excellent critical and strategic thinking skills with focus on process improvement and quality excellence
* Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to influence across organizational boundaries
* Strong oral and written communication skills with ability to create clear training materials and quality documentation
* Ability to prioritize and handle multiple training initiatives and quality projects in a demanding environment
* Ability to coach others on training delivery, quality standards, and best practices
* Ability to partner and work with colleagues locally and globally to achieve training and quality objectives
* Ability to interact with onshore leadership, lead discussions as needed, and provide relevant reporting
* Understanding of quality management frameworks, methodologies, and continuous improvement tools
* Proficiency in MS Office Tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and learning management systems (preferred)
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to maintaining high quality standards

**What makes you stand out?**

* Adaptable communicator, facilitator, influencer and problem solver
* Proven track record of implementing successful training programs or quality initiatives
* High attention to detail with commitment to excellence
* Good relationship skills and proven ability to work on own initiative as well as in a team
* Ability to multi-task and prioritize time effectively while managing competing training and quality demands
* Passion for continuous learning and development
* Experience with instructional design, training technology, or quality management certifications (Six Sigma, ISO, etc.)undefined

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.

title: Software Quality Assurance, Senior
description:
**Location:**
Hybrid - Pune
  
  
**Position Summary**
At Bentley Systems, our software forms the digital back
  
  
bone for the world's most critical infrastructure projects. The integrity of that backbone rests on the quality of our products, and we are looking for a professional who shares that commitment.
  
  
We are seeking a meticulous and proactive
**Software Quality Analyst**
to join our industry-leading ProjectWise team. In this role, you will hold a pivotal position, responsible for validating the functionality, performance, and stability of software used to design and manage everything from nuclear power plants to international airports.
  
  
This is an opportunity to move beyond standard testing. You will be a key contributor to the development lifecycle, acting as a crucial advocate for quality and ensuring that our solutions meet the rigorous demands of the engineers who rely on them. If you are a QA professional driven by a sense of ownership and a desire to work on complex, high-impact products, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Partner with Development, Product Management, and other stakeholders to define quality goals, assess risks, and develop comprehensive test strategies, test scenarios, and validation plans for complex features and releases.
* Lead defect management activities by identifying, documenting, prioritizing, and driving resolution of software defects, ensuring timely communication of quality risks and impacts.
* Own validation efforts for new features and releases, performing and guiding regression, smoke, sanity, exploratory, and risk-based testing activities to ensure product quality.
* Champion quality engineering best practices across the software development lifecycle, driving continuous improvements in processes, testing approaches, and release readiness.
* Analyze quality metrics, test results, and product trends, providing actionable insights and quality recommendations to engineering and product leadership.
* Drive adoption of emerging QA technologies, AI-assisted testing practices, and quality engineering tools, while mentoring team members and sharing best practices across teams.
* Own the setup, maintenance, and troubleshooting of complex test environments, ensuring they accurately represent customer deployments and support effective testing.
* Define and drive the test automation strategy, identify opportunities for AI-assisted and automated testing, and lead initiatives to improve test coverage, reliability, efficiency, and overall product quality.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in a STEM engineering discipline (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics).
* 8+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, including ownership of complex testing initiatives and release validation.
* Deep understanding of QA principles, methodologies, and risk-based testing approaches across the software development lifecycle.
* Strong quality ownership mindset, with a proven ability to identify quality risks early, drive resolution, and influence quality outcomes across teams.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to define test strategies, test plans, and test scenarios for complex features, even when requirements are evolving, incomplete, or ambiguous.
* Advanced technical knowledge of test environment architecture, configuration, troubleshooting, and environment readiness management.
* Proficiency in leveraging AI tools (Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) to improve test design, quality analysis, productivity, and testing effectiveness.
* Experience working with test automation frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and quality engineering practices, with the ability to identify automation opportunities and guide adoption.
* Experience mentoring QA engineers, promoting testing best practices, and helping drive a culture of quality within engineering teams.
* Ability to analyze quality trends, define quality metrics, and provide data-driven recommendations to support release readiness decisions.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.

This is a Hybrid role.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Step into a collaborative work environment where ideas flourish, and teamwork propels us forward towards shared success.
* An attractive salary and benefits package.
* Bentley Impact Day: take a day off from work to volunteer with an organization of your choice.

Our industry-leading software solutions are used by professionals, and organizations of every size, for the design, construction, and operations of roads and bridges, rail and transit, water and wastewater, public works and utilities, buildings and campuses, mining, and industrial facilities.
