title: Senior QA Engineer – Functional, System & Cloud Testing
description:
BETSOL is a cloud-first digital transformation and data management company offering products and IT services to enterprises in over 40 countries. BETSOL team holds several engineering patents, is recognized with industry awards, and BETSOL maintains a net promoter score that is 2x the industry average.
  
  
BETSOL’s open source backup and recovery product line, Zmanda (Zmanda.com), delivers up to 50% savings in total cost of ownership (TCO) and best-in-class performance.
  
  
BETSOL Global IT Services (BETSOL.com) builds and supports end-to-end enterprise solutions, reducing time-to-market for its customers.
  
  
BETSOL offices are set against the vibrant backdrops of Broomfield, Colorado and Bangalore, India.
  
  
We take pride in being an employee-centric organization, offering comprehensive health insurance, competitive salaries, 401K, volunteer programs, and scholarship opportunities. Office amenities include a fitness center, cafe, and recreational facilities.
  
  
Learn more at betsol.com
  
  
**Job Description**
**About the Role**
We are looking for an experienced Senior QA Engineer to test a cloud-based, distributed SaaS platform. This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone with 7–8+ years of experience. You should have broad technical knowledge and be able to think at the system level. You will own the quality of the product areas assigned to you. That means testing features, integrations, cloud behavior and complete customer workflows, and making sure test coverage leaves no critical risk untested. The right person has strong functional and system testing skills, knows cloud and microservices architecture well, and takes an investigative approach to finding complex defects that affect customers.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
*Test design and coverage*

* Design and run comprehensive functional, system, integration, end-to-end and regression tests for the areas you own.
* Build and maintain coverage for those areas (requirement traceability, risk-based coverage maps, mind maps) so that critical workflows, configurations and integrations are all validated.
* Find gaps in test coverage and close them proactively across releases.
* Design detailed test matrices covering permutations and combinations of configurations, user roles, deployments and data variations.

*System and cloud testing*

* Test across microservices, APIs, event streams, databases and third-party integrations.
* Validate application behavior in cloud environments (AWS, Azure or GCP), including scalability, failover, resiliency, multi-tenancy and behavior that depends on configuration.
* Find and investigate intermittent, concurrency, timing and distributed-system defects using logs, monitoring and observability tools.
* Check data integrity and transaction consistency with SQL/NoSQL queries and log analysis.

*Exploratory and customer-focused testing*

* Apply advanced exploratory, heuristic-based and risk-based testing to find edge cases, negative scenarios and hidden integration failures.
* Simulate real customer workflows under complex enterprise configurations and data volumes.
* Run impact analysis and sanity, regression and cross-functional checks for releases, patches and hotfixes.

*Collaboration*

* Work closely with Product, Development, DevOps and Architecture teams to clarify requirements and question assumptions early.
* Write clear defect reports that cover root cause, reproduction steps, business impact and troubleshooting details.
* Take an active part in Agile ceremonies, release readiness reviews and quality risk discussions.

**Mandatory Skills And Experience**
*Technical*

* 7–8+ years in software QA, with strong depth in functional, system, integration and end-to-end testing of enterprise SaaS or cloud products.
* Hands-on experience testing distributed, microservices-based applications on AWS, Azure or GCP.
* Strong ability to design tests and plan coverage, including test matrices, scenario combinations and risk-based prioritization.
* Hands-on REST API testing (Postman or similar) and backend validation with SQL/NoSQL databases.
* Strong debugging skills using logs, APIs, databases and monitoring tools (e.g. Kibana, Grafana, CloudWatch, Datadog).
* Good understanding of CI/CD pipelines, containers and cloud infrastructure concepts as they affect testing.
* Experience in Agile/Scrum teams with fast release cycles.

*Soft skills*

* Strong ownership of and accountability for product quality.
* Ability to work independently on complex, loosely defined problems and turn them into clear test plans.
* Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, and willingness to think beyond documented requirements.
* Clear communication and good collaboration with cross-functional teams.
* Ability to handle several testing activities in parallel and work under pressure.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with Contact Center, CCaaS, Unified Communications, CX or telephony platforms.
* Exposure to omnichannel workflows such as voice, chat, email, routing, reporting and agent or supervisor workflows.
* Exposure to test automation (Selenium, Playwright, REST Assured or similar).
* Experience with performance, load or resiliency testing (JMeter, k6, chaos testing).
* Basic knowledge of security testing.
* ISTQB Advanced or an equivalent certification.

**Qualifications**
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  
  
**Additional Information**
**Ideal Candidate Profile**
A seasoned, hands-on QA professional who sees the whole system rather than individual features. They understand how cloud infrastructure, services, data and customer workflows fit together, and their test coverage reflects that. They are technically curious, very good at exploratory testing, and focused on delivering stable, high-quality releases.
  
  
**Work Location and Hours**

* Work from Office, Monday to Friday, at Magarpatta, Pune.
* General shift, with flexibility to coordinate with global stakeholders across time zones when needed.

title: Principal Test Engineer
description:
For more than 30 years, SonicWall has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. Backed by a global ecosystem of more than 17,000 partners, SonicWall delivers enterprise-grade protection built for SMB and mid-market realities.

 

For more information, visit


www.sonicwall.com

or follow us on


X,


LinkedIn

,


Facebook

, and


Instagram

.

 

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a
**Principal Test Engineer (Test PE) / QA Lead**
to partner directly with the Sonicwall Firewall development team. In this high-impact technical role, you will lead feature testing, complex defect reproduction, test plan architecture, and automation development across critical Sonicwall Firewall networking and security components.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

* ****Dev Partnership & Defect Triage:****
  Work closely with firmware and software developers to reproduce intricate customer and field issues, isolate root causes, and verify bug fixes.
* ****Test Strategy & Planning:****
  Architect end-to-end test strategies, author detailed test plans, and design comprehensive functional, system, and regression test suites.
* ****STLC & Quality Governance:****
  Drive the complete Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC)—identifying, filing, prioritizing, and tracking defects to closure in an Agile environment.
* ****Test Automation Engineering:****
  Develop, execute, and maintain automated test suites (functional, regression, and system) using Python to integrate into continuous testing pipelines.
* ****Component & Feature Qualification:****
  Deep-dive into Sonicwall Firewall  subsystems to validate new feature requirements, performance limits, and edge-case handling.
* ****Technical QA Mentorship:****
  Guide and mentor team members on test methodologies, test tool development, and network security validation.

**Core Skills & Requirements**

* ****Domain & SQA Experience:****
  10+ years of software quality assurance experience in the networking and network security domain for enterprise network products, appliances, or firewalls.

* ****Domain & Network Security Expertise:****

+ Deep understanding of L2–L7 networking concepts: TCP/IP, IP routing, NAT, VLANs, and stateful packet filtering.

We are seeking a Process Assurance Consultant to join our Global Customer Services team in Pune. You will develop and administer quality systems, tools, and materials while implementing corporate quality initiatives including ISO 9001, ISO 27001, SOC2, TISAX, and continuous improvement processes. This role is pivotal in enabling our organization to deliver world-class services and support to our global customers through robust quality frameworks and process excellence.

We are seeking a hands-on Firmware Design Engineer with 3-7 years of experience to implement, integrate, verify, and support embedded firmware for Client's fire and life-safety portfolio. The role supports new product development, product enhancements, platform updates, value engineering, component changes, compliance, and production support. Working with the Firmware Engineering Manager and experienced engineers, the candidate will own defined modules or features, develop drivers and product logic, support hardware bring-up, investigate defects, execute tests, and maintain controlled technical records. Assignments may include new implementations, legacy-code improvements, hardware or toolchain migrations, and changes driven by quality, cost, availability, or field performance.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Firmware Development and Implementation**

• Implement firmware work packages for new products, product enhancements, redesigns, sustenance, and value-engineering initiatives.

• Review software requirements, hardware interfaces, schematics, datasheets, existing source code, product documentation, and test procedures for assigned work.

• Develop or update startup, BSP, HAL, and driver modules for GPIO, timers, interrupts, ADC, PWM, serial interfaces, flash, non-volatile memory, watchdogs, and debug functions.

• Implement application logic for control, communication, indication, relays, supervised I/O, configuration, diagnostics, trouble reporting, and power-state behaviour as required.

• Maintain clear separation between reusable platform software and product configuration to reduce duplication and simplify regression.

• Support microcontroller, compiler, IDE, or hardware-platform migrations when included in an assigned project.

Integration Debugging and Verification

• Support board bring-up, peripheral validation, signal-level debugging, and hardware-firmware fault isolation with hardware engineers.

• Create and execute unit, module, integration, protocol, timing, fault-injection, regression, and system-integration tests for assigned features.

• Reproduce defects, collect logs and measurements, identify root cause, implement corrections, and verify that changes do not disturb existing behaviour.

• Use embedded IDEs, compilers, debuggers, JTAG or SWD probes, oscilloscopes, logic analysers, serial terminals, and protocol tools during implementation and debugging.

• Maintain requirements traceability, design notes, code-review records, test results, defect status, and release documentation for completed work.

**Product Lifecycle Compliance and Release Support**

• Implement firmware changes required by alternate components, hardware revisions, calibration updates, performance improvements, and cost-down initiatives.

• Support controlled test firmware and operating modes for transient, EMC, UL, FM, FCC, and other applicable compliance or certification testing.

• Prepare reproducible builds, binaries, maps, checksums, release notes, and configuration records and support production programming, ICT or FCT, pilot builds, and phase-in.

• Assist with production and field issue investigation and document corrective actions and regression evidence.

**Team Collaboration**

• Work with firmware, hardware, validation, compliance, manufacturing, product, and Client's US stakeholders to complete assigned work.

• Participate in design and code reviews, raise unclear requirements and technical risks early, and close assigned actions with objective evidence.

• Contribute reusable drivers, diagnostic utilities, test tools, documentation, and lessons learned for future development work.

**Qualifications**

• 3-7 years of hands-on embedded firmware-development experience, including coding, hardware integration, debugging, testing, and controlled release support.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Telecommunication, Computer Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a related discipline.

• Strong Embedded C fundamentals and practical experience with microcontrollers, interrupts, timers, GPIO, ADC, serial communications, watchdogs, and non-volatile memory.

• Experience with bare-metal or RTOS-based embedded systems, modular drivers, state machines, error handling, and resource-constrained products.

• Ability to read schematics, datasheets, interface specifications, existing source code, system requirements, and test procedures and convert them into working firmware.

• Hands-on experience with embedded IDEs, compilers, debuggers, JTAG or SWD, common laboratory tools, version control, and defect tracking.

• A disciplined approach to coding, peer review, test evidence, root-cause analysis, regression testing, configuration management, and documentation.

**Preferred Experience**

• Prior experience with fire alarm, fire and life-safety, emergency communication, building-automation, or another regulated embedded product is strongly preferred.

• Participation in UL and FCC compliance or certification programs is strongly preferred; exposure to UL 864 or FM Approvals is an advantage.

• Experience with Renesas or similar microcontrollers, IAR or comparable toolchains, processor migration, or legacy-code modernisation is preferred.

• Exposure to fire-alarm communication loops, notification circuits, RS-485 or proprietary protocols, supervised I/O, annunciation, relay control, or networked power products is advantageous.

**Core Competencies**

Ownership Mindset | Embedded C | Firmware Implementation | MCU Peripherals | Hardware Debugging | Test Discipline | Product Lifecycle | Root-Cause Analysis | Documentation | Collaboration

* Alerting on any issue which could impact the launch (ie: logistics, mis-handling, assembly recommendations not
* respected)

* Stepping up the implementation of Quality improvement modifications (reminders, follow-up).
* Facilitating communication between contacts at the Automaker site and the Valeo site during new product testing.

* request from Customer or GRE ).

**1.6. Help make products easier to assemble and ensure that they are used properly by:**

* customer.

****1.7 Participate In Measuring Quality By:****

* changes.
* Knowing customer contacts who process and consolidate Quality data in IT systems, so as to help Valeo sites ensure

title: SAP CPI-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Technology Consulting – SAP CPI PI Senior:**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We’re looking for Senior with expertise in SAP CPI Implementation to join the EYD GDS Integration practice. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Gathers specifications from the business and functional departments and deliver the solution that meets the needs presented
* Interprets business and functional requirements and develops technical specifications documentation
* Must be able to work on custom integration as well as standard integration packages
* Must have knowledge of SAP Cloud Connector and CPI cockpit
* Should have worked on Java and Groovy scripting
* Must be aware of SAP CPI support activities
* Must be able to perform root cause analysis of any re-occurring or critical issues and proposing solutions for them
* Performs Unit, System and Integration testing at the various phases of the project lifecycle and document the results of the testing process

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Experience with business process orchestration products like Cloud Platform Integration (CPI), Dell Boomi, SAP Process Integration (PI) / Process Orchestration (PO).
* Experience to deliver projects for customers, including requirement gathering, analysis of system landscape, technical design, and development of interface.
* Experience to build Integration Strategy for customers having on premise and cloud application systems (SuccessFactors, S4HANA, Ariba etc) with an expertise on data architecture, governance and pre-packaged cloud integration.
* Exposure to various business scenarios (A2A and B2B) and experience in working on all major adapters like SFTP, SOAP, REST, IDOC, ODATA, JDBC, SuccessFactors etc.
* Clarity of security concepts - SSL and PGP encryptions etc.
* Prefer to have experience in Groovy scripts.

**Responsibilities, Qualifications, Certifications**
**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* College degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.) or comparable job experiences
* Approximately 3-7 years of experience in a development role. Able to exhibit a progression of increasingly complex job responsibilities during the period
* SAP certification is a plus

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Should have understanding and experience of integration best practices
* Excellent business communication skills
* Excellent leadership skills

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Integration practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.

title: IQC/IQA Associate Engineer
description:
**Job Purpose**
Responsible for performing incoming material inspection activities as per approved sampling plans in SAP, customer
  
  
requirements, and Jabil IQC procedures. Ensure only conforming materials are released for production through e􀆯ective
  
  
inspection, documentation, material handling, defect reporting, and timely closure of quality issues.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Incoming Inspection
  
  
 Perform incoming inspection of raw materials, electronic components, SMT-related materials, mechanical
  
  
parts, and assemblies as per SAP sampling plans and customer requirements.
  
  
 Verify material conformity against drawings, specifications, approved samples, quality plans, and customer
  
  
documentation.
  
  
 Ensure inspection activities are conducted in accordance with Jabil IQC procedures and applicable quality
  
  
standards.
  
  
 Identify Critical-to-Quality (CTQ) characteristics and perform inspections as per defined requirements.
  
  
SAP & Quality Documentation
  
  
 Execute inspection lots and record inspection results in SAP accurately and timely.
  
  
 Perform Usage Decision (UD) in SAP based on inspection outcomes.
  
  
 Create and maintain e-IQA inspection records and quality documentation.
  
  
 Ensure traceability and retention of inspection records in line with company procedures.
  
  
Defect Management
  
  
 Raise SAP Quality Notifications (QN) for all detected non-conformities during incoming inspection.
  
  
 Clearly document defect details, quantity a􀆯ected, evidence, and disposition requirements.
  
  
 Coordinate with Buyers, SQE/IQA Engineers, and relevant stakeholders for issue resolution.
  
  
 Verify e􀆯ectiveness of corrective actions implemented by suppliers or internal teams.
  
  
 Ensure timely verification and closure of Quality Notifications.
  
  
Material Handling & Disposition
  
  
 Segregate, identify, and control non-conforming materials.
  
  
 Ensure proper stamping, labeling, and material status identification.
  
  
 Support material movement and disposition processes in coordination with Stores and Procurement teams.
  
  
 Prevent unintended use of non-conforming materials on the production floor.
  
  
Compliance & Continuous Improvement
  
  
 Adhere to EHS, quality, and customer-specific requirements.
  
  
 Participate in quality improvement initiatives and problem-solving activities.
  
  
 Support audits and provide inspection-related records when required.
  
  
 Maintain good housekeeping and 5S practices within the inspection area.
  
  
Qualification
  
  
 ITI / Diploma in Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, or related discipline.
  
  
**Experience**
 2-6 years of experience in Incoming Quality Inspection, IQA, IQC, or Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS)
  
  
environment.
  
  
 Experience in inspection of:
  
  

* SMT components
* Electronic components
* Mechanical parts
* Sheet metal, plastic, and electromechanical assemblies

** Experience In SAP-based Incoming Inspection Processes Preferred.**
Technical Competencies
  
  
 Knowledge of IQCprocesses, procedures and incoming inspection requirements.
  
  
 Understanding of electronic components, SMT processes, and mechanical part inspection.
  
  
 Ability to read engineering drawings and identify CTQ characteristics.
  
  
 Knowledge of inspection methodologies, sampling plans, and acceptance criteria.
  
  
 Familiarity with quality tools such as:
  
  

* AQL Sampling
* 7 QC Tools
* 5 Why Analysis
* Basic Problem Solving Techniques

 Hands-on experience with measuring instruments such as:
  
  

* Vernier Caliper
* Micrometer
* Height Gauge
* Multimeter
* Basic Electronic Test Equipment

PC Skills
  
  
 Proficient in MS O􀆯ice (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook).
  
  
 Experience working with SAP ERP, especially Quality Management (QM) module.
  
  
 Ability to update electronic inspection records and generate quality reports.
  
  
 Good data entry accuracy and documentation skills.
  
  
 Knowledge of Excel functions, data analysis, and report preparation.
  
  
Behavioral Competencies
  
  
 Attention to detail.
  
  
 Strong analytical and observation skills.
  
  
 Effective communication and coordination skills.
  
  
 Problem-solving mindset.
  
  
 Ability to work independently and as part of a cross-functional team.
  
  
 High level of integrity and ownership.
  
  
**Preferred Requirements**
 Experience in EMS/Automotive/Electronics manufacturing environment.
  
  
 Knowledge of IPC standards and component identification.
  
  
 Exposure to customer-specific quality requirements and supplier quality processes.

Jabil does not request payments for interviews or at any other point during the hiring process. Jabil will not ask for your personal identifying information such as a social security number, birth certificate, financial institution, driver’s license number or passport information over the phone or via e-mail. * Quality-focused approach

Arista Networks is seeking high-caliber self-motivated test engineers for its enterprise and cloud-managed WiFi products. This role will involve testing and validating complex cloud infrastructure and services that power WiFi networks, ensuring they perform at scale and meet the highest standards of reliability, security, and efficiency. You will play a key role in the design, development, and execution of comprehensive test plans for cloud-based Wi-Fi solutions, working closely with cross-functional teams to deliver industry-leading products.

**What You’ll Do**

* Lead the testing efforts on the cloud infrastructure that supports Wi-Fi networks, ensuring scalability, performance, and resilience in different environments (Cloud and On-premise deployments)
* Design and execute performance, scalability, and load tests to ensure the cloud services can handle heavy traffic and provide reliable WiFi services under various conditions.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to conduct integration tests for cloud-based services that interface with hardware. Ensure seamless interactions between cloud APIs and the Access Points.
* Create solution based detailed test plans, test cases, and test reports for all stages of the development lifecycle. Ensure traceability between requirements, test cases, and defects.
* “Own” the feature and core area of the product, and be the single point of contact and testing expert for your deliverables.
* Track defects and issues using defect management systems, ensuring they are escalated appropriately and resolved in a timely manner.
* Work closely with product managers, developers, and other stakeholders to understand requirements, provide feedback, and ensure high-quality product delivery.
* Participate in escalations debugging and reproduce the complex issues reported by customers.
* Mentor junior team members and share best practices in testing and cloud-based WiFi solution validation.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in E&TC/EE/CE/CS/IT or a related field; Master’s degree a plus.
* 10 - 15 years of experience in testing & troubleshooting Cloud technologies, virtualization, Microservices, and debugging complex software
* Good experience in working with Hadoop & Big data technologies like HDFS, HBase, Spark, Kafka streaming, and Elasticsearch
* Good working knowledge of Database (SQL) and Server side validations.
* Experience with various performance testing methods (Load test, Stress test, and capacity test) will be a plus.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems fundamentals around scalability, elasticity, availability, and fault tolerance.
* Experience in Networking Tools and networking fundamentals across the OSI stack is a plus.
* Strong analytical and debugging skills and proven expertise in creating test methodologies and writing test plans.
* Strong knowledge of Linux systems.
* Familiarity with scripting languages such as Python will be a plus.
* Excellent written and oral English communication skills.
* Adaptive to learning new things and technologies

title: Solution Engineer - Quality, Laboratory & OT Systems
description:
**Description**
At Envalior, we combine over a century of materials expertise with innovation and digital technology to help create sustainable, high-performance solutions for our customers around the world. As our laboratories, manufacturing sites, and quality organizations become increasingly digital, we are looking for a Solution Engineer who can help bridge business processes and technology across Quality, Research & Technology (R&T), and Operational Technology (OT) domains.
  
  
This role offers a unique opportunity to become a key technology partner for our global laboratory and quality functions, helping ensure that critical systems are reliable, compliant, efficient, and aligned with Envalior's business ambitions.
  
  
**The Role**
As a
**Solution Engineer – Quality, Laboratory & OT Systems**
, you will act as the subject matter expert and trusted advisor for a portfolio of laboratory, quality, and manufacturing applications, with a primary focus on
**Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS)**
.
  
  
LIMS applications sit at the heart of Envalior's quality and laboratory operations. They support the management of laboratory samples, testing workflows, quality data, product specifications, and batch release activities across manufacturing and R&D environments. As the system owner and technical lead, you will ensure these platforms continue to deliver business value while supporting operational excellence and continuous improvement.
  
  
You will work closely with Quality, R&T, Operations, Manufacturing, Digital Solutions Delivery, and Technology Services teams worldwide to support existing solutions while identifying opportunities for innovation, automation, and simplification.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Own and Support Critical Laboratory & Quality Systems**

* Serve as the IT System Owner for Envalior's LIMS QA solutions.
* Manage the lifecycle of laboratory and quality applications, including enhancements, upgrades, integrations, and support activities.
* Ensure platforms remain secure, stable, and aligned with evolving business requirements.
* Act as the primary escalation point for complex application and process issues.
* Support business continuity across laboratory and quality operations globally.

**Partner with the Business**

* Develop a deep understanding of Quality, R&T, and Operational Technology processes.
* Collaborate with laboratory managers, quality teams, manufacturing stakeholders, and digital colleagues to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Translate business challenges into scalable digital solutions.
* Build strong relationships with stakeholders and effectively communicate the value of technology-enabled change.

**Drive Innovation and Digital Transformation**

* Propose innovative information solutions by combining existing systems with emerging digital technologies.
* Evaluate opportunities to improve laboratory efficiency, data management, automation, and operational performance.
* Simplify and modernize existing application landscapes.
* Eliminate waste, reduce complexity, and improve user experience through technology and process optimization.

**Enable Reliable Laboratory Operations**

* Support systems used for sample management, laboratory workflows, testing activities, and quality data management.
* Ensure effective system integrations between laboratory, manufacturing, and enterprise platforms.
* Help maintain accurate, timely, and accessible laboratory information across the value chain.
* Support the digital backbone that enables quality decision-making and product release activities.

**Lead Continuous Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to strengthen system performance and business processes.
* Promote best practices in application management, information architecture, and digital solutions.
* Support change management initiatives and user adoption activities.
* Drive a culture of operational excellence and continuous improvement across supported domains.

**Requirements**
**Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, Chemistry, Materials Science, or a related discipline.

**Experience**

* Experience in application management, solution engineering, business analysis, or related digital roles.
* Experience supporting Quality, Manufacturing, Laboratory, R&T, or Operational Technology environments.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Experience working within global and cross-functional organizations.
* Demonstrated ability to lead change and drive continuous improvement initiatives.

**Preferred Technical Expertise -**
**Laboratory & Quality Systems**

* ZhuoMES
* GUSLAB / LABSQ
* Unilab
* Thermo Fisher SampleManager LIMS
* WinLIMS

**OT & Manufacturing Solutions**

* Eschbach Shiftconnector
* AssetWise

**Sustainability & Quality Platforms**

* Credit360
* Other Quality, OT, and R&T SaaS applications

**Additional Capabilities**

* Information architecture (data, process, and application landscape)
* Application lifecycle management
* Systems integration and interfacing
* Change management
* Technical project delivery
* Analytical problem solving
* Operations, Quality, and R&T process knowledge

**What Success Looks Like**
In this role, you will become the trusted digital partner for Envalior's Quality and Laboratory community. You will ensure our LIMS landscape delivers reliable support to laboratories worldwide while helping the business embrace new technologies and more efficient ways of working.
  
  
**You Will Be Successful If You Can**

* Balance technology expertise with business understanding.
* Influence stakeholders through collaboration and credibility.
* Simplify complex challenges into practical solutions.
* Drive operational efficiency through digital innovation.
* Continuously improve the applications and processes that support Envalior's quality and laboratory operations.

**Benefits**
**Competitive Compensation**
Join us at Envalior and enjoy competitive compensation packages, inclusive of a global bonus program and individual performance bonuses, ensuring your hard work is recognized and rewarded.
  
  
**Comprehensive Benefits**
Your well-being matters to us. At Envalior, we provide an array of benefits supporting your financial security, health, and overall well-being. This includes retirement plans, health programs, life insurance, and comprehensive medical care.
  
  
**Work-Life Balance & Flexibility**
Maintain a healthy balance between work and personal life with Envalior's commitment to supporting your schedule.
  
  
**Training & Development Opportunities**
At Envalior, your growth matters. We encourage and invest in your professional and personal development. We support our employees in their growth and personal development through ongoing investment in their knowledge and skills via training, coaching, and mentoring.
  
  
**Diversity & Inclusion**
At Envalior, our people drive our success, so it’s only right that we provide a diverse and inclusive working environment and foster a culture of belonging, openness, and respect. We value diversity as a cornerstone of our success. We are committed to nurturing and empowering every individual to reach their full potential.
  
  
**APPLY NOW!**
Ready to pioneer change with Envalior? Join us in our mission to drive innovation, sustainability, and excellence. Apply today and become a part of our transformative journey towards a more sustainable future.
  
  
Submit your application online by sending your CV and motivation letter in English through our career portal. If you have any questions, feel free to connect directly with our recruiter at Deepanshu.Tripathi@envalior.com
  
  
*Envalior is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.*
If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at Talent.Acquisition@Envalior.com.
  
  
**OUR HERITAGE**
With a combined heritage of over 100 years, Envalior brings together two established global materials players: DSM Engineering Materials and LANXESS High Performance Materials. Our unique combined portfolio of longstanding material-, application-, and design expertise enables our customers to develop and launch sustainable future-proof designs. Envalior is the brand new materials powerhouse that was Launched in early 2023.
  
  
We aim to be a global leader in sustainable and high-performance engineering materials. We imagine the future by shaping the world of today and tomorrow. We’re conscious that this is both a privilege and a responsibility – so, when we imagine the future, we’re guided by our key values to help us create a better world.

title: Senior Analyst, Data Management, IT
description:
**Job Description**
Edwards Lifesciences is expanding its global technology capabilities with the launch of a new IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India. The Hub strengthens the technology foundation that supports our business worldwide, working in close partnership with teams across regions to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions at scale.
  
  
Designed as a long-term investment, the Pune Hub will advance newer digital capabilities such as automation, data, AI, and cloud, and will include roles spanning end user services, application development, and enterprise platform teams.
  
  
As part of our IT team, your expertise will help Edwards strengthen trusted, governed, and high-quality master data across the enterprise. We are seeking a Senior Analyst, Data Management to support critical master data domains, including Healthcare Professional and Supplier Master, while helping modernize Edwards' Master Data Management capabilities from Informatica IDMC MDM SaaS toward a multi-domain Semarchy MDM platform on Snowflake. This role combines data stewardship, governance, data quality, business analysis, and operational support with direct partnership across global and regional business teams.
  
  
**How You Will Make An Impact**

* Participate in the implementation and expansion of Semarchy MDM as a Snowflake-based, multi-domain enterprise Master Data Management platform.
* Support the onboarding of new master data domains and contribute to migration planning, business validation, testing, and user adoption as domains transition from Informatica IDMC MDM SaaS to the future-state platform.
* Partner with MDM leadership, architects, engineers, data stewards, application teams, and business stakeholders to define scalable master data processes, governance models, stewardship workflows, and platform requirements.
* Support Healthcare Professional and Supplier Master domains operating on Informatica IDMC MDM SaaS, including application enhancements, release validation, testing, and production support.
* Investigate and resolve master data issues, data quality exceptions, match and merge conflicts, hierarchy requests, workflow issues, and data synchronization problems across upstream and downstream applications.
* Engage directly with regional business teams to understand business processes, data challenges, and master data requirements across multiple geographies and time zones.
* Elicit, document, validate, and translate business requirements into scalable data management and MDM solutions that business and technical teams can execute.
* Define, document, and maintain business rules, data standards, critical data elements, data definitions, stewardship procedures, and data quality controls.
* Perform data profiling, analysis, root cause investigation, and remediation activities using SQL, Snowflake, and related data tools.
* Develop and monitor data quality metrics, dashboards, and governance scorecards that improve data accuracy, consistency, completeness, and accountability.
* Create and maintain process documentation, standard operating procedures, governance artifacts, test evidence, and user guidance.
* Identify and implement opportunities to improve business processes, data quality, operational efficiency, and the user experience.

**What You Will Need (Required)**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Management, Business, Engineering, or a related field and a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in master data management, data governance, data quality, business analysis, or enterprise data operations.
* Practical experience supporting Master Data Management solutions, data stewardship processes, or governed enterprise data domains.
* Experience eliciting, documenting, and validating business requirements and translating them into functional data or application requirements.
* Experience with data profiling, root cause analysis, issue remediation, business rules, data standards, and data quality controls.
* Working proficiency in SQL and experience analyzing data in Snowflake or a comparable cloud data platform.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate complex data issues across connected systems and processes.
* Excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to facilitate discussions across business and technical teams.
* Ability to work independently under general direction, manage competing priorities, and collaborate effectively across global time zones.
* Adhere to all company rules and requirements, including Environmental Health & Safety rules, and take adequate control measures to prevent injuries, protect the environment, and prevent pollution under their span of influence or control.

**What Else We Look For (Preferred)**

* Hands-on experience with Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud MDM SaaS, Semarchy MDM, or another enterprise multi-domain MDM platform.
* Experience with Healthcare Professional, Supplier, Customer, Product, or other enterprise master data domains.
* Experience supporting an MDM modernization or migration program, including business validation, testing, cutover readiness, and user adoption.
* Experience with Snowflake-based data solutions and integrations among MDM, source applications, and downstream consumers.
* Experience developing data quality dashboards, governance scorecards, stewardship workflows, or operating procedures.
* Relevant industry experience in medical device, pharmaceuticals, healthcare, or another regulated environment.

**Additional Information**

* Develops solutions to a variety of complex data management problems and exercises judgment in selecting methods and techniques after considering business, data quality, governance, and technical implications.
* Works with general direction focused on end results and may provide guidance to less-experienced team members or data stewards.
* Travel may be required up to 5%.

**Benefits And Equal Opportunity**
Aligning our overall business objectives with performance, we offer competitive salaries, performance-based incentives, and a wide variety of benefits programs to address the diverse individual needs of our employees and their families.

title: Medical Coding Audit Manager
description:
Manages the day-to-day operations of the Medical Coding Evaluation team supporting Veradigm's enterprise coding capability. The team reviews the outputs of AI agents against clinical documentation to confirm that codes are supported, billable, and accurate, and its judgments establish the clinical ground truth used to measure how our AI agents perform.
  
  
Owns the scoring guide that defines how agent output is judged, incorporating input from the reviewers who apply it. Adjudicates disagreements between reviewers, measures and reports inter-reviewer agreement, and defines the clinical metrics reported to customers, so that accuracy claims made commercially and under federal transparency requirements are defensible. Builds and develops a distributed team of certified coders, plans capacity across specialties, and extends the team's scope across coding, chart preparation, and clinical note quality as the AI roadmap expands.
  
  
**Essential Functions / Major Job Responsibilities**

* Develops and maintains the scoring guide with clinical experts, updating it as specialties and agent behaviors expand.
* Manages daily operations for the review team, including assignments, priorities, capacity, and throughput.
* Adjudicates dual-review disputes, documenting rationale and identifying reviewer error versus guide ambiguity.
* Tracks inter-reviewer agreement, using low agreement to refine guidance rather than penalize staff.
* Runs calibration rounds across reviewers to set throughput benchmarks and validate scaling readiness.
* Reports clinical metrics, accuracy, claims inclusion, and risk impact, to leadership, product teams, and clients.
* Plans specialty coverage, starting with internal medicine and expanding as scope broadens.
* Expands scope into chart prep and note quality, establishing evaluation criteria for subjective tasks.
* Validates automated scoring through sampling and reports divergences between automated and expert review.
* Coordinates design-partner evaluations to maintain consistent review standards across teams.
* Enforces approved data access boundaries, authorized data tiers, and compliant review tools.

**Job Requirements**

* Bachelor's Degree in Health Information Management, Healthcare Administration, or equivalent technical or business experience
* 8+ years relevant work experience; 2-3 years at the Expert level or equivalent experience - Preferred
* 4 Years ICD-10-CM, CPT, and HCPCS coding across multiple specialties, with strong attention to detail and a high accuracy rate
* 2 Years coding auditing or coding quality review
* 2 Years outpatient or ambulatory coding in a multi-specialty or large group practice setting
* 1 Year developing coding guidelines, audit criteria, or annotation standards that others apply
* 1 Year reviewing output from automated or computer-assisted coding tools, or other structured annotation work
* Medicare Risk Adjustment or HCC coding experience - preferred
* 2-4 years relevant leadership experience, including leading distributed or remote teams - preferred

Certifications
  
  

* CPC, CCS, or CCS-P - AAPC or AHIMA coding certification, active -Required
* CPMA - Certified Professional Medical Auditor - Preferred
* CRC - Certified Risk Adjustment Coder - Preferred

**Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**

* Expert-level knowledge of medical coding, including ICD-10-CM, CPT, HCPCS Level II, modifier application, E/M documentation guidelines, and CMS claims processing rules.
* Ability to write clear, unambiguous evaluation criteria that multiple reviewers can apply to reach the same conclusion on the same record.
* Working understanding of measurement concepts relevant to human review, including inter-rater agreement, sampling, and the difference between reviewer error and ambiguous guidance.
* Ability to explain coding reasoning to engineers and product managers who have no coding background, and to translate their technical questions into coding terms.
* Sound judgment in cases where documentation is incomplete or coding guidance does not clearly apply, and the discipline to distinguish confident conclusions from uncertain ones.
* Proven ability to lead others, including where the next-level leader is not in the same location or time zone.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision in an environment where standards and processes are still being established.
* Working knowledge of HIPAA privacy and security requirements as they apply to handling clinical information and de-identified data.

**Working Arrangements**

* Standard work week or as defined by assignment requirements.
* Primarily works in a standard office environment or remotely.
* Requires periodic overlap with United States time zones to collaborate with Applied Intelligence, product, and engineering teams.

**Travel**

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.
  
  
Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
  
  
Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
  
  
Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.
  
  
Preventative and Predictive Maintenance - Interprets machine and tool maintenance records and data to develop and execute preventative and predictive management strategies to drive continuous improvement within the manufacturing process.
  
  
Problem Solving - Solves problems and may mentor others on effective problem solving by using a systematic analysis process by leveraging industry standard methodologies to create problem traceability and protect the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; identifies the systemic root causes and ensures actions to prevent problem reoccurrence are implemented.

**Company Description**
EZ Informatics Solutions Pvt Ltd is a technology-focused company that specializes in delivering high-quality software solutions and IT services to global clients. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience; prior experience in performance testing or QA engineering is highly beneficial.

title: Chrom S/W Support Specialist
description:
The Chrom S/W Support Specialist evaluates business opportunities to define and optimize the product portfolio through analysis and understanding of targeted markets, market trends, new technology, customer business issues and the competitive environment. Applies broad knowledge of company product capabilities and service offerings with in-depth analysis of market position to create and expand the portfolio of products and solution alternatives. Works closely with product development to create products and validates early product definitions with customers. Uses technical expertise and extensive industry experience to formulate product strategies and identify new product opportunities. Responsible for developing project plans designed to address customer needs and/or expand market share.
  
  

* Define and manage the end-end hardware driver development, testing, and release for leading chromatography software platforms for Perkinelmer chromatography products such as GC, GCMS, LC and LCMS initiatives, ensuring that features are well-defined, prioritized, and aligned with the overall product vision and strategy. This will be the major focus of the role.
* Track and manage successful deployment of these drivers to be up to date and validated with current versions available from vendors as they are released.
* Track success metrics such as adoption, value realization, business outcomes, license, royalty payments and inventory of products sold quarterly or annually
* Own end-end development process from scoping requirements, development of compatible drivers, user testing, validation reports, part number creating and updating revisions, release notes and commercial announcements.
* Collaborate with software programmers, project managers, engineers, UX designers, and business stakeholders to translate high-level requirements into actionable user stories.
* Work closely with Agile development teams to guide sprint planning, backlog grooming, and ensure timely delivery of high-quality software solutions.
* Address customer issues post release working with technical support to provide resolution or feedback to R&D and mitigate risks and customer dissatisfaction.
* Additional software development support for main software chromatography platform and assisting data analytics and story points by working closely with the Software Product Manager to assist in such activities as the business needs.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Analytical Chemistry, Software Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or a related role in software development, scientific computing, or with software products supporting chromatography technology with experience in GC, GCMS, LC and LCMS software solutions.
* Ability to interpret complex scientific workflows and translate them into user-friendly software features that R&D can execute.
* Experience with JIRA, PDM, SAP, Confluence, or similar Agile tools including the ability to use these tools to report out on team progress toward goals on a regular cadence is highly expected
* Experience with software lifecycle management, sustaining activities, PDM, URS and tracking software fixes to meet deadlines.
* Strong understanding of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and hands-on experience managing software development backlogs.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* User experience with Gas Chromatography, Liquid Chromatography and mass spectrometry technology; working with scientific or laboratory software applications with this technology (e.g., LIMS, ELN, data analysis tools).
* User level experience in leading chromatography software platforms in a lab setting is high desirable
* Previous experience working in a cross-functional R&D environment with researchers and scientists.
* Technical knowledge of software architectures, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure), and DevOps practices.
* Understanding of compliance requirements for regulated software (ISO, FDA, HIPAA, GDPR).

title: SW QA Engineer Associate - Simcenter X (AltairOne Apps)
description:
**We are Siemens**
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software.
  
  
Siemens Digital Industries Software is looking for a Software QA Engineer to join our Engineering Intelligence team and help ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of cloud-delivered engineering applications used by global manufacturers.
  
  
You will work with quality engineers, developers, product owners, and engineering domain experts to define and execute end-to-end workflows across SaaS, OnPrem, and High Performance Computing (HPC) environments. The role combines software quality engineering with engineering simulation workflows, cloud technologies, automation, and complex distributed systems.
  
  
You will play a key role in ensuring that our applications not only function correctly, but also deliver reliable and credible engineering results.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and execute comprehensive testing: Plan and perform functional, integration, system, exploratory, end-to-end, and performance testing for complex engineering and cloud-delivered applications.
* Validate engineering workflows: Test simulation-driven workflows from model setup and execution through solver behavior and result validation, ensuring both functional correctness and engineering credibility.
* Build test automation: Develop, maintain, and enhance automated test suites using modern frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or similar technologies to improve regression coverage and release efficiency.
* Test cloud and distributed applications: Validate web-based and cloud-native applications across microservices, event-driven architectures, and distributed environments.
* Analyze and troubleshoot quality issues: Investigate failures, defects, performance bottlenecks, and unexpected behaviors; perform root-cause analysis and verify fixes.
* Work with CI/CD and engineering infrastructure: Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and troubleshoot test environments across Windows, Linux, containers, and Kubernetes-based environments.
* Drive quality across the product lifecycle: Collaborate with developers, architects, product owners, and domain experts to define acceptance criteria, identify quality risks, and continuously improve test strategy and coverage.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* + years of hands-on software QA/testing experience involving technically complex software, with strong experience in test planning, execution, defect analysis, and validation.
* Strong experience with web/UI test automation using Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or similar frameworks.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, or equivalent.
* Working knowledge of Windows and Linux/Unix environments, with strong debugging and troubleshooting skills.
* Understanding of microservices, event-driven architectures, and distributed applications, with exposure to troubleshooting Kubernetes-based environments.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, debugging, and communication skills, with the ability to work independently and collaborate effectively in Agile teams.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience with engineering simulation, CAE, CAD, or other scientific/technical software, including understanding of simulation workflows beyond basic tool operation.
* Strong understanding of simulation concepts such as meshing, physics modeling, solver configuration, convergence, numerical stability, and result validation.
* Experience with API testing using tools such as Postman and performance testing using JMeter, Gatling, or similar.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP and testing applications deployed in cloud environments.
* Experience with Docker and Kubernetes, including debugging applications and test environments in containerized environments.
* Experience testing HPC environments, including Linux clusters, MPI-based workloads, and job schedulers such as Slurm or PBS.
* Experience with performance, scalability, reliability, or security testing of distributed or cloud-based applications.

**Why Us**
At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work - hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
  
  
**Diversity & Inclusion**
We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities. At Siemens, we believe people who've had real experiences dealing with being different will excel as leaders. Let's foster a culture of creativity and innovation. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

title: Software Test Engineer
description:
**Entity**
Technology
  
  
**Job Family Group**
Research & Technology Group
  
  
**Job Description**
**Who we are**
**About Bp/team**
bp technology is the central organization for all software and platform development. We build all the technology that powers bp’s businesses, from upstream energy production to downstream energy delivery to our customers. We have a variety of teams depending on your areas of interest, including infrastructure and backend services through to customer-facing web and native applications. We encourage our teams to adapt quickly by using native AWS and Azure services, including serverless, and enable them to pick the best technology for a given problem. This is meant to empower our software and platform engineers while allowing them to learn and develop themselves.
  
  
Role Purpose
  
  
The Software Test Engineer is responsible for assuring the quality, reliability and usability of digital platforms and services supporting the Corporate Affairs portfolio. The role combines hands-on manual testing with test automation to validate that new features, integrations, fixes and releases meet business, user, technical and operational requirements.
  
  
Working closely with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Technical Delivery Leads, Software Engineers, suppliers and business stakeholders, the role embeds quality throughout the delivery lifecycle. It plans and implements functional and non-functional testing, builds reusable automated tests, manages defects and provides clear evidence to support release decisions and continuous improvement.
  
  
Scope & Scale
  
  
**Platform focus**
Supports Corporate Affairs digital platforms and services, including DCP, Brand Portal, global web, content, campaign, analytics, integrations and operational support capabilities.
  
  
**Testing coverage**
Covers manual and automated functional, integration, regression, API, end-to-end, smoke, exploratory and release testing.
  
  
**Non-functional quality**
Supports accessibility, usability, cross-browser, responsive, performance, security and operational-readiness validation.
  
  
**Delivery lifecycle**
Contributes from discovery and requirements refinement through build, test, release, production verification and post-release improvement.
  
  
**Quality engineering**
Builds reusable automation, quality gates, test evidence, defect insight and risk-based recommendations that improve release confidence.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Test Strategy, Planning & Analysis
  
  

* Contribute to test strategies and create proportionate test plans based on scope, quality risks, dependencies and release objectives.
* Review requirements, user stories, designs and acceptance criteria to identify gaps, ambiguity, testability concerns and required coverage.
* Define test scenarios, test cases, test data, environment needs, entry and exit criteria and traceability to requirements.
* Apply risk-based testing to focus effort on business-critical journeys, integrations and operational risks.
* Provide clear test estimates, progress reporting, quality metrics and evidence for delivery governance and release decisions.

Manual & Exploratory Testing
  
  

* Implement manual functional, integration, system, regression, smoke, exploratory and end-to-end testing across digital products and services.
* Validate user journeys, content workflows, business rules, integrations, permissions, data handling and error scenarios.
* Test responsive behaviour, usability, cross-browser compatibility and accessibility against agreed standards.
* Work with business users and Business Analysts to support UAT, capture evidence and confirm acceptance outcomes.
* Perform production verification and support early-life testing following releases.

Test Automation & Continuous Testing
  
  

* Design, build and maintain reliable automated tests for UI, API, integration, regression and end-to-end scenarios.
* Develop reusable test libraries, page objects, fixtures, utilities and test data aligned to sound software engineering principles.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and establish quality checks that provide rapid, repeatable feedback.
* Select appropriate candidates for automation, balancing business value, stability, maintenance effort and execution speed.
* Monitor automation reliability, investigate failures and continuously improve coverage, execution time and maintainability.

Defect Management & Quality Insight
  
  

* Log clear, reproducible defects with evidence, business impact, severity and appropriate diagnostic information.
* Work with engineers and suppliers to triage defects, investigate root causes, validate fixes and prevent recurrence.
* Maintain transparent defect status, highlight release risks and escalate unresolved quality concerns with options.
* Analyse defect patterns, escaped defects, automation results and quality trends to identify improvement opportunities.
* Contribute to retrospectives and root-cause reviews, turning lessons into stronger requirements, engineering and test practices.

Collaboration & Quality Culture
  
  

* Collaborate with product, analysis, design, development, operations, security, privacy and supplier teams throughout delivery.
* Champion shift-left testing by engaging early in discovery, refinement and technical design discussions.
* Promote shared ownership of quality and support engineers in improving unit, component and integration testing.
* Maintain test documentation, evidence, dashboards and reusable knowledge assets.
* Share testing practices and support continuous improvement across bp and supplier delivery teams.

**Skills & Experience**

* Experience testing digital products, web platforms, CMS solutions, APIs, integrations or cloud-based services using both manual and automated approaches.
* Solid understanding of test design techniques, exploratory testing, regression testing, defect management and requirements traceability.
* Hands-on experience developing and maintaining UI and API automation using tools such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, Postman or equivalent.
* Coding or scripting experience in TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, Python or a comparable language, with Git-based version control.
* Experience integrating automated testing into Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions or comparable CI/CD platforms.
* Understanding of accessibility, responsive, cross-browser, performance, security and operational-readiness testing.
* Experience working in Agile teams and collaborating with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Engineers and suppliers.
* Strong analytical, communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to provide evidence-based quality recommendations.

Success Measures
  
  

* Clear test coverage and traceability across requirements, business journeys, risks and acceptance criteria.
* Early identification of defects, gaps and release risks, reducing rework and production issues.
* Reliable and maintainable automated regression coverage integrated into delivery pipelines.
* Timely, evidence-based quality reporting that supports informed release decisions.
* Improved platform quality across functionality, accessibility, usability, performance, security and operability.
* Effective defect resolution and measurable reduction in repeated or escaped defects.

Strong collaboration and shared quality ownership across business, product, engineering and supplier
  
  
**About Bp**
Our purpose is to deliver energy to the world, today and tomorrow. For over 100 years, bp has focused on discovering, developing, and producing oil and gas in the nations where we operate. We are one of the few companies globally that can provide governments and customers with an integrated energy offering. Delivering our strategy sustainably is fundamental to achieving our ambition to be a net zero company by 2050 or sooner!

title: Test Strategy & Operations Specialist for User Acceptance Test (UAT)
description:
**About Our Program**
S4E is one of the major Business- & IT Transformation Programs within global Siemens Energy (SE). Its key objective is to transform our historical patchwork of 23 legacy SAP systems into a completely new platform based on the latest state-of-the-art SAP S/4 HANA technology. At the same time, S4E-Unify is aiming for the optimization and harmonization of SE’s worldwide Business Processes across all Business Areas, Regions and Functions. Goal is to significantly reduce complexity, increase speed and flexibility, foster cross-organizational collaboration and finally drive significant cost reductions.The S4E-Unify core team consists of roughly 300 colleagues around the globe plus a substantial extended community of subject matter experts (SME), change network ambassadors and other contributors. It affects 40,000 global users and follows an implementation roadmap through 2030.
  
  
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
As the Test Strategy & Operations Management Specialist for User Acceptance Test (UAT) (f/m/d), you start your day aligning with internal stakeholders and external IT partners to support in the develop the S/4 test factory setup for User Acceptance Testing.
  
  
You oversee the integration of various rollout projects within the S/4 program, ensuring a scalable, efficient, and well-governed operating model. Being part of a global team of IT and Business Transformation experts, you monitor testing activities across rollout projects and ensure transparency regarding progress, risks, and performance.
  
  
You drive stakeholder alignment, analyze key performance metrics, and continuously improve processes through automation and AI-driven solutions. At the end of the day, you consolidate results, prepare performance reports, and propose next steps to strengthen the factory setup
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Contribute to scale the S/4 test factory for the UAT scope, combining internal employees and external IT partners to enable industrialized SAP rollouts.

* Manage the Performance Management on UAT testing scope with clear KPIs and continuous improvement mechanisms for various rollout projects.
* Drive automation and AI-enabled testing approaches for UAT across various rollout projects to increase efficiency and quality.
* Manage risks, dependencies, and service levels for UAT scope across various rollout projects to ensure timely and complete delivery.
* Ensure transparency through structured reporting, governance, and stakeholder alignment

Proven experience in managing IT environments or transformation programs.
  
  

* Good understanding of enterprise IT systems (software, hardware, databases).
* Experience in rollout initiatives (preferably SAP/S/4HANA).
* Knowledge of IT operations, governance, and service management structures.
* Experience to work with external IT partners and related performance frameworks.
* Experience leading cross-functional, international initiatives.
* Business fluent English; German is an advantage

You are responsible for managing all aspects of the User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for the Siemens Energy SAP S/4HANA across multiple rollout projects and contribute to the overall setup of the UAT delivery model. You contribute to the UAT strategy development and take the lead on various aspects of its operational execution. In this role you leverage the setup of the S4E Program with assigned team members across all rollout projects as well as our external IT delivery partner. Your work enables us to scale the testing process to an industrialized level including automation and AI technologies that allow efficient and effective UAT test management for 10+ in-parallel rollout projects.
  
  
You manage various stakeholders related to UAT testing from across our solution factory, data migration factory, change factory to contribute towards our rollout projects and its business stakeholders. You steer the performance of the external IT service delivery partner for the UAT scope and ensure in-time, in-quality, audit proof documented testing as part of the rollout projects.
  
  
**Who is Siemens Energy?**
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
  
  
Our distributed team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
  
  
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion, and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

description:
