Test / Integration Engineer I
  
  
**Job Description**
**Test Integration Engineer I | Pune, India | Full-time**
If you are an experienced testing and integration professional who enjoys leading complex system validation activities and working directly with customers and multidisciplinary engineering teams, this is an opportunity to play a key role in delivering Vanderlande’s advanced automation solutions.
  
  
**Your Role**
As a Test Integration Engineer I, you will provide functional leadership for testing activities across the project lifecycle. You will own the overall testing strategy, coordinate multidisciplinary engineering teams, lead customer test workshops, and ensure the system is ready for successful acceptance.
  
  
You will work closely with Project Leaders, Engineering teams, customers, and other stakeholders to ensure that testing activities are effectively planned, executed, and aligned with project requirements.
  
  
**What You Will Do / Key Responsibilities**
Test Strategy & Project Ownership
  
  

* Own and drive the testing strategy across the project lifecycle.
* Define and manage test approaches, test plans, test readiness criteria, and acceptance criteria.
* Ensure testing activities are aligned with project requirements, system specifications, and customer expectations.
* Lead operational scenario validation to ensure the system performs effectively under realistic operating conditions.
* Approve test readiness and ensure required prerequisites are in place before testing activities commence.
* Lead and coordinate FAT, IHT, SFT, SAT, and other system acceptance activities as applicable.
* Monitor overall testing progress and provide clear reporting to project leadership.

Customer & Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Lead customer test workshops and facilitate technical discussions related to system testing and acceptance.
* Act as the key testing interface between the customer and internal engineering teams.
* Present test results, issues, risks, and mitigation plans to relevant stakeholders.
* Manage expectations and ensure alignment between customer requirements and testing outcomes.
* Participate in engineering discussions, design reviews, and system-level technical meetings.

Multidisciplinary Integration
  
  

* Coordinate testing activities across software, controls, electrical, mechanical, simulation, and other engineering disciplines.
* Drive system integration activities and ensure interfaces between disciplines are properly validated.
* Coordinate resolution of complex cross-disciplinary defects and technical issues.
* Guide Test Integration Engineers and provide functional leadership to the testing team.
* Support and mentor junior engineers and promote consistent testing practices.

Risk Management & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Identify testing-related project risks and support the development of mitigation and contingency plans.
* Drive defect investigations and ensure critical issues are followed through to resolution.
* Identify opportunities to improve testing processes, tools, methodologies, and system validation.
* Promote standardisation and reuse of test procedures and best practices across projects.
* Ensure complete and accurate test documentation and project handover deliverables.

**What You Bring**

* B.E. / B.Tech in Electronics, Instrumentation, Electrical, E&TC, or Computer Engineering.
* 5+ years of relevant experience in system integration, software testing, system testing, or a related engineering environment, with demonstrated experience in a testing or integration lead role.
* Strong understanding of software testing and development life cycles, including V-Model, CMMI, Agile, and test processes.
* Strong hands-on experience with Polarion, Jira, Oracle PL/SQL, and Unix.
* Strong experience in developing and reviewing test strategies, test plans, test cases, integration plans, system designs, and acceptance criteria.
* Proven ability to lead testing activities across multidisciplinary engineering teams.
* Strong customer-facing and stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience in leading defect investigations and technical issue resolution.
* Strong ownership, leadership, and mentoring capabilities.
* Willingness to travel extensively and support customer projects based on business requirements.
* Knowledge of airport baggage handling, material handling, distribution systems, PLC, and SCADA is highly advantageous.
* Previous experience in airport automation or a similar complex automation environment is an advantage.

**About Vanderlande**
Vanderlande makes automated systems that handle baggage at airports and sort parcels in logistics networks around the world. At airports, our technology manages the complete bag journey—from check-in and security screening through to the reclaim belt. In parcel logistics, our systems power the networks that get packages to
  
  
customers’ doors. At Vanderlande, you will find the space to aspire, to grow, and to achieve something that matters, with people who bring out the best in each other.
  
  
**Website**
www.vanderlande.com
  
  
**What We Offer**
Working at Vanderlande comes with the support and space to grow, achieve, and enjoy the journey. Here is what that looks like in practice

* 22 paid leave days
* 8 sick/casual leave days
* Applicable government holidays
* Flexible and hybrid working model that promotes work-life balance
* Access to Vanderlande Academy and a wide range of learning and development programs
* Comprehensive medical insurance coverage, including parental coverage
* Opportunities to participate in diverse Vanderlande communities, networks, and employee initiatives
* Opportunity to collaborate globally with engineering and project teams

**How We Work**
We work by three values Every day better, We care, and Team play. In practice, this means we drive customer success, lead with transparency, celebrate what we achieve together, and do what we say.

Are you interested in this position? Apply directly via our careers page with your CV/Resume.

title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
**The Opportunity**
The Sr.QA Engineer role is responsible for the development and delivery of an automation-first test suite for our ComplianceAlpha products. Each Sr. QA Engineer will be part of a geo-located agile product team, and will provide guidance to the team during planning and refinement as well as execute on the plan during the sprint.
  
  
We are looking for an imaginative self-starter with a passion for great software and a proven track record of developing test automation solutions that drive exceptional quality and productivity. Only motivated problem solvers willing to take the initiative and demonstrate consistent follow-through need apply. Qualified candidates will have extensive experience successfully implementing test automation.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Develop an automation-first testing strategy for functional, performance, and regression testing.
* Architect and develop reusable and scalable multi-layer automation frameworks for UI, API, and database automated test scripts that cover the functional areas of our application suite.
* Guide other test automators embedded in cross-functional development teams, to create scripts and provide faster, scalable, and more comprehensive test coverage.
* Organize and direct team meetings to ensure automation efforts are on track.
* Always be the advocate for automation and quality best practices.
* Review requirements stated in product backlog and assign to each sprint as needed.
* Partner with product, engineering, and IT personnel to align long term solution roadmap with quality assurance efforts.
* Analyze root cause of failing test automation test scripts and fix.
* Lead the collaboration with software developers as needed to identify root cause of product defects and resolve problems.
* Align strategies with organizational goals and report progress to the product owner.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* You must always be curious about the business and customers you support. The more you know and understand your customers and how they work on a daily basis, the better equipped you will be to deliver high quality technology solutions.
* Motivated to deliver the best possible software solutions in a fast-paced collaborative environment.
* Ability to quickly identify and communicate risks.
* Proactively learn and experiment with new technologies and cloud development strategies, staying ahead of the curve.
* Ability to self-manage multiple priorities and understand when to ‘switch gears’ to unblock others.
* Clear and concise written and verbal communication skills.
* Diplomatic with strong negotiation and conflict resolution skills.
* Self-motivator with a strong work ethic, able to perform job duties without significant supervision.
* Comfortable with leveraging approved AI toolsets to help you be more efficient and productive.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Minimum 7 to 9 years of overall test automation experience, at least 3 years using Playwright and Typescript (or Javascript).
* Development experience with C#, Java, or any other Object Oriented Programming language.
* Experience with keyword and data driven test automation.
* Experience implementing APIs (OData, REST, SOAP) and database automated tests.
* Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins / TeamCity, LambdaTest, etc.
* Experience with development tools, such as Visual Studio, Azure DevOps, Junit, and Eclipse.
* Working knowledge of code coverage tools, defect-tracking systems, test case management systems, and performance tools.
* Experience with version control tools such as Git or SVN.

**Ideally, you will also have**

* Bachelor’s Degree in STEM
* Experience with Agile Scrum and ATDD methodologies.
* Experience automating mobile platforms, a plus.
* Experience in writing SQL queries and database automation.
* Experience in scripting languages, such as Python or Ruby, are a plus.

**What We Look For**
We are interested in innovative technology professionals with strong vision and a desire to stay on top of trends in the industry. If you have a genuine passion for new technologies and transforming an entire industry, this role may be for you.
  
  
**What Working At ACA Offers**
We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options as well as a flexible work environment. You’ll also be granted time off for designated ACA Paid Holidays, Summer Fridays, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
  
  
  
  
**Plus, we offer:**

* Continuous learning: You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You will be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**Why join our team?**
We are the leading governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) advisor in financial services. When you join ACA, you'll become part of a team whose unique combination of talent includes the industry's largest team of former regulators, compliance professionals, legal professionals, and GIPS® standards verifiers in the industry, along with practitioners in cybersecurity, ESG, and regulatory technology.
  
  
Our team enjoys an entrepreneurial work environment by offering innovative and tailored solutions for our clients. We encourage creative thinking and making the most of your experience at ACA by offering multiple career paths. We foster a culture of growth by focusing on continuous learning through inquiry and curiosity, and transparency. If you’re ready to be part of an award-winning, global team of thoughtful, talented, and committed professionals, you’ve come to the right place.
  
  
**More About ACA**
ACA was founded in 2002 by four former SEC regulators and one former state regulator. The founders saw a need for investment advisers to receive expert guidance on existing and new regulations.
  
  
Over the years, ACA has grown both organically and by acquisition to expand our GRC business and technology solutions. Our services now include GIPS standards verification, cybersecurity and technology risk, regulatory technology, ESG advisory, AML and financial crimes, financial and regulatory reporting, and Mirabella for establishing EU operations.
  
  
**What We Commit To**
ACA is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity. We conduct our business without regard to actual or perceived age, race, color, religion, disability, caregiver, marital or partnership status, pregnancy (including childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), ancestry, national origin and citizenship, sex, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, sexual and reproductive health decisions, military or veteran status, creed, genetic predisposition, carrier status or any other category protected by federal, state and local law.
  
  
ACA is firmly committed to a policy of nondiscrimination, which applies to recruiting, hiring, placement, promotions, training, discipline, terminations, layoffs, recall, transfers, leaves of absence, compensation and all other terms and conditions of employment.
  
  
Here at ACA, we have created a variety of programs to promote ACA’s culture of inclusivity and work hard to ensure that all our employees have an equal opportunity to contribute to ACA and feel that ACA is exactly where they belong.

title: Agent Evaluation & Operations Engineer
description:
**# Agent Evaluation & Operations Engineer**

* Location:\*\* Pune, Maharashtra
* Work Mode:\*\* Work From Office (WFO)(890)
* Experience:\*\* 8–11 Years
* Salary Budget:\*\* ₹8,00,000–₹18,00,000 per annum (₹8–18 LPA)
* Notice Period:\*\* Immediate to 45 Days
* Preferred Candidates:\*\* Local candidates based in Pune

**## Role Overview**
We are seeking an experienced Agent Evaluation & Operations Engineer to develop, evaluate, test, monitor, and support AI agents and LLM-powered applications across their development and production lifecycle.
  
  
The ideal candidate must have strong hands-on expertise in Python, LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI, and Azure Databricks. The role involves agent orchestration, LLM evaluation, experiment lifecycle management, automated testing, observability, production monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational reliability.
  
  
This is a client-facing position involving regular interaction with clients and technical teams. Excellent verbal and written communication skills are mandatory, with no compromise on communication quality.
  
  
**## Key Responsibilities**
### 1. Agent Development & Orchestration
  
  

* Design, develop, integrate, and maintain AI agents using LangChain, LangGraph, and OpenAI-based technologies.
* Build Python-based services, REST APIs, and agent integration components using FastAPI and Pydantic.
* Work with agent orchestration frameworks such as OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK, and Pydantic-AI, where applicable.
* Support agent workflow development, integration, testing, and production operations.

### 2. LLM Evaluation & Experiment Lifecycle
  
  

* Design and implement evaluation frameworks to assess agent quality, response accuracy, reliability, consistency, and performance.
* Develop automated evaluation suites using pytest and custom pytest-based evaluations.
* Work with MLflow Evaluation, DeepEval, Ragas, and promptfoo for LLM and agent evaluation.
* Manage experiment execution, evaluation results, test iterations, and quality improvement cycles.
* Identify performance gaps and support continuous improvement of AI agent outputs.

### 3. Agent Observability & Tracing
  
  

* Implement tracing, monitoring, and observability for agent workflows and LLM applications.
* Use OpenTelemetry and OpenInference for telemetry and instrumentation.
* Work with Langfuse and LangSmith to trace agent execution, investigate failures, and analyze application behavior.
* Monitor agent performance and troubleshoot issues across application and integration layers.

### 4. Azure AI Stack
  
  

* Work with Azure OpenAI and Microsoft Foundry for AI application and agent-related workloads.
* Use Azure Monitor and Application Insights for telemetry, application monitoring, diagnostics, and troubleshooting.
* Support operational monitoring and performance analysis of Azure-hosted AI solutions.

### 5. Azure Databricks & Data Operations
  
  

* Work with Azure Databricks for data processing, SQL-based analysis, and operational workflows.
* Use Unity Catalog for data governance and access management.
* Work with Databricks Workflows/Jobs and SQL Warehouses.
* Support data-related workflows required for AI agent evaluation and operations.

### 6. CI/CD, Testing & Version Control
  
  

* Maintain source code and version control using Git and GitLab.
* Integrate automated tests and evaluation suites into CI/CD pipelines.
* Support repeatable testing, deployment validation, and release quality checks.
* Troubleshoot build, test, and deployment issues.

### 7. Production Monitoring & Reliability
  
  

* Monitor applications and services using Grafana, Prometheus, Azure Monitor, Kibana, and alerting platforms.
* Investigate production incidents, analyze logs and telemetry, and perform root-cause analysis.
* Support incident response, issue resolution, performance monitoring, and operational improvements.
* Help improve system reliability, observability, and troubleshooting efficiency.

### 8. Cloud Infrastructure, Containers & Security
  
  

* Work with Docker, Kubernetes, and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) for containerized workloads.
* Understand infrastructure-as-code practices using Terraform and Bicep.
* Apply security and identity management practices using Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, OAuth2, Azure Key Vault, and role-based access control (RBAC).
* Support secure application access, credential management, and appropriate authorization controls.

### 9. Client & Stakeholder Collaboration
  
  

* Collaborate regularly with clients, engineering teams, and other stakeholders.
* Communicate technical issues, evaluation outcomes, incident updates, and resolutions clearly.
* Participate in technical discussions and troubleshooting sessions.
* Maintain professional communication and timely coordination across teams.

**## Mandatory Skills / Must-Haves**
**The Following Skills Are Explicitly Mandatory For This Position**

* Python
* LangChain
* LangGraph
* OpenAI
* Azure Databricks

Candidates must also demonstrate excellent communication, analytical thinking, problem-solving, and troubleshooting capabilities appropriate for a client-facing engineering role.
  
  
##
**Nice-to-Have Skills**
### Programming & APIs
  
  

* FastAPI
* REST APIs
* Pydantic
* pytest

### Agent Orchestration
  
  

* OpenAI Agents SDK
* Google ADK
* Pydantic-AI

* LangSmith

## Candidate Screening Criteria

The role also requires strong understanding of requirements management, SDLC, systems integration, web services, troubleshooting, and workflow management. The candidate should be a key contributor who can guide others informally and help teams deliver reliable, maintainable solutions.
  
  
Role
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Perform QE activities across assigned projects, including test planning, strategy, validation, automation, and release readiness.
* Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to enhance testing processes and strengthen quality practices.
* Contribute to SME QE teams focused on test validation and automation within assigned projects.

* Establish and maintain QA processes and standards that prevent defects, improve quality, optimize performance, and support customer expectations.

* Partner with product owners, developers, and delivery teams to review requirements, clarify acceptance criteria, manage changes, identify risks, and ensure testability throughout the SDLC.
* Support SDLC activities including requirements, design, coding, testing, deployment, and maintenance to ensure solutions remain high quality and maintainable.
* Contribute to systems integration by validating communication, interoperability, and reliability across diverse technologies, processes, applications, and services.
* Implement and support UI, API, backend, and integration automation using tools such as Playwright, Cypress, and API automation frameworks.
* Support API performance testing and performance validation using tools such as Gatling and BlazeMeter.

* Analyze workflows, identify bottlenecks, streamline procedures, monitor progress, allocate resources, and adapt processes to ensure work moves smoothly from one stage to the next.
* Contribute to CI/CD and DevOps practices by supporting automated test execution, version control, and integration of test automation into delivery pipelines.
* Provide technical guidance to team members, support proof-of-concepts, coach others informally, and help teams adopt scalable and maintainable test automation practices.
* Communicate status, risks, dependencies, and quality insights clearly to stakeholders and leadership.
* Promote agile ways of working, continuous learning, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement across the team.

**All About You / Experience**
The ideal candidate for this position should have:
  
  

* Strong experience in quality engineering, test strategy, planning, automation, QA, and software validation across complex technology programs.
* Ability to apply skills independently and consistently in complex or nuanced situations while supporting broader business, delivery, and quality goals.
* Strong knowledge of agile principles and practices, including planning, prioritization, iterative delivery, collaboration, adaptability, and continuous improvement.
* Experience collaborating with developers and engineering teams to review source code, identify potential issues, improve maintainability, and promote coding standards and best practices.
* Hands-on experience with UI and API automation tools such as Playwright and Cypress.
* Strong experience in API integration testing and backend validation.
* Experience designing and maintaining integration tests that validate data flows, interfaces, dependencies, web services, and system interactions.
* Experience with API performance testing and exposure to performance testing tools such as Gatling and BlazeMeter.
* Strong understanding of requirements management, including documenting, analyzing, tracing, prioritizing, agreeing on, and communicating requirements and changes to stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of software development life cycle practices, including requirements gathering, design, coding, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
* Experience with systems integration, including validating communication and interoperability across applications, services, technologies, and processes.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, with the ability to systematically identify, diagnose, and resolve technical issues across systems, applications, services, test environments, and networks.
* Experience with web services and standardized protocols that enable communication, data exchange, interoperability, scalability, and integration across diverse systems.
* Ability to analyze workflows, identify bottlenecks, streamline procedures, monitor progress, allocate resources, and adapt processes to achieve outcomes.
* Working knowledge of version control tools such as Git.
* Experience with API testing tools such as Insomnia.
* Experience with test case management tools such as XRay.
* Experience with project management tools such as Jira.
* Exposure to cloud platforms, preferably Azure.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted engineering and quality practices, including GitHub Copilot, Playwright MCP servers, and automation accelerators.
* Ability to work on proof-of-concepts.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams and present quality insights clearly.
* Self-driven, proactive, adaptable, and committed to continuous improvement.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Technical Consultant plays a crucial role in pharmacovigilance, particularly in the context of the Argus Safety System data migrations. The responsibilities of an data migration consultant, as outlined, involve various aspects of data migration, data management, automation, and collaboration with clients and source application data provider teams.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**

* Configure, maintain, and optimize Oracle Argus Safety to support pharmacovigilance operations and regulatory reporting requirements.
* Lead end-to-end pharmacovigilance data migration projects involving migration of safety data from legacy safety systems databases into target safety systems.
* Perform source system assessment, data profiling, gap analysis, and migration impact assessments to define migration strategies and project deliverables.
* Analyze and convert PostgreSQL databases, schemas, tables, views, indexes, sequences, functions, triggers, and stored procedures into Oracle Database/Oracle Autonomous Database (ADB) while ensuring data integrity and optimal performance.
* Design and maintain source-to-target mapping documents, transformation rules, migration specifications, and data conversion documentation.
* Develop SQL and PL/SQL scripts to support data extraction, transformation, loading (ETL), reconciliation, validation, and migration reporting activities.
* Perform data extraction, cleansing, standardization, transformation, and loading activities while ensuring accuracy, completeness, and regulatory compliance.
* Execute database schema conversion and optimize migrated database objects for Oracle Database and Oracle Autonomous Database (ADB).
* Conduct comprehensive data validation and reconciliation between source and target systems to verify successful migration of all pharmacovigilance data.
* Support migration of safety entities including Cases, Products, Events, Licenses, Studies, Regulatory Reports, Literature, Users, Workflow Data, Attachments, and Configuration Data.
* Develop and execute migration validation plans, reconciliation reports, exception reports, and post-migration verification activities.
* Participate and support in migration testing activities including System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), Performance Testing, and Production Validation.
* Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve migration issues related to data quality, database conversion, mapping discrepancies, application configurations, and system integrations.
* Develop and maintain Oracle BI Publisher (BIP) reports and validation reports to support migration verification and operational reporting.
* Collaborate with Pharmacovigilance, Regulatory Affairs, Business Analysts, Database Administrators, Validation Teams, and Oracle Support throughout migration projects.
* Support system integrations between Oracle Argus Safety and external applications using APIs, web services, and interface technologies.
* Ensure migrated data and system configurations comply with GxP, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, EMA, ICH E2B(R3), GAMP 5, and organizational validation standards.
* Prepare and maintain migration documentation including Migration Plans, Data Mapping Specifications, Validation Documents, Technical Design Documents, SOPs, and Migration Summary Reports.
* Support Oracle Argus upgrades, cloud migrations, and database modernization initiatives involving Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and Oracle Autonomous Database (ADB).
* Mentor junior consultants and provide technical guidance on migration methodologies, database conversion techniques, and Oracle Argus best practices.
* Recommend automation opportunities and continuous improvements to enhance migration efficiency, quality, and compliance.

**Qualifications**
**MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES**

* Participate in end-to-end pharmacovigilance data migration projects, including data assessment, profiling, mapping, transformation, validation, and reconciliation activities.
* Strong expertise in PostgreSQL database administration and development.
* Hands-on experience converting PostgreSQL databases to Oracle Database and Oracle Autonomous Database (ADB).
* Experience with PostgreSQL-to-Oracle schema conversion, including tables, indexes, constraints, sequences, views, triggers, stored procedures, and functions.
* Strong SQL and PL/SQL programming skills.
* Experience developing migration scripts, stored procedures, packages, and automation utilities.
* Experience using Oracle SQL Developer Migration Workbench or equivalent schema conversion tools.
* Strong understanding of Oracle Database architecture, Oracle Autonomous Database (ADB), and performance tuning.
* Experience with ETL processes, data transformation, and migration automation.
* Ability to optimize SQL queries and improve migration performance for high-volume datasets.
* Perform end-to-end data assessment, profiling, cleansing, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and migration activities.
* Develop and maintain source-to-target mapping documents and migration specifications.
* Execute complex SQL-based reconciliation and data validation activities.
* Identify and resolve migration defects, mapping inconsistencies, and data quality issues.
* Conduct pre-migration, mock migration, production migration, and post-migration verification.
* Support migration testing including SIT, UAT, Regression Testing, and Production Validation. Page 4 of 4 CONFIDENTIAL ERD-3-01b, Job Description Template, Rev. 13.0, Eff. 02/22/2023
* Perform record-level reconciliation to ensure completeness, consistency, and accuracy of migrated pharmacovigilance data.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 7+ years of relevant experience in safety IT Systems

title: Software QA Engineer - Physics AI
description:
**We are Siemens**
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software.
  
  
Our Shared Engineering Services team is at the forefront of validating and releasing the cutting-edge Simcenter™ portfolio. Our simulation software and test solutions help companies predict product performance across a broad range of engineering domains - from 3D CAE and system simulation to physical testing.
  
  
We are looking for a technically strong Software QA Engineer - Physics AI to help ensure the quality, accuracy, robustness, and reliability of AI-enabled engineering simulation capabilities.
  
  
In this role, you will combine your knowledge of CAE, physics-based simulation, Engineering AI, and software quality to validate AI/ML models and their integration into desktop simulation products. You will work closely with AI/ML engineers, product teams, software developers, and applications engineers to assess whether AI predictions are accurate, robust, physically meaningful, and reliable when compared with traditional simulation or solver results.
  
  
This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys complex technical problem-solving, understands engineering simulation workflows, and wants to contribute to the evolution of AI-enabled physics and simulation software.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Validate Physics AI capabilities: Work closely with AI/ML engineers to understand the underlying physics models, simulation workflows, and algorithms, and validate the accuracy, robustness, fidelity, and consistency of AI predictions against traditional solver or reference results.
* Own end-to-end quality: Drive QA activities across the software development lifecycle, independently planning and executing quality activities to ensure reliable delivery of AI-enabled simulation capabilities.
* Design comprehensive testing: Review user stories, requirements, and design documentation for testability and develop functional, stress, performance, and end-to-end test scenarios aligned with engineering use cases.
* Develop and maintain test automation: Create, execute, and maintain automated tests using scripting and automation frameworks, while improving existing test suites and porting automation to high-performance systems where appropriate.
* Investigate complex technical issues: Go beyond identifying defects by reproducing issues, analyzing logs and system behavior, investigating root causes, and collaborating with Development and AI/ML teams to drive resolution.
* Improve quality engineering practices: Identify potential risks proactively, research complex problems, introduce effective solutions, and champion best practices in software quality, automation, and testing of Physics AI capabilities.
* Collaborate across engineering teams: Work closely with Development, AI/ML Engineering, DevOps, Product Management, Applications Engineering, and other teams in a globally distributed environment.

**Qualifications**

* 4–6+ years of relevant technical experience in CAE, engineering simulation, design verification, Physics AI, Engineering AI, or a related domain, along with hands-on experience in Software Quality Engineering or software validation.
* 1–3+ years of professional experience in Software QA, Quality Engineering, software testing, or test automation, preferably for complex engineering or desktop software products.
* Strong understanding of CAE and engineering simulation workflows, with the ability to analyze simulation results and assess their technical and physical reasonableness.
* Exposure to AI/ML or Engineering AI, with the ability to understand and validate AI-driven predictions against physics-based, simulation, or solver-generated reference results.
* Experience with desktop simulation or engineering software such as Simcenter, CAD/CAE applications, or similar products; experience with HyperView, Simcenter 3D Post, or equivalent post-processing tools is highly valuable.
* Proficiency in Python, C, or similar scripting/programming languages, with hands-on experience developing or maintaining automated tests using PyTest, Ranorex, Selenium, or comparable frameworks.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently, investigate complex technical issues, and contribute effectively in cross-functional teams.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience testing or validating AI/ML models, Physics AI, surrogate models, or AI-enabled engineering applications.
* Experience comparing AI predictions with traditional CAE/CFD/FEA solver results, experimental data, or other engineering reference data.
* Familiarity with Windows and UNIX/Linux environments and cross-platform desktop software testing.
* Experience with JIRA, Xray, Git, and modern test automation frameworks.
* Experience with functional, regression, stress, performance, and system-level testing.
* Strong attention to detail, curiosity, self-motivation, and the ability to quickly learn unfamiliar engineering and software technologies.

**Why Us**
At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work - hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
  
  
**Diversity & Inclusion**
We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities. At Siemens, we believe people who've had real experiences dealing with being different will excel as leaders. Let's foster a culture of creativity and innovation. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
  
  
**Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday**

Each QA Engineer will be part of a geo-located agile product team, and will provide guidance to the team during planning and refinement as well as execute on the plan during the sprint.
  
  
We are looking for an imaginative self-starter with a passion for great software and a proven track record of developing test automation solutions that drive exceptional quality and productivity. Only motivated problem solvers willing to take the initiative and demonstrate consistent follow-through need apply. Qualified candidates will have extensive experience successfully implementing test automation.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Develop an automation-first testing strategy for functional, performance, and regression testing.
* Architect and develop reusable and scalable multi-layer automation frameworks for UI, API, and database automated test scripts that cover the functional areas of our application suite.
* Guide other test automation engineers embedded in cross-functional development teams, to create scripts and provide faster, scalable, and more comprehensive test coverage.
* Organize and direct team meetings to ensure automation efforts are on track.
* Always be the advocate for automation and quality best practices.
* Review requirements stated in product backlog and assign to each sprint as needed.
* Partner with product, engineering, and IT personnel to align long term solution roadmap with quality assurance efforts.
* Analyze root cause of failing test automation test scripts and fix.
* Lead the collaboration with software developers as needed to identify root cause of product defects and resolve problems.
* Align strategies with organizational goals and report progress to the product owner.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* You must always be curious about the business and customers you support. The more you know and understand your customers and how they work on a daily basis, the better equipped you will be to deliver high quality technology solutions.
* Motivated to deliver the best possible software solutions in a fast-paced collaborative environment.
* Ability to quickly identify and communicate risks.
* Proactively learn and experiment with new technologies and cloud development strategies, staying ahead of the curve.
* Ability to self-manage multiple priorities and understand when to ‘switch gears’ to unblock others.
* Clear and concise written and verbal communication skills.
* Diplomatic with strong negotiation and conflict resolution skills.
* Self-motivator with a strong work ethic, able to perform job duties without significant supervision.
* Comfortable with leveraging approved AI toolsets to help you be more efficient and productive.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Minimum 5 to 7 years of test automation experience, with at least 2 years using Playwright and Typescript (or Javascript).
* Development experience with Typescript/Javascript, C#, Java, or any other Object Oriented Programming language.
* Experience implementing APIs (OData, REST, SOAP) and database automated tests.
* Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins / TeamCity, LambdaTest, etc. is preferred
* Experience with development tools, such as Visual Studio, Azure DevOps, Junit, and Eclipse.
* Working knowledge of code coverage tools, defect-tracking systems, test case management systems, and performance tools.
* Experience with version control tools such as Git or SVN.

**Ideally, you will also have**

* Bachelor’s Degree in STEM.
* Experience with Agile Scrum and ATDD methodologies.
* Experience automating mobile platforms, a plus.
* Experience in writing SQL queries and database automation.
* Experience in scripting languages, such as Python or Ruby, are a plus.

**What We Look For**
We are interested in innovative technology professionals with strong vision and a desire to stay on top of trends in the industry. If you have a genuine passion for new technologies and transforming an entire industry, this role may be for you.
  
  
**What Working At ACA Offers**
We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options as well as a flexible work environment. You’ll also be granted time off for designated ACA Paid Holidays, Summer Fridays, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
  
  
  
  
**Plus, we offer:**

* Continuous learning: You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You will be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**Why join our team?**
We are the leading governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) advisor in financial services. When you join ACA, you'll become part of a team whose unique combination of talent includes the industry's largest team of former regulators, compliance professionals, legal professionals, and GIPS® standards verifiers in the industry, along with practitioners in cybersecurity, ESG, and regulatory technology.
  
  
Our team enjoys an entrepreneurial work environment by offering innovative and tailored solutions for our clients. We encourage creative thinking and making the most of your experience at ACA by offering multiple career paths. We foster a culture of growth by focusing on continuous learning through inquiry and curiosity, and transparency. If you’re ready to be part of an award-winning, global team of thoughtful, talented, and committed professionals, you’ve come to the right place.
  
  
**More About ACA**
ACA was founded in 2002 by four former SEC regulators and one former state regulator. The founders saw a need for investment advisers to receive expert guidance on existing and new regulations.
  
  
Over the years, ACA has grown both organically and by acquisition to expand our GRC business and technology solutions. Our services now include GIPS standards verification, cybersecurity and technology risk, regulatory technology, ESG advisory, AML and financial crimes, financial and regulatory reporting, and Mirabella for establishing EU operations.
  
  
**What We Commit To**
ACA is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity. We conduct our business without regard to actual or perceived age, race, color, religion, disability, caregiver, marital or partnership status, pregnancy (including childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), ancestry, national origin and citizenship, sex, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, sexual and reproductive health decisions, military or veteran status, creed, genetic predisposition, carrier status or any other category protected by federal, state and local law.
  
  
ACA is firmly committed to a policy of nondiscrimination, which applies to recruiting, hiring, placement, promotions, training, discipline, terminations, layoffs, recall, transfers, leaves of absence, compensation and all other terms and conditions of employment.
  
  
Here at ACA, we have created a variety of programs to promote ACA’s culture of inclusivity and work hard to ensure that all our employees have an equal opportunity to contribute to ACA and feel that ACA is exactly where they belong.

title: Principal Silicon Validation Engineer
description:
**Description**
**Invent the future with us.**
Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing with an innovative approach to CPU design focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute.
  
  
As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable computing for AI, Cloud, and edge applications.
  
  
Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team - we’d love to have you apply!
  
  
**About The Role**
This position is for a Principal Silicon Validation Engineer within the Silicon Validation Engineering team, supporting Ampere’s AI Compute family. The engineer will test, qualify, and improve bare-metal validation framework used for CPU/Mesh, SoC, and platform validation across emulation and post-silicon environments.
  
  
The role owns regression strategy, test automation, CI/CD integration, results analysis, and first-level failure triage. The engineer will ensure validation processes, traceability, documentation, and test evidence meet strict ISO 26262 functional-safety and high-quality engineering requirements up to ASIL-D, where applicable
  
  
**What You'll Achieve**

* Develop test plans, automated regression suites, and validation strategies for the bare-metal framework.
* Create and execute functional, negative, stress, robustness, fault-injection, and regression tests across simulation, emulation, FPGA, and post-silicon environments.
* Validate framework execution, build/load/boot flows, CPU and memory features, interrupts, timers, coherency, power/reset, error handling, recovery, and multicore configurations.
* Own regression execution, monitoring, metrics, CI/CD pipelines, test artifacts, and reporting.
* Perform first-level triage; reproduce and classify failures across test, framework, firmware, hardware, configuration, and lab infrastructure.
* Develop automation for test execution, log collection, result analysis, failure classification, and reporting.
* Maintain reproducible test configurations, tool versions, artifacts, requirements traceability, and objective verification evidence.
* Support ISO 26262-aligned requirements-based testing, safety-mechanism validation, fault handling, diagnostic testing, and review/audit readiness up to ASIL-D.
* Improve logging, diagnostics, assertions, timeouts, health checks, and failure signatures; identify and resolve flaky tests.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams on testability, debug, framework improvements, defect resolution, and platform bring-up

**About You**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field
* 8+ years of experience in validation, test automation, firmware/system testing, or functional safety
* Strong experience in validation, test automation, firmware/system testing, or hardware/software integration.
* Strong Python, C, or C++ programming, scripting, and AI Coding skills.
* Experience building automated test infrastructure, regression suites, and CI/CD workflows.
* Experience with test planning, requirements-based testing, defect tracking, result analysis, and reporting.
* Experience with ISO 26262 or similar safety-critical standards; ASIL-D validation experience is strongly preferred.
* Understanding of traceability, configuration/change management, anomaly management, verification evidence, and safety-quality processes.
* Experience with Linux, Git, build systems, and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI or GitHub Actions.
* Familiarity with bare-metal software, firmware, boot flows, ARMv8/AArch64 or Cortex-M/R Series Controllers, and CPU/SoC concepts including caches, MMU, interrupts, timers, coherency, exceptions, reset, and power.
* Experience analyzing logs, firmware traces, register dumps, crashes, and test results.
* Familiarity with DSTREAM, Trace32, OpenOCD, GDB, JTAG, simulation, emulation, FPGA, post-silicon bring-up, or lab automation is a plus.
* Strong ownership, attention to detail, communication, and systematic debugging skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with bare-metal test frameworks, CPU/Mesh/SoC validation, boot firmware, or post-silicon bring-up.
* Experience with safety mechanisms, fault injection, diagnostic coverage, safety evidence, assessments, or audits.
* Experience with requirements/test-management tools such as Jira, Polarion, Codebeamer, or TestRail.
* Experience owning hardware or firmware regression infrastructure and resolving flaky or intermittent failures.

At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay, cash long-term incentive, and comprehensive benefits.
  
  
**Benefits Highlights Include**

* Premium medical, dental, vision insurance, parental benefits including creche reimbursement, as well as a retirement plan, so that you can feel secure in your health, financial future and child care during work.
* Generous paid time off policy so that you can embrace a healthy work-life balance
* Fully catered lunch in our office along with a variety of healthy snacks, energizing coffee or tea, and refreshing drinks to keep you fueled and focused throughout the day.

And there is much more than compensation and benefits. At Ampere, we foster an inclusive culture that empowers our employees to do more and grow more. We are passionate about inventing industry leading cloud-native designs that contribute to a more sustainable future. We are excited to share more about our career opportunities with you through the interview process.
  
  
Ampere is an inclusive and equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, religion, age, veteran and/or military status, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, physical or mental disability, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.

**Impact of the Role**

* Accelerate release velocity while ensuring high quality across multiple engineering teams contributing to shared releases.
* Improve QA processes through automation and AI-enabled testing.
* Reduce release timelines and improve deployment frequency through optimized QA validation and regression processes.

* iOS and Android mobile applications
* Mobile automation frameworks such as Appium or equivalent tools
* Mabl, Selenium, and Playwright
* Web, API, and Microservices testing

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end QA release sign-off for mobile applications across iOS and Android.

* Champion AI-powered testing solutions, AI-assisted test generation, self-healing automation, and intelligent test selection.
* Monitor QA metrics such as automation coverage, execution success rate, pipeline health, defect leakage, and release readiness, driving continuous improvements.
* Coordinate with multiple engineering teams to streamline testing activities and remove bottlenecks in the release process.
* Mentor QA engineers and promote best practices in automation, quality engineering, and release management.

**Qualifications**

* 10–12+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, QA Automation, or Release QA for enterprise applications, including 4+ years of hands-on mobile testing and automation experience.
* 4+ years of experience leading QA release management or centralized regression testing teams.
* Must have strong experience in Mobile QA across iOS and Android, including functional, regression, release, and automation testing.
* Must have hands-on experience with mobile automation frameworks such as Appium or equivalent mobile automation tools.
* Exposure to Mabl, Selenium, Playwright, Web testing, and API testing is good to have.
* Experience integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.

* Must have a strong understanding of release management, quality governance, and regression optimization.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in large-scale retail/eCommerce organizations.
* Experience leading QA transformation initiatives.
* Exposure to Web and API testing.
* Experience leveraging AI-enabled testing to accelerate software delivery.

**Why Join Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center**

* Our people first and performance driven culture means that we provide opportunities to grow and build a career and invest in the well-being of our associates, including comprehensive benefits to support you and your family.
* Scale and innovation of a Fortune 500 company combined with a high-ownership that empowers engineers to make real impact.
* Build and operate large-scale digital commerce platforms serving millions of customers worldwide, working on systems that run at global scale.
* Continuous learning environment with opportunities to work on cutting-edge technologies, AI-driven solutions, and large-scale engineering challenges.
* Hybrid work model designed for flexibility and collaboration, with two in-office days for team engagement.

**About Us**
Founded in 1956, Williams-Sonoma Inc. is the premier specialty retailer of high-quality products for the kitchen and home in the United States. Today, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is one of the United States' largest e-commerce retailers with some of the best known and most beloved brands in home furnishings. Our family of brands are Williams-Sonoma, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, West Elm, Williams-Sonoma Home, Rejuvenation, GreenRow and Mark and Graham. We currently operate retail stores globally. Our products are also available to customers through our catalogs and online worldwide.

The India Technology Center serves as a critical hub for innovation and focuses on developing cutting-edge solutions in areas such as e-commerce, supply chain optimization, and customer experience management. By integrating advanced technologies like artificial intelligence, data analytics, and machine learning, the India Technology Center plays a crucial role in accelerating Williams-Sonoma's growth and maintaining its competitive edge in the global market

Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software-defined manufacturing.
  
  
****Why join Litmus****
****Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible****
AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.
  
  
****Work on problems where software meets the real world****
Most AI systems fail without access to real-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non-negotiable.
  
  
****Have real impact, fast****
You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.
  
  
****Join a high-performance team****
We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.
  
  
****Our culture****
At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.
  
  
We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are hiring Senior QA Automation Engineers to test our data cataloging and real-time data platform products. You will build reliable automation with Playwright, turn business and technical requirements into test cases, and work with developers and product owners to improve product quality.
  
  
We have openings in two areas: application and API automation for our data cataloging product, and end-to-end data validation for our real-time data platform. Your experience will help us identify the best fit. Both openings are hands-on automation roles.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Develop and maintain automated UI tests with Playwright, using TypeScript or JavaScript, and build supporting test scripts and tools in Python where appropriate.
* Translate functional and non-functional requirements into clear test cases and automated coverage.
* Investigate test failures, work with developers to identify root causes, and improve test coverage and automation efficiency.
* Use Linux, Git and AI tools as part of your testing and automation work.

Depending on your product assignment, you will also:
  
  

* Automate API tests, build and troubleshoot Docker test environments, and set up and maintain CI pipelines for application testing.
* Test data flows from source systems to downstream destinations, checking completeness, correctness and consistency, and build scripts to generate test data and validate results at scale.

**What You Will Bring**

* QA experience with a strong focus on hands-on test automation.
* Practical experience building and maintaining automated tests with Playwright.
* Automation coding skills in TypeScript, JavaScript or Python, with strong TypeScript or JavaScript skills for the application automation opening.
* Confidence working in the Linux command line, using Git, and turning requirements into effective test cases.
* Experience using AI tools to support testing and test automation.

**Additional Requirements By Opening**

* Application and API automation: API testing experience; hands-on Docker skills, including building images, running containers and debugging; and experience with CI/CD practices and setting up pipelines in Jenkins, Git-based tooling or similar.
* Real-time data testing: 3–6 years of QA experience, including hands-on validation of data from source to destination; working knowledge of SQL and JSON; and the ability to automate data checks using Python or TypeScript/JavaScript. Docker and Kubernetes can be learned on the job.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with data processing or cataloging products, industrial or IoT data, or MQTT, Kafka and other pub/sub messaging systems.
* Kubernetes, performance or load testing, and CI pipeline setup experience for the real-time data opening.

**Job Summary**
This position is an individual contributor role. This position conducts supplier quality related activities including, supporting new product introduction with existing and new suppliers within Dorman APQP requirements for purchased parts during program development, Acting as technical and quality liaison between Dorman and suppliers. Performing supplier qualification & re-qualification audits, supplier process development & audit, product audits (FAI, SI, PSI). Drive supplier and product quality improvement. * Train suppliers in Dorman’s development processes and ensue “speed to market”

* Drive source inspection activities for 1st shipment of new product
* Monitor supplier performance and work with product team and quality team to continuously reduce the warranty cost.
* Drive and facilitate Continuous Improvement efforts at suppliers to better control of nonconforming products
* Support supplier related corrective action and prevention actions / 8D follow up and validation of internal and external.
* Elimination of repeat of product and process nonconformance through quality engineering activities and drill deep & wide investigations by working together with internal cross functional teams

**Qualifications**

* Communicate proficiently verbally and written, in English. Experience in a global cross-functional team environment. Working experience in global manufacturing and distribution environment is preferred.
* Working knowledge of IATF16949 quality management systems or similar i.e. ISO9001, ISO14001
* Auditing experience (Internal, Supplier, Corrective Action validation, Product, Process, CSR, WCA, SQP, C-TPAT)
* Working experience of APQP, PPAP, FMEA, SPC and MSA
* Exposure to the Ferrous or Aluminum casting process for automotive casting & machined parts i.e., timing cover, engine & transmission parts, etc.

* Working experience of new supplier project management.

* Working experience of Leading Continual Improvement activities.
* Working knowledge of product qualification testing, inspection tools and equipment, and supplier quality activities.
* Familiar with automotive vehicle components and knowledge of field failure analysis (FFT) is preferred.
* Working knowledge of materials, finishes, and specifications (SAE, ASME, ANSI, etc.)
* Familiar with knowledge of common parts and one of the following manufacturing processes, such as plastics, stamping, rubber, casting, machining, forging, plating. Familiar with knowledge of electronics/electrical parts and manufacturing process is a plus.
* Familiar with GD&T and can understand drawing related with parts of mechanical and/or electrical.
* Familiar with checking fixture and know how to conduct check fixture calibration.
* Good PC skills including MS Office Suite including Excel, Word, and PPT. Minitab / SAP is preferred.
* Physical Requirement: Capability to lift 20 pounds.
* Working Conditions: Working Conditions: "this role would require 50% travel to supplier partners across the country for all the activities mentioned above

Education / Experience
  
  

* Preferred Bachelor's degree (B. S / B tech) in a technical or quality related field from four-year College or University; and 6 to 11 related experience.
* Working knowledge of Tier1 / OEM is preferred.
* At least 4 years automotive related project / program / quality working experience.

title: SW QA Engineer - Engineering Simulation ( HyperMesh )
description:
**We are Siemens**
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software.
  
  
Siemens Digital Industries Software is looking for a Software QA Engineer to join our Shared Engineering Services team, supporting the quality and reliability of our Simcenter™ and HyperMesh engineering software portfolio.
  
  
In this role, you will validate desktop-based CAE applications and engineering workflows across multiple platforms, combining engineering domain knowledge with software testing and automation. You will design and execute test scenarios, develop automation scripts, investigate complex defects, and contribute to performance and stress testing.
  
  
You will collaborate with development, product management, and application engineering teams to deliver reliable, high-quality software while exploring AI-assisted testing and continuous improvement opportunities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Validate engineering software: Design and execute functional, integration, regression, stress, and performance tests for CAE applications, with a focus on HyperMesh functionality and engineering workflows.
* Test engineering workflows: Develop comprehensive test scenarios covering pre-processing, post-processing, design validation, and verification to ensure software behavior meets engineering requirements.
* Develop test automation: Create, maintain, and enhance automated tests using Python or Tcl/Tk and frameworks such as Pytest, Ranorex, Selenium, or similar tools.
* Investigate and resolve defects: Analyze test failures, logs, and application behavior to identify root causes, document reproducible defects, and verify fixes.
* Improve testing efficiency: Identify opportunities for automation, reuse existing test assets, port automated tests to high-performance systems, and explore AI-assisted testing approaches.
* Champion quality throughout development: Review requirements, user stories, and design documents to improve testability, coverage, and early defect detection.
* Collaborate across teams: Work with QA, development, DevOps, product management, and application engineering teams to improve product quality and testing practices across supported platforms.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Civil Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.
* 2–3 years of relevant technical experience in CAE or engineering software, with hands-on exposure to engineering tools and design validation or verification workflows.
* Practical knowledge of CAE pre-processing and/or post-processing workflows, preferably using HyperMesh or similar engineering applications.
* Strong scripting skills in Python or Tcl/Tk, including the ability to develop test scripts and automate repetitive workflows.
* Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks such as Pytest, Ranorex, Selenium, or equivalent tools.
* Understanding of software testing fundamentals, including test design, execution, regression testing, defect reporting, and validation of fixes.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and effective written and verbal communication.

**Preferred Skills**

* Knowledge of composite mechanics, including Classical Laminate Theory (CLT), sandwich structures, and manufacturing constraints.
* Experience with design verification, validation, or testing of CAD/CAE engineering applications.
* Familiarity with Windows and UNIX/Linux environments.
* Experience with performance or stress testing, test automation frameworks, and API-based automation.
* Familiarity with Jira, Xray, Git, and collaborative software development practices.
* Exposure to AI-assisted testing, test generation, or intelligent automation techniques.
* Ability to analyze engineering models and results to identify inconsistencies or unexpected application behavior.

**Why Us**
At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work - hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
  
  
**Diversity & Inclusion**
We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities. At Siemens, we believe people who've had real experiences dealing with being different will excel as leaders. Let's foster a culture of creativity and innovation. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
  
  
**Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday**

title: Industry Process Consultant/LIMS
description:

We are looking for a skilled
**Method Developer**
to join our team and contribute to laboratory process digitalization, recipe authoring, and configuration using BIOVIA applications. The ideal candidate will have a background in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or Chemistry, along with hands-on experience in LIMS and a strong understanding of analytical laboratory processes.
  
  
In this role, you will work on developing and managing digital recipes, standardizing recipe templates, configuring data, validating applications, and supporting integrations with laboratory and process systems.
  
  
This position requires close collaboration with internal teams, clients, and stakeholders to deliver effective solutions for pharmaceutical and life sciences environments.
  
  
**Role Description & Responsibilities**

* Develop, configure, and manage digital recipes based on laboratory and business requirements.
* Support laboratory process digitalization and improve existing workflows.
* Create, maintain, and standardize recipe templates to ensure consistency and efficiency.
* Configure application data, parameters, and workflows based on project requirements.
* Support integration of recipes and laboratory applications with relevant process systems.
* Perform application validation, functional testing, and troubleshooting to ensure solution quality.
* Maintain technical documentation and ensure adherence to applicable compliance and quality standards.
* Support cross-system integration between laboratory applications and other enterprise systems.
* Identify, analyze, and resolve application-related issues and provide ongoing functional support.
* Prepare reports and perform data analysis to support process improvement and operational efficiency.
* Understand analytical laboratory processes and techniques, including UV, HPLC, LC-MS, and GC-MS.
* Understand the application of analytical equipment used in pharmaceutical companies.
* Collaborate with internal teams, clients, and management to gather requirements and deliver solutions.
* Manage multiple tasks and project deliverables while ensuring quality and adherence to deadlines.
* Provide regular project updates, communicate challenges proactively, and coordinate with stakeholders across teams and time zones.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Life Sciences or a related discipline, such as B. Pharm., Biotechnology, or M.Sc. in Chemistry.
* Minimum 2+ years of industry experience in IT, Life Sciences, Pharmaceuticals, or Healthcare.
* Minimum 2+ years of hands-on experience with LIMS (Laboratory Information Management System).
* Hands-on experience with BIOVIA applications such as OneLab, CISPro, Pipeline Pilot, Workbook, and Electronic Lab Notebooks (ELN).
* Sound knowledge of analytical sciences and laboratory processes.
* Understanding of analytical laboratory techniques and equipment, including UV, HPLC, LC-MS, and GC-MS.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with strong organizational and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and work effectively in a dynamic environment.
* Flexibility to support global teams across different time zones when required, while maintaining reasonable working hours.

**Must Have**

* Experience in recipe authoring, recipe management, and template standardization.
* Experience in laboratory process digitalization and workflow configuration.
* Familiarity with application validation, testing, and technical documentation.
* Experience with laboratory application integration and cross-system workflows.
* Team leadership experience.
* Experience working with pharmaceutical laboratory systems and regulated environments.

**Good to have**

* Proficiency in Java and JavaScript for backend development and application logic.
* Strong experience with Angular and TypeScript for frontend development and dynamic UI creation.
* Knowledge of RDF for semantic data modeling, querying (SPARQL), and knowledge graph implementation.
* Familiarity with Generative AI (Gen AI) tools and frameworks for automating workflows and enhancing data-driven insights.
* Experience with RESTful APIs and microservices architecture for platform integration.
* Understanding of cloud-based development and deployment
* Knowledge of software development best practices, including Agile methodologies, CI/CD pipelines, and version control (Git).

**What’s In It For You**

* You will work with BIOVIA applications and contribute to digital transformation initiatives in the Life Sciences and Pharmaceutical domains.
* Gain exposure to laboratory processes, analytical sciences, and laboratory information management systems.
* Work on recipe development, process standardization, application configuration, and system integration.
* Collaborate with technical teams, laboratory experts, and stakeholders to solve business challenges.

* Contribute to process improvement initiatives while enhancing your problem-solving and collaboration skills.

title: Creative Quality Assurance
description:
As a member of the Creative QA team, you will facilitate detailed inspections of Amazon and marketplace creative — A+ Content, Image Stacks, and product imagery — to ensure the final product meets Pattern's quality standards before it goes live. You'll play a pivotal role in keeping campaigns and projects moving internally: catching copy errors, image inconsistencies, and compliance issues before they cost a listing sales or trigger a takedown, while developing and refining the inspection process itself.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**

* Run detailed QA on Amazon A+ Content and Image Stack modules, cross-referencing Figma design files against content sheets (copy docs, Google Sheets, PDFs)
* Ensure all projects are delivered on time, within scope, and with correct stakeholder approvals
* Ensure all pertinent details needed for the creation of materials are provided and complete before production begins
* Verify copy accuracy — headlines, bullets, claims, and brand voice — is consistent across every module and product variant
* Audit images against hero/reference product photos to catch AI-generation errors, color mismatches, cropping issues, and packaging inaccuracies
* Check file naming conventions and SKU counts across shared drive folders to confirm content is production-ready
* Follow up with the appropriate channels when mistakes are found or details are incomplete
* Log and prioritize QA findings with clear severity ratings and specific, actionable feedback for designers and copywriters
* Track task progression across pre- and post-production, keeping CPMs and project owners looped in on updates
* Maintain and apply brand-specific QA guidelines, incorporating reviewer feedback to sharpen the process over time
* Develop and continuously improve the workflow for product/content inspection

**Key Skills & Areas For Development**

* Extremely organized and works well under pressure, at volume, without losing rigor
* A sharp eye for visual detail — able to catch color shifts, misalignment, cropping errors, and typography inconsistencies at a glance
* Able to view a project from a strategic perspective, not just a checklist
* A deep understanding of ecommerce/marketplace trends and how design strategy affects conversion
* Well-versed with AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, AI image generation/review tools) and comfortable adopting new ones — a genuine quick learner who picks up new tools and workflows fast
* Develops skills in staff/personnel management as the team grows

**Required Qualifications**

* 1–3 years of interest and experience with QA within a creative or production team
* The ability to consistently identify mistakes across thousands of inspections
* Skilled in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides) and Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint)
* Working familiarity with Figma
* Skilled in Asana or similar project management software preferred
* Strong AI-tool fluency and a demonstrated quick-learner mindset — comfortable picking up new QA/creative tools with minimal ramp-up
* Language skills: ability to read, write, type, and communicate verbally, effectively and professionally, with other business departments, guests, and vendors; able to diplomatically handle difficult situations while maintaining professionalism

**Nice to have**

* Experience QAing Amazon A+ Content, Image Stacks, or similar ecommerce listing creative
* Familiarity with reviewing AI-generated product imagery for accuracy
* Background in ecommerce, DTC, or marketplace brand management
