title: Test Lead SME / Associate Director
description:
**Some Careers Shine Brighter Than Others.**
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Test Lead SME
  
  
**In this role, you will:**
**(Principal Responsibilities)**

* Act as the senior technical lead for integration testing across the Product Control pod and Channels IT programme.
* Define and own the end-to-end integration-testing strategy across upstream, downstream, internal and third-party systems.
* Establish integration-test scope, environments, test data, dependencies, entry and exit criteria, quality gates and release-readiness measures.
* Lead testing across APIs, microservices, messaging platforms, event-driven services, data pipelines, databases and reporting interfaces.
* Ensure end-to-end business flows are validated across contact center, Product Control, accounting, regulatory and reconciliation processes.
* Coordinate integration testing with global teams across the UK, Hong Kong, Guangzhou, India and Canada.
* Identify and manage interface, environment, data, sequencing and dependency risks.
* Ensure defects are logged, prioritized, root causes are understood and remediation is tracked through to closure.
* Provide clear status reporting on integration coverage, risks, defects, dependencies and release readiness.

**NFR strategy and assurance**

* Define and maintain the NFR strategy, ensuring requirements are identified, measurable, testable and traceable to business and technical outcomes.
* Work with architects, engineers, infrastructure, security, operations and business stakeholders to establish NFR acceptance criteria.
* Lead the planning and execution of NFR testing, including:

+ Performance, load, stress and endurance testing
+ Scalability and capacity testing
+ Resilience, failover and recovery testing
+ Availability and service-continuity validation
+ Data quality, integrity and reconciliation testing
+ Security, access-control and vulnerability validation
+ Monitoring, alerting, logging and observability testing
+ Disaster-recovery and operational-readiness testing
+ Deployment, rollback and production-verification testing

* Define performance baselines, service-level thresholds, capacity assumptions and production-volume scenarios.
* Assess NFR risks and ensure that identified gaps have documented remediation plans and accountable owners.
* Challenge designs and implementation approaches where they may create unacceptable performance, resilience, security or operational risks.
* Produce NFR evidence and sign-off recommendations for governance forums, architecture reviews and release decisions.
* Support audit, regulatory and control requirements through complete and traceable test documentation.

**Technical quality engineering**

* Provide hands-on technical leadership for test automation and integration-validation solutions using Java and relevant testing frameworks.
* Develop and maintain automation for APIs, services, data flows, messaging, database validation and end-to-end scenarios.
* Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and establish appropriate shift-left quality practices.
* Partner with software engineers to improve service testability, observability, error handling and operational supportability.
* Review test designs, automation code, test results and technical evidence for quality and completeness.
* Support deployment and release activities, including pre-production validation and post-deployment verification.
* Contribute to technical delivery plans, estimates, timelines and sprint planning.

**Architecture and stakeholder management**

* Work with architecture teams to ensure that integration and NFR considerations are embedded in solution designs and aligned with the target-state architecture.
* Translate business and technical requirements into clear integration scenarios and measurable NFR acceptance criteria.
* Collaborate with upstream and downstream system teams to coordinate interfaces, environments, test data and delivery schedules.
* Communicate technical risks, quality trends and recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders.
* Manage expectations and negotiate practical compromises while protecting critical quality, control and risk outcomes.
* Support programme governance, release forums, technical design reviews and production-readiness assessments.

**Leadership and people development**

* Lead, coach and mentor integration-test and quality-engineering colleagues.
* Establish consistent testing standards, reusable approaches and a culture of quality ownership.
* Provide functional management and support the development, performance and career progression of direct reports.
* Contribute to recruitment, resource planning and capability development for the testing function.
* Promote inclusive, collaborative ways of working across geographically distributed teams.

**What You’ll Need To Succeed**

* Typically 10+ years’ experience in software testing, quality engineering, integration testing or software engineering, including significant experience in senior technical leadership roles.
* Proven experience leading integration testing for complex, enterprise-scale and regulated technology environments.
* Strong experience testing distributed systems, microservices, APIs, event-driven architectures, messaging platforms and data-intensive applications.
* Demonstrable experience defining and delivering NFR strategies covering performance, scalability, resilience, availability, security, recoverability and operational readiness.
* Hands-on experience with Java and testing frameworks such as JUnit, TestNG, Mockito, Cucumber or equivalent.
* Experience with API and service-testing tools such as REST-assured, Postman, SoapUI or equivalent.
* Experience testing data integrations using relational and NoSQL databases, including data reconciliation, integrity and quality validation.
* Experience with performance and resilience-testing tools such as JMeter, Gatling, LoadRunner, Chaos Engineering tools or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of integration patterns, asynchronous processing, messaging, event streaming and distributed data flows.
* Experience with CI/CD and DevOps tools such as Jenkins, GitHub, SonarQube and Nexus.
* Experience working on Unix/Linux platforms.
* Experience with cloud technologies, containerised platforms and observability tools would be advantageous.
* Experience with data-streaming technologies, such as Apache Beam, would be a plus.
* Strong understanding of Agile delivery, Scrum, shift-left testing, risk-based testing and continuous testing.
* Experience defining quality gates, release criteria, NFR baselines and production-readiness assessments.
* Proven ability to influence senior business and technology stakeholders across multiple locations.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
* Self-motivated and accountable, with the ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and deliver under pressure.
* A disciplined approach to requirements analysis, test design, risk assessment, defect management and evidence production.
* Degree-level education in software engineering, computer science or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

title: Senior Consultant – Oracle Fusion Payroll
description:
**Job Summary:**

We are seeking a Senior Oracle Fusion Payroll Consultant with strong functional expertise in payroll concepts, Oracle Fusion Payroll implementation, configuration, and troubleshooting. The role involves delivering end-to-end payroll implementations, enhancements, testing, and production support for clients in the United Arab Emirates (UAE).

The consultant will work offshore in close collaboration with onsite teams to configure payroll solutions, develop and debug Fast Formulas, execute parallel payroll runs, resolve complex payroll issues, and ensure accurate payroll processing and successful go-live.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Payroll Configuration:**
  Configure payroll definitions, elements, eligibility rules, balances, payment methods, costing, and General Ledger (GL) transfer.
* **Payroll Concepts:**
  Apply a strong understanding of gross-to-net calculations, earnings and deductions, retroactive processing, proration, arrears, balances and dimensions, costing, and payroll period close.
* **Fast Formula Development:**
  Develop, modify, test, and troubleshoot payroll Fast Formulas to support complex payroll calculations and business requirements.
* **Implementation:**
  Lead and execute end-to-end Oracle Fusion Payroll implementations, including requirements analysis, configuration, testing, data migration, go-live, and hypercare.
* **Testing and Parallel Runs:**
  Prepare test scenarios, conduct system integration testing (SIT), execute parallel payroll cycles, and reconcile results against legacy payroll systems.
* **Troubleshooting and Support:**
  Diagnose failed payroll flows, incorrect calculations, retroactive processing issues, balance discrepancies, and costing errors using logs, element entries, and balance views.
* **Data Migration:**
  Perform payroll balance and element entry migrations using HCM Data Loader (HDL), validate migrated data, and support payroll readiness for go-live.
* **UAE Payroll Localization:**
  Support UAE payroll requirements, including Wage Protection System (WPS), applicable pension and social security rules, gratuity, and leave salary calculations, as relevant to client requirements.
* **Enhancements and Updates:**
  Implement payroll policy changes, assess quarterly Oracle updates, conduct regression testing, and maintain existing payroll configurations.
* **Reporting:**
  Develop and maintain payroll and costing reports to support payroll validation, reconciliation, and business reporting.
* **Oracle Support:**
  Raise, manage, and follow up on Oracle service requests to resolve product-related issues.
* **Stakeholder Collaboration:**
  Work closely with onsite leads, HR, Finance, technical teams, and client stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver payroll solutions.
* **Documentation:**
  Maintain functional specifications, configuration documents, test scripts, reconciliation reports, and implementation documentation.

**Role Requirements and Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 6+ years of experience in Oracle Payroll, including at least 4 years of hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion Payroll.
* Minimum of 2 end-to-end Oracle Fusion Payroll implementations, covering configuration, parallel runs, and go-live.
* Strong understanding of payroll concepts, gross-to-net calculations, earnings, deductions, balances, retroactive processing, proration, arrears, and costing.
* Strong hands-on experience in Oracle Fusion Payroll configuration and payroll processing.
* Proficiency in developing, debugging, and troubleshooting Oracle Payroll Fast Formulas.
* Experience with payroll testing, parallel runs, payroll reconciliation, data migration, and production support.
* Hands-on experience with HCM Data Loader (HDL) for payroll balance and element entry migration.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across payroll flows, calculation errors, balance discrepancies, and costing issues.
* Ability to work independently with onsite teams and manage implementation activities effectively.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document and explain technical and functional issues clearly in English.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with UAE and Gulf payroll localization, including Wage Protection System (WPS), General Pension and Social Security Authority (GPSSA) requirements, gratuity, and leave salary.
* Working knowledge of Oracle Fusion Absence Management and Time and Labor.
* Previous experience with Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) Payroll.
* Experience developing payroll and costing reports using Oracle BI Publisher.
* Familiarity with Oracle Fusion quarterly updates, regression testing, and Oracle Support service requests.
* Oracle Fusion Global Payroll certification is preferred.

**Why Join Us:**

* Opportunity to work on Oracle Fusion Payroll implementations and enhancements for clients in the UAE.
* Exposure to enterprise payroll transformation and complex functional requirements.
* Collaborative working environment with onsite and offshore implementation teams.
* Opportunities for continuous learning, technical development, and career growth.
* A culture that encourages ownership, problem-solving, and professional development.

title: Senior Engineer, Quality Engineering [T500-30262]
description:
**Talent500 is hiring for one of its clients.**

**About DIRECTV:**

Since our inception in 1994, DIRECTV has been part of millions of American households, delivering favorite shows, sports, and premium content anytime, anywhere. We believe media entertainment is meant to be enjoyed, so we continuously evolve to provide personalized, best-in-class options that exceed expectations. We champion excellence, embrace emerging technologies, and offer industry-leading video services that feel made for each viewer.

**About DIRECTV India GCC:**

DIRECTV India, an independent capability center is our exciting new chapter in Pune where exceptional technical and AI talent come together to solve meaningful challenges and build what’s next. It’s a high-impact, high-visibility environment built to deliver on business-critical priorities. Here, your work directly shapes entertainment technology that reaches millions, while you grow your career in one of the world’s most dynamic talent markets.

**Our Purpose:**

We’re here to reimagine what’s possible in entertainment, delivering experiences that meet the viewer’s needs, timing, and preferences. With nearly three decades at the forefront, we stay focused on our people, partners, and customers, creating innovative experiences that fit seamlessly into their lives, wherever and however they choose to watch. Driven by values we truly live, we channel curiosity, care, and commitment into innovation, aggregating, curating, and delivering entertainment with exceptional services that bring the future closer every day.

**Our Values and Culture:**

We built our culture with our people, not for them. Our values unite every teammate which forms a culture grounded in care, challenge, and delivery. They are more than just principles; they are how we operate.

Anchored in a 30-year legacy of innovation and community, we’re building a future better than yesterday – for our colleagues, our customers, and our company.

**Functional EVP:**

Engineer quality into every stage of delivery

Quality at DIRECTV starts long before a product reaches the customer. As part of DQE, you’ll work alongside engineering teams to strengthen how software is designed, tested and released. You’ll drive automation, testing and quality practices across products and platforms, helping teams identify issues earlier, improve reliability and deliver with greater confidence.

**Position Summary:**

To help drive this next chapter, we're seeking a talented and innovative Senior Engineer, Quality Engineering to join our Test Environment & Data Management organization. This role designs, supports, and optimizes enterprise test environments, service virtualization solutions, and test data management capabilities that enable efficient software delivery across DIRECTV. You will partner with engineering, quality, DevOps, and platform teams to improve environment availability, automation, and operational excellence.

The ideal candidate combines strong expertise in environment management, service virtualization, cloud-native technologies, and automation engineering with a commitment to engineering excellence and continuous improvement.

**Job Responsibilities:**

**Environment Engineering:**

* Support enterprise test environment management activities.
* Manage environment provisioning, configuration, and maintenance processes.
* Partner with engineering teams to ensure environment readiness and availability.
* Troubleshoot complex environment-related issues and implement sustainable solutions.

**Service Virtualization & Automation:**

* Develop and maintain
  **service virtualization**
  and API mocking capabilities.
* Support automated environment provisioning and lifecycle management activities.
* Build automation solutions that improve testing efficiency and quality outcomes.
* Contribute to platform modernization initiatives through automation and engineering best practices.

**Platform Reliability & Innovation:**

* Improve environment observability and operational monitoring capabilities.
* Support cloud-native testing and delivery environments.
* Evaluate emerging tools and technologies that improve engineering productivity.
* Contribute to AI-enabled testing and quality engineering modernization efforts

**Qualifications:**

**Required Experience:**

* 4-6 years of software engineering experience.
* Experience supporting enterprise testing environments.
* Experience with service virtualization and API mocking technologies.
* Familiarity with cloud-native platforms and containerized environments.
* Strong problem-solving and collaboration skills.
* Experience operating within Agile software development environments.

**Required Technical Skills:**

* **Test Environment Management**
* **Service Virtualization & API Mocking**
* Python Automation
* Java Automation
* **Cloud & Kubernetes**
* **AI/LLM-Enabled Testing**
* **DevOps & Environment Observability**

**Preferred Skills & Experience:**

* Kubernetes
* Docker
* REST API Mocking
* SOAP API Mocking
* Automated Environment Provisioning
* Enterprise Testing Infrastructure
* Quality Engineering Modernization Initiatives

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science and engineering or equivalent

**Note:**
This position is based in Pune, and applications are currently being considered from candidates based in Pune.

**Talent Value Proposition statement:**

At DIRECTV India, we're building a culture with our people, not for them, grounded in the values of We Care, We Challenge, and We Deliver. We will focus on building a better future than yesterday for our colleagues, customers, and company. As part of our team, you'll help shape the future of enterprise data platforms, enable advanced analytics and AI innovation, and contribute to business-critical capabilities that impact millions of customers. If you're ready to bring your expertise, leadership, and passion for innovation to a team redefining entertainment technology, we'd love to have you join us on this journey.

Headquartered in El Segundo, California, DIRECTV has been a household name in sports and entertainment for 30 years. We've grown our global footprint with DIRECTV India, a capability center in Pune built to support our operations and speed up how we build new technology. Here, our teams work on the platforms and products that bring together satellite and streaming, so customers get their favorite content without the hassle of switching between apps or inputs. From AI-driven personalization to content built around what people actually want to watch, we're shaping what entertainment looks like next, and Pune is a big part of that.

DIRECTV is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are based on business requirements, qualifications, merit, and performance, without discrimination on the basis of legally protected characteristics under applicable laws.

title: Lead, Data Validation Specialist
description:
**Who We Are**
Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.
  
  
**The Role**
We are seeking a Lead, Data Validation Specialist to oversee a team of Data Validation Specialists responsible for ensuring the accuracy and integrity of financial data during new client onboarding. You’ll manage daily workflows, ensure consistent data quality across projects, and serve as the primary liaison between the Data Validations team and cross-functional partners.
  
  
This is primarily a non-client-facing role that plays a key part behind the scenes, requiring focus, consistency, and comfort with repetitive work. It’s a great fit for someone who enjoys working with data in a structured way and takes pride in getting the details right.
  
  
You’ll be instrumental in fostering a collaborative team culture, driving consistency in our data conversions, and contributing to the growth of both your team and our global function.
  
  
Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead and mentor a team of Data Validation Specialists, supporting career development, delivering regular feedback, and helping individuals thrive in their role
* Manage a team’s work allocation, prioritization, and execution to ensure on-time, high-quality project delivery
* Review and audit data validation projects to ensure adherence to standards and best practices
* Drive process improvements to increase data occurrence, reduce turnaround time, and enhance scalability
* Develop and maintain documentation, templates, and standard operating procedures for data validation
* Collaborate cross-functionally across global teams, including Sales, Client Solutions, Product, and Engineering, to deliver integrated solutions
* Foster a team culture that values collaboration, learning, and a shared commitment to client success
* Maintain a personal set of data validation projects, performing hands-on review and reconciliation of client data alongside team leadership responsibilities

**Who You Are**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent, ideally in Business, Finance, Math, Economics, or another data-oriented field
* 3+ years of experience in data validation, financial operations, data quality assurance, or a related field
* 1+ year of people leadership or team coordination experience preferred
* Strong organizational and analytical skills, with a proven track record of maintaining accuracy in high-volume data environments
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to guide and influence across teams
* Proficiency with spreadsheets (e.g., Excel), internal tools, and web-based platforms
* Familiarity with financial data is a plus, but not required. Quick to learn new systems and follow structured processes for data navigation and validation
* Process-oriented with a continuous improvement mindset and strong attention to detail

**Our Values**

* Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
* Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.
  
  
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
  
  
PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

title: AVP , Quality Engineering (QE) Automation Architect  ( L11 )
description:
**Role Title :**
AVP , Quality Engineering (QE) Automation Architect ( L11 )
  
  
**Company Overview:**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
The Quality Engineering Center of Excellence (QE COE) is a centralized team of Quality Engineering Leaders and Test Architects, that standardizes, scales, and governs software quality, test automation, and best practices across the organization. This team works closely with the Leaders in the Engineering verticals and other cross functional teams who are the key stakeholders. This role will work closely with other peer Test Architects in the team under the leadership of the QE Leader to rollout and institutionalize the AI driven QE strategies and solutions conceptualized by the team, in partnership with the Application Teams.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
**Quality Engineering (QE) Automation Architect**
Drive the design and delivery of next-generation Quality Engineering solutions by blending proven testing methodologies with AI-powered approaches. This role will occasionally architect scalable testing frameworks, champion adoption of AI-assisted testing, and embed intelligent automation across the product development lifecycle and CI/CD pipelines to accelerate high-quality delivery.
  
  
As an SME in AI-enabled test automation engineering, this role will partner with peer architects and stakeholders to define strategy, recommend the optimal tool stack aligned to the application landscape, and resolve complex automation challenges—delivering best-in-class, enterprise-wide automation expansion solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Architect and own scalable test automation frameworks for functional, regression, and non-functional testing; embed automation into CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub, CloudBees) as required by the Application teams.
* Define and drive QE standards, best practices, and reusable libraries/patterns across engineering teams.
* Partner with QE leads in application teams to implement shift-left testing and quality-by-design.
* Design and implement AI-assisted testing solutions leveraging LLMs, RAG, and agentic workflows; lead prompt engineering and context design for reliable AI test agents (test generation, test data creation, defect triage/analysis).
* Drive adoption and standardization of modern automation tools/frameworks (e.g., Playwright, Selenium).
* Enable self-service automation and quality reporting dashboards for engineering teams.
* Act as a QE technical leader, run architecture reviews, mentor QE Engineers/Architects on AI-driven quality patterns and tools, and resolve complex automation challenges.
* Create playbooks, training, and rollout plans; continuously evaluate/pilot emerging QE technologies and measure adoption and impact.

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Experience: 12+ years in Software Quality Engineering, including 3+ years in test architecture and framework design.
* Automation Tools: Hands-on expertise in Playwright and/or Selenium, REST API testing, and modern JavaScript/TypeScript or Python automation frameworks.
* AI-Assisted Testing: Working knowledge of LLMs and context design for QE use cases.
* Experience in providing AI-assisted solutions for functional, UAT, performance and security testing.
* AI Tooling: Experience applying AI tools for test case generation, code review support, and defect triage.
* Agentic Workflows: Understanding of agentic AI patterns to build autonomous test agents and end-to-end workflows.
* Integration: Ability to integrate AI solutions with existing business processes and enterprise IT infrastructure
* Communication & stakeholder management: Align and influence stakeholders through clear, concise communication.
* System thinking & architecture design: Design scalable QE architectures with end-to-end perspective.
* Problem formulation & solution design: Turn vague problems into measurable, practical solutions.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* Experience designing and building GenAI platforms.
* Exposure to cloud ecosystems such as AWS and Azure.
* Proven ability to integrate test automation into CI/CD toolchains (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, CloudBees).

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Bachelor’s Degree and a minimum of 12 + years of experience in Information Technology or Engineering.

**Work Timings**
2:00PM to 11:00 PM IST
  
  
This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. More than 250 manufacturers rely on our ICyte Platform to orchestrate their commercial and government payer contracting, patient services, and distribution channels. With ICyte, Life Sciences innovators can digitalize their market access operations, freeing up resources to focus on more data-driven decision support. With ICyte, Life Sciences innovators are digitalizing labor-intensive processes – freeing up their best talent to identify and resolve coverage and availability hurdles and to manage pricing and forecasting complexity.
  
  
We are headquartered in Philadelphia, PA (USA), with offices in: Ambler, PA (USA); Pune, India; and Medellín, Colombia. For more information, visit www.integrichain.com, or follow us on Twitter @IntegriChain and LinkedIn.

The Operations Analyst is responsible for supporting operational processes by ensuring work is completed accurately, efficiently, and on time. This role analyzes data, investigates issues, collaborates across teams, maintains documentation, and identifies opportunities to improve processes. The Analyst is expected to learn new business areas quickly, take ownership of assigned work, and contribute to a high-quality customer experience.

* Participate in customer and internal meetings to provide status updates and discuss open items.
* Perform quality reviews and support continuous improvement initiatives.
* Assist with onboarding new customers, implementing new processes, and supporting system enhancements.
* Identify opportunities to improve workflows, reduce manual effort, and increase efficiency.
* Build knowledge across multiple operational functions and provide cross team support as business needs evolve.

**Qualifications**
**What you’ll bring to the table:**

* 1 to 3 years of experience in operations, business analysis, customer support, finance, healthcare, supply chain, or a related field.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience, preferred.
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills with the ability to investigate and resolve issues.
* High attention to detail and commitment to producing accurate work.
* Ability to learn new systems, business processes, and industry concepts quickly.
* Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, lookups, sorting, and filtering. Pivot tables are a plus.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfort working independently while collaborating effectively with cross functional teams.
* Ability to demonstrate accountability, curiosity, adaptability, and a continuous improvement mindset.

Additional Information
  
  
**What does IntegriChain have to offer?**

* Mission driven: Work with the purpose of helping to improve patients' lives!
* Excellent and affordable medical benefits + non-medical perks including Flexible Paid Time Off and much more!

title: Process and Data Officer
description:
**Description**
***Join Envalior – Imagine The Future!***
Are you passionate about pioneering change in a constantly evolving environment? At Envalior, we are seeking a talented Process and Data Officer to join our dynamic Supply Chain team.
  
  
At Envalior, the future of high-performance materials isn't just being shaped; it's being pioneered. A belief in fostering an environment where every voice is heard and ideas are valued is integral to our culture. Empowerment is the driving force behind our pioneering spirit, allowing our teams to take initiative, explore new solutions, and revel in the thrill of constant innovation.
  
  
Join us and be a part of a team committed to making a positive impact—where safety, sustainability, collaboration, and empowerment intersect to drive innovation.
  
  
**Requirements**
Purpose of the position
  
  
The Process & Data Officer serves as a subject matter expert for master data across multiple business processes. The role ensures high-quality master and configuration data and supports agile, accurate processing of master data requests. The job holder must possess solid knowledge of key business processes (PtP, OtC, SCM) to provide the right data foundation for efficient and compliant process execution.
  
  
**The Key Areas Of Accountability/responsibility**
Governance (approx. 10%)
  
  

* Validate whether correct and complete master data requests have been submitted.
* Assess whether email-based requests can be executed directly or require workflow routing.
* Identify and clean up non-used master data elements; align conditions and decisions with relevant stakeholders.

Continuous Improvement (approx. 15%)
  
  

* Simplify complex processes, automate routine activities, and proactively eliminate redundancies.
* Identify repetitive business activities and transfer them into automated tasks using available tooling (e.g., RPA).

Reporting (approx. 15%)
  
  

* Monitor and report data quality based on business rules describing logical relationships across data fields.
* Develop detailed reports to support clean-up actions beyond high-level KPIs.
* Provide ad hoc reporting to support projects, issue resolution, and fact-based decision making.

Project Support (approx. 20%)
  
  

* Contribute to project activities; master data is critical to all process and system implementations.
* Support data preparation, data mapping, and validation activities.
* Play an active role during UAT and be a key contributor during cutover planning and execution.

Operational Support (approx. 40%)
  
  

* Support SAP users in understanding and applying master data correctly.
* Assist in troubleshooting by identifying root causes, even when issues are not directly data-related.
* Interpret incoming requests and determine which master data objects require updates (vendors, customers, materials, contracts, info records, source lists, etc.).
* Choose the most effective data entry method (manual entry vs. upload tools).
* Maintain shipment routes across multiple regions.
* Maintain approval tables (SAP/SRM) and the department’s SharePoint environment.
* Maintain the PANDA master data workflow application (users, roles, tasks, workflows).
* Ensure timely responses to all support questions submitted through the central mailbox.

**THE IDEAL CANDIDATE**
Core Competencies
  
  

* Analytical & Conceptual Thinking
* Stakeholder Management & Influence
* Process Discipline & Quality Orientation
* Problem-Solving & Troubleshooting Mindset
* Ownership & Accountability
* Continuous Improvement Attitude
* Communication & Service Orientation

Technical Skills
  
  

* SAP Master Data Expertise
* Data Quality & Reporting Tools
* Workflow & Process Tools
* Basic Automation or Scripting Knowledge (advantage)
* Documentation Skills.

**Additional Requirements**

* Strong command of English (written and verbal); additional languages are an asset.
* Ability to work effectively in a global environment across multiple time zones.
* High level of organization and ability to manage high request volumes (6,000+ emails, 10,000+ workflows annually).
* Ability to balance standardization with practical support in a non-harmonized business environment.

**Benefits**
**WHY ENVALIOR?**
**Competitive Compensation**
Join us at Envalior and enjoy competitive compensation packages, inclusive of a global bonus program and individual performance bonuses, ensuring your hard work is recognized and rewarded.
  
  
**Comprehensive Benefits**
Your well-being matters to us. At Envalior, we provide an array of benefits supporting your financial security, health, and overall well-being. This includes retirement plans, health programs, life insurance, and comprehensive medical care.
  
  
**Work-Life Balance & Flexibility**
Maintain a healthy balance between work and personal life with Envalior's commitment to supporting your schedule.
  
  
**Training & Development Opportunities**
At Envalior, your growth matters. We encourage and invest in your professional and personal development. We support our employees in their growth and personal development through ongoing investment in their knowledge and skills via training, coaching, and mentoring.
  
  
**Diversity & Inclusion**
At Envalior, our people drive our success, so it’s only right that we provide a diverse and inclusive working environment and foster a culture of belonging, openness, and respect. We value diversity as a cornerstone of our success. We are committed to nurturing and empowering every individual to reach their full potential.
  
  
**APPLY NOW!**
Ready to pioneer change with Envalior? Join us in our mission to drive innovation, sustainability, and excellence. Apply today and become a part of our transformative journey towards a more sustainable future.
  
  
Submit your application online by sending your CV and motivation letter in English through our career portal. If you have any questions, feel free to connect directly with our recruiter at Deepanshu.Tripathi@envalior.com
  
  
*Envalior is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.*
If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at Talent.Acquisition@Envalior.com.
  
  
**OUR HERITAGE**
With a combined heritage of over 100 years, Envalior brings together two established global materials players: DSM Engineering Materials and LANXESS High Performance Materials. Our unique combined portfolio of longstanding material-, application-, and design expertise enables our customers to develop and launch sustainable future-proof designs. Envalior is the brand new materials powerhouse that was Launched in early 2023.
  
  
We aim to be a global leader in sustainable and high-performance engineering materials. We imagine the future by shaping the world of today and tomorrow. We’re conscious that this is both a privilege and a responsibility – so, when we imagine the future, we’re guided by our key values to help us create a better world.

title: Senior Specialist, Provider Data Operations (US Healthcare Insurance)
description:
**Our Mission**
You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.
  
  
We’re here to give power to the patient.
  
  
For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.
  
  
Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from
*seeking*
to
*getting*
. We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.
  
  
Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.
  
  
As an Insurance Senior Specialist, you will serve as the subject matter expert for Zocdoc's insurance taxonomy and related systems. You will own the policies, processes, and quality standards that ensure our insurance data is accurate, scalable, and aligned with product strategy. This role combines deep expertise in the U.S. health insurance landscape with strong analytical thinking to improve the patient search experience and strengthen the integrity of our insurance database.
  
  
You will partner closely with Product, Operations, and Engineering teams to define insurance policies, monitor database health, and drive continuous improvements. Your work will directly influence how patients find in-network care by ensuring that our insurance taxonomies, carrier and plan coverage, and provider matching systems remain accurate, scalable, and responsive to changes in the healthcare market.
  
  
**A Day in the Life of a Product Operations Specialist:**

* Define Insurance Policies & Standards: Own the policies governing insurance carriers and plans across the Zocdoc marketplace. Define and maintain rules for adding, modifying, and removing insurance carriers and plans, as well as thresholds for performance-based retention or removal.
* Monitor Insurance Market Trends: Stay informed about developments in the U.S. health insurance landscape, including new carrier launches, plan introductions, mergers, and regulatory changes. Evaluate their impact on Zocdoc's insurance database and recommend proactive updates.
* Drive Cross-functional Strategy: Partner with Product, Engineering, Operations, and Data & Analytics teams to ensure insurance taxonomies support product strategy and accurate patient search experiences. Translate complex insurance policies into clear product requirements, data models, business rules, and acceptance criteria. Advise senior Product and Engineering leaders on recommendations and tradeoffs, influence roadmap priorities, and shape taxonomy architecture, validation logic, tooling, and system controls. Define reporting and monitor performance, while leading incident reviews and escalations involving inaccurate insurance availability or provider matching to identify root causes and mitigate future risk.
* Own Insurance Database Health: Define, monitor, and report on key insurance database health metrics. Conduct regular reviews with Product, Operations, and Data partners to identify trends, prioritize improvements, and maintain high data quality.
* Improve Processes & Quality: Identify systemic issues affecting insurance data quality and lead continuous improvement initiatives. Refine policies and operational processes to improve efficiency, reduce manual effort, and increase accuracy across workflows.
* Perform Quality Assurance & Expert Reviews: Act as the organization's expert on U.S. health insurance, review and validate outputs from operational teams for new insurance plan additions and complex taxonomy decisions. Serve as the final escalation point for policy interpretation and insurance-related quality questions.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree from a reputed institution with a strong academic record.
* 5+ years of experience in the U.S. healthcare industry, with deep expertise in Insurance Payor Management, Payor Analytics, Database
* Management or related functions at payor or plan level.
* Strong understanding of U.S. commercial insurance plans, carriers, provider networks.
* Strong analytical mindset with experience using metrics and data to drive strategic decisions and operational improvements.
* Experience partnering cross-functionally with Product, Operations, Analytics, and Engineering teams to deliver scalable solutions.
* Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to balance strategic thinking and operational execution.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to influence stakeholders across functions.
* Experience with SQL, Excel, Google Sheets, Looker or other analytical tools is a must.
* Familiarity and proven usage of AI-driven tools and workflow automation is a must.

**Benefits**

* An incredible team of smart and supportive people
* A competitive compensation package, including attractive medical insurance
* Amazing perks – think catered lunch every day, Ping Pong, etc.
* Daycare/creche facility for kids
* The chance to create a better healthcare experience for millions of patients!
* Corporate wellness programs with Headspace
* Cellphone and wifi reimbursement
* Competitive parental leave
* Sabbatical leave (over 5 years)
* Annual sponsored health check-ups
* Zocdoc is certified as a Great Place to Work 2025-2026

**About Us**
Zocdoc is the country’s leading digital health marketplace that helps patients easily find and book the care they need. Each month, millions of patients use our free service to find nearby, in-network providers, compare choices based on verified patient reviews, and instantly book in-person or video visits online. Providers participate in Zocdoc’s Marketplace to reach new patients to grow their practice, fill their last-minute openings, and deliver a better healthcare experience. Founded in 2007 with a mission to give power to the patient, our work each day in pursuit of that mission is guided by our six core values. Zocdoc is a private company backed by some of the world’s leading investors, and we believe we’re still only scratching the surface of what we plan to accomplish.
  
  
Zocdoc is a mission-driven organization dedicated to building teams as diverse as the patients and providers we aim to serve. In the spirit of one of our core values -
*Together, Not Alone*
, we are a company that prides itself on being highly collaborative, and we believe that diverse perspectives, experiences and contributors make our community and our platform better. We’re an equal opportunity employer committed to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. Applicants are considered for employment regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, veteran status, or any other class protected by applicable laws.

* Evaluate emerging environment management and virtualization technologies.
* Improve testing productivity through automation and intelligent engineering solutions.
* Champion innovative practices that accelerate software delivery and quality outcomes.

Pune, IN
  
  
YASH Technologies is a leading technology integrator specializing in helping clients reimagine operating models, enhance competitiveness, optimize costs, foster exceptional stakeholder experiences, and drive business transformation.
  
  
At YASH, we’re a cluster of the brightest stars working with cutting-edge technologies. Our purpose is anchored in a single truth – bringing real positive changes in an increasingly virtual world and it drives us beyond generational gaps and disruptions of the future.
  
  
**We are looking forward to hire Master Data Management (MDM) Professionals in the following areas :**
**Experience Level 8+ Years**
**Job Title: Lead Quality Engineer / MDM Test Engineer**
****Role Overview****
We're looking for a detail-oriented Quality Engineer with experience in Master Data Management testing to ensure the reliability, accuracy, and performance of our Reltio MDM platform. You'll be responsible for designing and executing comprehensive test strategies across data models, integrations, match & merge rules, workflows, and data quality processes — ensuring that master data is accurate, consistent, and fit for business use.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****

* Design, develop, and execute test strategies and test plans for Reltio MDM implementations, including unit, functional, integration, regression, and performance testing.
* Validate Reltio data models, entity configurations, relationships, attributes, and reference data for accuracy and completeness.
* Test match & merge rules, survivorship logic, and deduplication processes to ensure golden record quality meets business expectations.
* Validate integration pipelines (batch and real-time) between Reltio and source/target systems (ERP, CRM, data lakes, APIs) for data accuracy, completeness, and timeliness.
* Perform data quality testing — profiling, validation, and reconciliation — across source systems and the Reltio MDM hub.
* Test Reltio workflows, business rules, stewardship processes, and exception handling scenarios.
* Develop and maintain automated test scripts for regression and data validation testing using tools such as Python, SQL, or Selenium.
* Perform API testing of Reltio REST APIs using tools like Postman, REST Assured, or similar.
* Conduct performance and load testing on Reltio integrations and platform configurations.
* Log, track, and manage defects through the full lifecycle using JIRA or similar tools, working closely with developers to ensure timely resolution.
* Collaborate with business analysts, data stewards, and developers to understand requirements and define acceptance criteria.
* Validate data migration activities — pre-migration, mid-migration, and post-migration — ensuring data integrity and completeness.
* Participate in UAT (User Acceptance Testing) and support business stakeholders during testing cycles.
* Develop and maintain test documentation including test cases, test scripts, test data, and test summary reports.
* Contribute to the definition and enforcement of QA best practices within MDM projects.

****Required Skills & Experience****

* 3+ years of experience in software or data quality engineering, with at least 1–2 years of exposure to MDM platforms (Reltio preferred, or Informatica MDM, Semarchy, SAP MDG, Stibo STEP, or similar).
* Hands-on understanding of Reltio MDM concepts — entities, relationships, match & merge, survivorship, hierarchies, and workflows — sufficient to design meaningful test cases.
* Strong SQL skills for data validation, reconciliation, and querying across relational/cloud databases.
* Experience testing REST APIs using Postman, REST Assured, or similar API testing tools.
* Experience with test management tools (JIRA, TestRail, Zephyr, or similar).
* Familiarity with ETL/integration testing (validating data pipelines, transformation logic, and data flow accuracy).
* Experience with data quality testing concepts — completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and uniqueness.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to define test scenarios from complex business and data requirements.
* Good understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and experience working within sprint-based delivery teams.

****Preferred Qualifications****

* Experience with test automation frameworks (Selenium, PyTest, or similar) and scripting in Python or Groovy.
* Exposure to performance/load testing tools (JMeter, Gatling, or similar) for MDM and integration pipelines.
* Reltio platform certification or formal training is a plus.
* Experience testing Snowflake, AWS, Azure, or GCP data platforms integrated with Reltio.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, etc.) for automated testing workflows.
* Experience with data migration testing in large-scale MDM implementation projects.
* Knowledge of data privacy/compliance frameworks (GDPR, HIPAA) and their impact on data quality and testing requirements.
* Experience in industries such as Manufacturing, life sciences, healthcare, retail, or financial services.

**Key Competencies**

* Meticulous attention to detail and strong data analytical mindset.
* Ability to understand complex data relationships and identify edge cases in match/merge scenarios.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills to work across data engineering, business, and architecture teams.
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple test deliverables across concurrent project tracks.
* Proactive in identifying risks, raising issues early, and proposing pragmatic testing solutions.

At YASH, you are empowered to create a career that will take you to where you want to go while working in an inclusive team environment. We leverage career-oriented skilling models and optimize our collective intelligence aided with technology for continuous learning, unlearning, and relearning at a rapid pace and scale.

* Flexible work arrangements, Free spirit, and emotional positivity
* Agile self-determination, trust, transparency, and open collaboration
* All Support needed for the realization of business goals,
* Stable employment with a great atmosphere and ethical corporate culture

title: Technical Consultant
description:
At EVERSANA, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work across the globe. We’re fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. How? Our global team of more than 7,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. We are grounded in our cultural beliefs and serve more than 650 clients ranging from innovative biotech start-ups to established pharmaceutical companies. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!
  
  
Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.
  
  
**Job Description**
**THE POSITION**
**:**
**Technical Consultant**
plays a crucial role in pharmacovigilance, particularly in the context of the Argus Safety System. The responsibilities of an Argus administrator, as outlined, involve various aspects of configuration, data management, automation, and collaboration with case processing teams.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Configure, maintain, and optimize Oracle Argus Safety to support pharmacovigilance operations and regulatory reporting requirements.
* Analyze business requirements and implement Argus configurations aligned with regulatory standards and industry best practices.
* Design, develop, and enhance Argus workflows, business rules, and automation solutions to improve operational efficiency.
* Participate in end-to-end pharmacovigilance data migration projects, including data assessment, profiling, mapping, transformation, validation, and reconciliation activities.
* Collaborate with business, safety, and technical teams to define migration requirements and source-to-target mapping specifications.
* Perform data extraction, transformation, validation, and reconciliation activities to ensure accurate and compliant migration of safety data into Argus Safety.
* Develop and execute SQL queries for data analysis, reporting, migration validation, and issue investigation.
* Identify and resolve application, configuration, integration, and data-related issues within the Argus Safety environment.
* Support system integrations between Argus Safety and external applications using web services and related technologies.
* Develop, customize, and maintain reports and dashboards using Oracle BI Publisher (BIP) to support operational and regulatory reporting needs.
* Participate in testing activities, including system integration testing (SIT), user acceptance testing (UAT), and migration validation testing.
* Ensure system configurations, migrated data, and business processes comply with global pharmacovigilance regulations, including FDA, EMA, and other applicable requirements.
* Support validation documentation and compliance activities for audits, inspections, system upgrades, and regulatory reviews.
* Collaborate with Oracle Support and internal stakeholders for incident management, patch deployments, and system enhancements.
* Provide end-user support, training, and documentation to promote effective system utilization and knowledge sharing.
* Monitor regulatory updates, Argus product enhancements, and industry trends to recommend continuous process and system improvements.
* Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

*Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.*
**Qualifications**
The requirements listed below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skill and/or abilities required.
  
  

* Participate in end-to-end pharmacovigilance data migration projects, including data assessment, profiling, mapping, transformation, validation, and reconciliation activities.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, Pharmacovigilance, Regulatory Affairs, and IT teams to gather migration and reporting requirements.
* Develop and maintain source-to-target mapping documents, data migration specifications, and reconciliation reports.
* Execute data extraction, transformation, cleansing, and validation activities to ensure data quality and integrity throughout the migration lifecycle.
* Perform SQL-based data analysis, data validation, reconciliation, and issue investigation to support migration and reporting activities.
* Identify, analyze, and resolve data discrepancies, mapping issues, and migration defects.
* Support migration testing activities, including System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and post-migration validation.
* Conduct data reconciliation between source and target systems to ensure completeness, accuracy, and compliance of migrated data.
* Design, develop, customize, and maintain Oracle BI Publisher (BIP) reports, line listings, and regulatory outputs based on business requirements.
* Create and optimize complex data models, templates, and report layouts within Oracle BI Publisher.
* Support generation and validation of operational, regulatory, and management reports using BIP and database queries.
* Develop and optimize SQL queries, stored procedures, and scripts to support reporting, migration, and data analysis requirements.
* Collaborate with technical teams to support integrations, data interfaces, and reporting solutions across pharmacovigilance systems.
* Participate in system upgrades, enhancements, and migration projects, ensuring reporting and data validation requirements are met.
* Prepare and maintain migration documentation, validation evidence, test scripts, SOPs, and technical specifications.
* Ensure migrated data and reporting processes comply with pharmacovigilance regulations and organizational data governance standards.
* Provide end-user support and training related to migration deliverables, reporting solutions, and BI Publisher reports.
* Monitor reporting performance and recommend process improvements to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and compliance.
* Stay current with Oracle BI Publisher enhancements, data migration best practices, and emerging pharmacovigilance technologies.
* PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:
* Bachelor’s degree/Masters Degree in IT Stream
* 3+ years of relevant experience in drug safety IT Systems

**Additional Information**
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
  
  
Our team is aware of recent fraudulent job offers in the market, misrepresenting EVERSANA. Recruitment fraud is a sophisticated scam commonly perpetrated through online services using fake websites, unsolicited e-mails, or even text messages claiming to be a legitimate company. Some of these scams request personal information and even payment for training or job application fees. Please know EVERSANA would never require personal information nor payment of any kind during the employment process. We respect the personal rights of all candidates looking to explore careers at EVERSANA.
  
  
From EVERSANA’s inception, Diversity, Equity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds who share a passion for improving the lives of patients and leading innovation within the healthcare industry. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion, and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees’ points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

title: QA AIML Consultant
description:
Job Description: AI SDET Engineer
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
We are seeking an experienced AI Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to define and advance quality engineering across web, API, mobile, cloud, and AI-enabled products. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with deep test automation expertise and can validate both deterministic software and probabilistic AI behavior. This role partners closely with Engineering, Product, Design, SRE, Security, and Data/ML teams to build quality into the full delivery lifecycle, improve release confidence, and lead the evolution of our testing strategy, tooling, and people.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end quality strategy, including risk-based test planning, requirement traceability, coverage analysis, test matrices, release-readiness criteria, and production validation.
* Design and maintain scalable automation frameworks for UI, API, mobile, integration, and end-to-end testing using tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Appium, TestNG, and pytest.
* Establish maintainable test architecture through modular design, page or screen objects, reusable fixtures, parametrization, test-data management, and appropriate use of BDD, mocking, and stubbing.
* Define API and contract-testing practices for REST and GraphQL services using tools such as Postman, REST Assured, or Karate, while promoting effective unit testing and close collaboration with developers.
* Automate test execution, reporting, quality gates, and deployment controls in Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps pipelines.
* Lead performance, load, reliability, resiliency, and security validation using tools such as k6, JMeter, or Gatling; incorporate chaos testing and OWASP-aligned security checks where appropriate.
* Use logs, traces, and metrics from platforms such as ELK, Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana, and Jaeger to diagnose failures, reproduce production issues, and drive root-cause analysis.
* Build automated evaluation harnesses and regression suites for machine-learning models, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation systems, and agentic workflows.
* Define quality KPIs and service expectations, including escape rate, flaky-test rate, automation effectiveness, mean time to detect, and release quality; communicate trends and corrective actions to stakeholders.
* Create effective defect triage and release-readiness processes, influence product and design decisions, and ensure quality risks are visible and acted upon.
* Protect personal and sensitive information through secure test-data generation, access controls, masking, redaction, retention practices, and GDPR/PII-aware validation.
* Mentor and lead QA and SDET engineers, contribute to hiring and onboarding, and strengthen engineering practices across distributed cross-functional teams.

**Core Qualifications**

* 5+ years of professional experience in software quality engineering, test automation, or an SDET role, with evidence of ownership of complex quality initiatives.
* Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Python, Java, C#, or JavaScript/TypeScript, supported by strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, networking, and operating-system fundamentals.
* Hands-on experience designing test frameworks and maintainable automation architecture with Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Appium, TestNG, pytest, or comparable tools.
* Strong knowledge of test design techniques, risk-based testing, integration and end-to-end strategy, TDD/ATDD practices, requirement traceability, coverage analysis, and test-matrix management.
* Experience testing REST and GraphQL APIs and service contracts with Postman, REST Assured, Karate, or equivalent tooling; ability to use mocks and stubs to isolate dependencies.
* Practical experience with load and performance testing, reliability or chaos testing, security-testing fundamentals, and OWASP principles.
* Experience integrating automated tests and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines and working with Git, Docker, basic Kubernetes concepts, and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform.
* Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills using logs, distributed traces, metrics, and production observability platforms.
* Ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, influence decisions, and partner effectively with Development, SRE, Product, Design, Security, and Data/ML teams.
* Experience working with quality KPIs and SLAs, supporting release-readiness assessments, and participating in defect triage.
* Working knowledge of GDPR and PII obligations, including secure test-data creation, masking, redaction, and least-privilege access.

AI Testing Expertise
  
  

* Experience testing non-deterministic AI systems and translating product expectations into measurable evaluation criteria, representative datasets, scoring rubrics, statistical thresholds, and repeatable acceptance gates.
* Ability to evaluate large language model quality across correctness, groundedness, faithfulness, relevance, completeness, consistency, latency, token usage, cost, and failure behavior rather than relying on exact-match assertions alone.
* Hands-on understanding of retrieval-augmented generation testing, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, retrieval recall and ranking, context relevance, citation accuracy, answer groundedness, and stale or conflicting knowledge.
* Experience building golden datasets and regression suites; curating, labeling, versioning, and reviewing evaluation data while preventing leakage, contamination, duplication, and unrepresentative test coverage.
* Knowledge of adversarial and safety testing for prompt injection, jailbreaks, indirect injection, sensitive-data disclosure, insecure tool use, hallucinations, harmful content, toxicity, bias, fairness, and model or agent misuse.
* Ability to test agentic and tool-calling workflows, including multi-step planning, permissions, memory and state, tool selection, retries, timeouts, partial failures, human approvals, and safe recovery.
* Experience validating model, prompt, retrieval, and configuration changes through versioned experiments, reproducible environments, baseline comparisons, confidence intervals, and controlled rollout or canary strategies.
* Understanding of model and data drift, feedback-loop risks, online quality monitoring, human-in-the-loop review, and production signals that detect degradation after release.
* Familiarity with AI evaluation and observability tools such as OpenAI Evals, promptfoo, Ragas, DeepEval, LangSmith, Langfuse, MLflow, Weights & Biases, or equivalent frameworks.
* Knowledge of AI-specific privacy and security risks, including training-data exposure, model inversion, membership inference, prompt and response logging, retention controls, and safe use of synthetic data.

Nice-to-Have Skills
  
  

* Experience testing mobile, embedded, distributed, event-driven, or highly regulated systems.
* Experience with cloud-native testing on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud and with ephemeral test environments managed through Kubernetes and Terraform.
* Familiarity with MLOps practices, model registries, feature stores, data validation, experiment tracking, dataset or artifact versioning, and quality-engineering enablement or open-source tooling.

title: SAP QM (Quality Management)
description:
Job Description: SAP Quality Management (QM)
  
  
We are seeking an experienced and results-driven
**SAP Quality Management (QM) Consultant**
to design, configure, implement, and support robust SAP QM solutions across our manufacturing and supply chain operations. In this role, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional business stakeholders to translate quality and operational requirements into scalable SAP processes.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in end-to-end SAP QM functionalities, seamless integration capabilities with adjacent SAP modules, and hands-on experience in S/4HANA implementations, rollouts, enhancements, and production support.
  
  

* Key Responsibilities

Requirements Gathering & Process Design
  
  

* Engage with business stakeholders to analyze, refine, and document business requirements for Quality Management processes.
* Conduct Fit-Gap analysis between current operational workflows and standard SAP functionalities.
* Author detailed Functional Specifications (FS) for custom developments, reports, interfaces, and enhancements (RICEF objects).

SAP QM Core Configuration & Management
  
  

* Configure and maintain core SAP QM master data and functionalities, including:

+ Inspection Plans, Master Inspection Characteristics (MICs), Sampling Procedures, and Schemes.
+ Catalogs, Selected Sets, and Catalog Profiles.
+ Quality Info Records (QIRs) for Vendor Quality Management.

* Configure and support key QM operational workflows:

+ Quality Planning & Quality Inspection (Incoming, In-Process, and Final Inspections).
+ Results Recording, Defect Recording, and Usage Decisions (UD).
+ Quality Notifications, Root Cause Analysis, and Corrective Action workflows.
+ Quality Certificates creation and processing.

Module Integration & Traceability
  
  

* Ensure seamless cross-module integration between SAP QM and key supply chain/manufacturing modules:

+ Production Planning (PP): In-process inspection lots, routing integrations.
+ Materials Management (MM): Goods receipt inspections, vendor evaluation, stock transfers.
+ Sales & Distribution (SD): Delivery inspections, customer complaints, quality certificates.
+ Plant Maintenance (PM): Calibration inspections and equipment maintenance integration.
+ Extended Warehouse Management (EWM / WM): Warehouse inspection processes, inbound/outbound lot management.

* Oversee and configure Batch Management, including batch determination, classification, and end-to-end material traceability.

Implementation, Testing & Production Support
  
  

* Participate across all project phases: implementation, global rollouts, upgrades, and post-go-live support.
* Execute Unit Testing, Integration Testing, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Collaborate with ABAP development teams to build and test custom solutions, reports, and system interfaces.
* Provide incident management, ticket resolution, and root cause analysis within defined SLA timelines.
* Support system governance and project documentation using SAP Solution Manager / ALM.

Training & Documentation
  
  

* Develop detailed end-user documentation, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), business process charts, and training manuals.
* Conduct training sessions and knowledge-transfer workshops for business key users and end-users.
* Required Qualifications & Skills

Functional & Domain Expertise
  
  

* SAP QM Expertise: Proven experience in SAP QM module configuration, maintenance, and support across manufacturing or supply chain environments.
* Core Capabilities: In-depth knowledge of Inspection Types, Inspection Lots, Results Recording, Usage Decisions, Quality Notifications, Quality Certificates, Defect Management, and Quality Info Records.
* Master Data Management: Deep proficiency in Inspection Plans, MICs, Sampling Schemes, Catalogs, and Selected Sets.
* Traceability: Strong understanding of Batch Management, batch classification, and full forward/backward supply chain traceability.
* Domain Knowledge: solid understanding of core manufacturing quality management standards and supply chain operations.

Integration Knowledge
  
  

* Hands-on integration experience between SAP QM and:

+ SAP Production Planning (PP)
+ SAP Materials Management (MM)
+ SAP Sales & Distribution (SD)
+ SAP Plant Maintenance (PM)
+ SAP Extended Warehouse Management / Warehouse Management (EWM / WM)

* Exposure to SAP S/4HANA enterprise environments.

Technical & System Exposure
  
  

* Experience writing Functional Specifications (FS) and specifying requirements for RICEF objects.
* Hands-on experience with interface testing and debugging support alongside ABAP teams.
* Proficiency with SAP Solution Manager / Application Lifecycle Management (ALM).

Soft Skills & Competencies
  
  

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to bridge business and technical requirements.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting abilities.
* Demonstrated ability to manage deliverables within strict SLA timelines in production environments.
* Preferred Experience
* Participation in at least one full-lifecycle SAP S/4HANA implementation or migration project.
* Experience in regulated manufacturing environments (e.g., Automotive, Life Sciences, Chemical, or Consumer Goods).

**About the Role:**

This position is responsible for ensuring cGMP compliance across Drug Substance manufacturing operations through effective shop floor quality oversight, documentation review, and quality systems management. The role supports the manufacture of biosimilars and biologics in a globally regulated environment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Shop Floor Quality Oversight-

* Perform manufacturing line clearance activities for Drug Substance operations.
* Ensure effective execution and compliance of in-process quality checks during manufacturing.
* Conduct routine GMP and compliance rounds, document observations, and drive timely corrective actions.
* Ensure continuous adherence to cGMP requirements and regulatory expectations on the shop floor.

Documentation & Validation-

* Review online Batch Manufacturing Records (BMRs) for accuracy, completeness, and compliance.
* Review and approve Process Validation and Cleaning Validation protocols and reports.
* Review and manage SOPs, protocols, reports, and other GMP documentation related to manufacturing operations.

Quality Systems & Compliance-

* Initiate, review, and manage Change Controls, Deviations, Incidents, and CAPAs, ensuring timely investigation and closure.
* Participate in quality investigations, root cause analysis, and implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
* Perform risk assessments for critical manufacturing and quality processes.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives to strengthen quality systems and operational excellence.

Product Quality & Regulatory Support-

* Prepare and support Annual Product Quality Review (APQR/PQR) activities.
* Ensure inspection readiness and support audits by maintaining robust compliance practices.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to maintain a strong quality culture across operations.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Experience in Biosimilar and/or Biologics manufacturing environments.
* Hands-on exposure to Drug Substance (DS) Shop Floor QA/IPQA activities.
* Experience in Deviations, CAPA, Change Controls, Investigations, and Risk Assessments.
* Knowledge of Process Validation, Cleaning Validation, and regulatory compliance requirements.
* Exposure to USFDA, EMA, WHO, or other global regulatory environments will be preferred.

**Why Join Us?**

* Opportunity to work in a growing biopharmaceutical organization focused on biosimilars and biologics.
* Exposure to advanced Drug Substance manufacturing operations and global quality standards.
* Collaborative and innovation-driven environment with opportunities for continuous learning and professional growth.

The ideal candidate will have deep functional and technical expertise in Murex Back Office modules, a strong understanding of capital markets products, and hands-on experience in managing Murex implementation, upgrades, and support.
