* Familiarity with Agile or DevOps methodologies.

title: Technical SAP Signavio Architect/Techno-Functional Consultant
description:
**About the Role**

Job Description: Technical SAP Signavio Architect/Techno-Functional ConsultantPosition OverviewWe are seeking a highly skilled SAP Signavio Tecno-Functional Consultant with extensive hands-on technical capabilities to lead end-to-end business process transformation, optimization, and process mining initiatives. Unlike traditional functional roles, this position demands a deep understanding of data architectures, systems integration, and hands-on technical development.The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between business operations and technical data engineering, actively building data pipelines, profiling source data, setting up complex system integrations via SAP BTP, and writing advanced queries to power operational dashboards and process intelligence metrics.

**Responsibilities**

* Key Responsibilities
* 1. Module-Specific Functional Management
* SAP Signavio Process Manager: Establish and enforce workspace modeling conventions, govern the central corporate Dictionary for reusable business terms/objects, and model end-to-end process hierarchies using BPMN 2.0 and DMN (Decision Model and Notation). Conduct process simulations and perform structured "As-Is" vs. "To-Be" diagram comparisons to evaluate impact.
* SAP Signavio Process Insights: Configure rapid connections to core SAP ERP/S/4HANA instances to gain immediate, automated visibility into business processes. Analyze standard out-of-the-box performance indicators (such as automation rates, backlogs, and throughput), interpret industry benchmarking data, and execute standard correction or innovation recommendations.
* SAP Signavio Process Intelligence: Lead advanced process mining discovery initiatives across multi-system environments. Execute detailed conformance checks to analyze actual execution against standard target models, and identify process execution leakage including compliance violations, unwanted loops, and manual workarounds.
* 2. Process Mining & Data Profiling (Technical Hands-on)
* Perform exhaustive data profiling and structural data analysis across SAP and non-SAP source environments to validate data quality and completeness before process ingestion.
* Design, build, and maintain data ingestion pipelines for SAP Signavio Process Intelligence, mapping transactional data to event logs (Case ID, Activity, Timestamp).
* Identify data anomalies, concurrency issues, and gaps in transactional logs, implementing robust transformations to resolve them.
* 3. Integration & SAP BTP Engineering
* Configure, establish, and optimize secure data connections between SAP Signavio and various backend applications (including third-party ERPs, CRMs, legacy databases, and cloud services).
* Leverage SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) for enterprise integration, data orchestration, data federation, and custom extension developments.
* Implement API-based integrations and utilize JDBC/ODBC connectors, secure file transfers, and cloud ingestion agents to capture real-time or batch transactional records.
* 4. Query Development & Analytics
* Write, debug, and optimize complex queries using SIGNAL (Signavio Process Mining Query Language) and standard SQL to extract process insights and calculate critical KPIs.
* Develop advanced process dashboards, custom metrics, and automated alerts within SAP Signavio Process Intelligence to expose process bottlenecks, variations, and compliance violations.
* Build predictive metrics and custom logic to track process behavior and trigger operational actions based on data patterns.
* 5. Process Modeling & Functional Analysis
* Lead collaborative process discovery workshops with business stakeholders to model "As-Is" and "To-Be" business processes using BPMN 2.0 standards within SAP Signavio Process Manager.
* Translate analytical findings from process mining into actionable business optimization strategies, collaborating with functional process owners.
* Align custom developments with standard SAP Best Practices and Signavio Value Accelerators to accelerate digital transformation milestones (e.g., SAP S/4HANA migrations).



**Qualifications**

* Required Technical & Functional QualificationsExperience: Minimum of 5 to 10 years of professional experience in Business Process Management (BPM) and Process Mining, with at least 5 years of direct, hands-on technical implementation experience using the SAP Signavio Suite.

**Required Skills**

* Functional Competencies:
* Extensive knowledge of Process Manager, including business architecture design, simulation setups, and DMN decision tables.
* Deep proficiency in Process Insights, including setting up automated data extractions, analyzing standard process flows, tracking master data categories, and navigating the Variant Explorer.
* Masterful command of Process Intelligence functional configurations, identifying root causes, managing metrics, and aligning data-driven findings with stakeholders.
* Signavio Toolset Mastery: Proven expertise across SAP Signavio Process Intelligence (specifically the ETL layer), Process Manager, and Collaboration Hub.
* Database & Query Skills: Exceptional proficiency in writing complex queries in standard SQL and SIGNAL. Deep understanding of relational database management systems (RDBMS), data warehousing concepts, and schema design.
* SAP BTP & Middleware: Practical, hands-on experience using SAP BTP for data integration, orchestration, or application deployment. Familiarity with SAP Integration Suite (Cloud Integration) is highly advantageous.
* Third-Party Integrations: Demonstrated track record connecting Signavio to non-SAP systems (e.g., Salesforce, ServiceNow, Oracle, or custom legacy databases) via REST/SOAP APIs and standard database connectors.
* Data Engineering: Experience in ETL/ELT development, data profiling tools, data cleansing methodology, and transforming raw transactional tables into event logs.



**Preferred Skills**

* Preferred Professional QualificationsPreferred - Official certification in SAP SignavioPrior functional experience in core enterprise process cycles such as Order-to-Cash (O2C), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), or Record-to-Report (R2R).Experience assisting organizations through large-scale migrations from SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA using process mining insights.
* Core Soft SkillsStrong analytical and problem-solving mindset capable of drilling down into low-level data anomalies while maintaining a high-level operational perspective.Excellent communication and presentation skills, with a proven ability to translate complex technical data structures into clear business insights for executive stakeholders.Comfortable working in agile, fast-paced environments with cross-functional global teams.

title: Software Solutions Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Software Solutions Engineer to support NVIDIA AI Enterprise customers and deployments across cloud and datacenter environments. This is a dual role: (1) Support, triage and resolve complex customer software issues end-to-end, and (2) build software features, automation, diagnostics, reproducible test cases, and deployment tooling—to improve product readiness and scale support across enterprise environments.
  
  
You will work across compute and cloud-native technologies in CSP environments, including container platforms/orchestrators, enterprise system software, and GPU-accelerated AI frameworks and inference services used to run production AI workloads at scale. In this customer-facing role, you will work closely with customers and internal engineering teams to understand issues, explain root causes, drive resolution, and collaborate on fixes and improvements. Success in this role requires strong debugging skills, crisp communication, and ownership of technically deep escalations from inception to closure.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Develop and maintain product-facing features and deployment assets for AI Enterprise supportability (e.g., scripts, configuration guidance, Kubernetes manifests/Helm charts, and reproducible test cases)
* Develop and maintain Python-based tooling/automation (validators, log collectors, repro harnesses) to improve NVIDIA AI Enterprise deployment reliability across NGC and container orchestrators (e.g., Kubernetes)
* Contribute code-level fixes, patches, or pull requests (as appropriate) in collaboration with engineering to address customer-impacting issues and improve product readiness
* Support enterprise customers deploying NVIDIA AI Enterprise in datacenter and CSP environments, including Kubernetes-based and containerized production AI platforms
* Take ownership of customer issues from inception to resolution: reproduce in lab/cloud, collect diagnostics, provide mitigations, and partner with engineering on fixes
* Create high-quality bug reports and RFEs with clear repro steps, environment details (CSP/Kubernetes/GPU), impact analysis, and supporting artifacts
* Develop customer-facing and internal documentation (KBs, runbooks, deployment guidance) to improve time-to-value and reduce recurring issues
* Be on call one weekend per month in the event a customer has a Sev1 outage and requires engineering assistance

**What We Need To See**

* BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
* At least 5+ years system software development and troubleshooting experience, ideally with some customer facing
* Strong computer science fundamentals and programming/scripting skills (Python required; Bash; Go/C++ a plus) to automate investigations and build diagnostics/repro tools
* Strong troubleshooting fundamentals (networking, concurrency, OS concepts) and a structured approach to isolating issues across application, platform, and infrastructure layers
* Deep understanding of at least two of the following: data centers/servers, distributed systems, virtualization, deep learning frameworks, containers (Docker/Kubernetes), hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), and CI/CD for reliable deployments

* Reviews product demo against acceptance criteria for the feature set

* A background in financial services is desirable; knowledge/experience in actively managing websites or mobile apps is a must.

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

**Senior QA Engineer**

In this role, you will work on validating distributed system components by developing test strategies, building automation, and executing performance and reliability tests. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys problem-solving, automation, and working on complex systems at scale.

title: Product Analyst
description:
**About us:**

At PadCare, we’re on a mission to make hygiene sustainable. Founded in 2018, we have developed India’s first patented sanitary napkin recycling technology—PadCareX.

But we’re not just solving a waste problem, we’re building a circular economy that champions environmental resilience and social equity. Our service model closes the loop starting from collection, recycling, and transforming single-use sanitary napkins into sustainable materials, while also creating dignified jobs for marginalized waste workers, especially women, across the country.

With 100+ changemakers across 25+ cities, PadCare is driving real impact—for people and the planet. Recognized by Forbes, the World Economic Forum, and more, we believe business can be a force for good. If you do too, PadCare is where your purpose finds a home.

Oh, and you must have seen us on an episode of Shark Tank India, Season 2 - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7q0cmPtpJRo

To learn more about the work that PadCare is doing, check out the website: www.padcarelabs.com

**Role overview & Key Responsibilities:**

We are hiring a full-time Product Analyst to own modules of our internal Order-to-Cash platform, end to end, working directly with the Product Lead. The core of the role is building requirements: understanding the business process, identifying its gaps, and structuring it into a complete system module that accounts for every case, validation and dependency. You will also test what gets built and make sure the delivered solution matches what was defined.

**Key responsibilities**

1. Requirement building (core)

• Understand business workflows across Sales, Onboarding, Operations and Finance, and identify

process gaps and inefficiencies

• Structure each process into a system module with clear flows and flow charts

• Cover every scenario the module must handle (standard, exception and edge cases) before it

goes to development

• Define fields and data structures, validation rules, dependencies and conditions

• Own and maintain the functional specification for each assigned module

2. Testing and quality assurance

• Write and execute functional test cases for every release

• Run end-to-end workflow testing and user acceptance testing (UAT)

• Log, prioritise and re-test bugs through the periodic bug-fix cycles

3. Development partner coordination

• Work with the external development team on assigned modules

• Track tasks, follow-ups and requirement clarifications

• Ensure the delivered solution matches the defined requirement

4. Data checks for owned modules

• Validate data for the modules you own, including post-go-live accuracy checks

• Work alongside the data management team where module data is involved

**What we're looking for:**

**Must-have**

• 1–3 years in a product, business analyst or functional/QA role on software or ERP projects

• Hands-on experience writing functional specs or BRDs and test cases

• Experience working with development teams through build, testing and release

• Strong analytical and logical thinking; able to structure problems into clear workflows

• Basic understanding of APIs and system design: data flow, validations, logic layers

• Attention to detail and execution focus

• Clear communication across business and tech teams

**Good-to-have**

• Exposure to ERP tools, especially Zoho Books

• Familiarity with Order-to-Cash or billing processes

• Basic SQL

• Exposure to AI or automation use cases (document processing, workflow automation)

Tools you will use

• HTML (basic UI understanding)

• AI tools for productivity and documentation

• Excel and basic analytics tools

**Culture Fit:**
Must align with PadCare’s values – Integrity, Entrepreneurship, Collaboration, Customer-First, Innovation.

**Work Mode:**
Full-time; based in Pune.

**Why join us:**

* **Compensation:**
  Competitive salary in line with industry standards.
* **Growth Path:**
  Opportunity to scale into Head of Research and beyond as PadCare expands globally.
* **Purpose With Impact:**
  Join a mission-driven team transforming menstrual hygiene through sustainable solutions that uplift women’s health, the environment, and sanitation workers' dignity.
* **Eco-Warrior in Action:**
  Help recycle millions of sanitary pads and actively reduce landfill waste and carbon emissions—real impact, not just buzzwords.
* **Innovation Meets Heart:**
  Be part of a team that blends empathy with patented 5D recycling tech to build the future of circular economy.
* **Grow With Us:**
  We’re a fast-gowing, venture-backed startup offering real opportunities to scale your career as we scale our impact.
* **A Culture That Cares:**
  Work in a space where collaboration, inclusivity, and purpose aren’t just values—they’re how we roll every day.

Amtech Medidevices Pvt. Ltd. is a research-driven medical device company with over 20 years of experience delivering innovative and reliable surgical solutions. title: SW QA Engineer - Associate , Physics AI
description:
**We are Siemens**
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software.
  
  
Our Shared Engineering Services team is at the forefront of validating and releasing the cutting-edge Simcenter™ portfolio. Our simulation software and test solutions help companies predict product performance across a broad range of engineering domains - from 3D CAE and system simulation to physical testing.
  
  
We are looking for a technically strong Software QA Engineer - Physics AI to help ensure the quality, accuracy, robustness, and reliability of AI-enabled engineering simulation capabilities.
  
  
In this role, you will combine your knowledge of CAE, physics-based simulation, Engineering AI, and software quality to validate AI/ML models and their integration into desktop simulation products. You will work closely with AI/ML engineers, product teams, software developers, and applications engineers to assess whether AI predictions are accurate, robust, physically meaningful, and reliable when compared with traditional simulation or solver results.
  
  
This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys complex technical problem-solving, understands engineering simulation workflows, and wants to contribute to the evolution of AI-enabled physics and simulation software.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Validate Physics AI capabilities: Work closely with AI/ML engineers to understand the underlying physics models, simulation workflows, and algorithms, and validate the accuracy, robustness, fidelity, and consistency of AI predictions against traditional solver or reference results.
* Own end-to-end quality: Drive QA activities across the software development lifecycle, independently planning and executing quality activities to ensure reliable delivery of AI-enabled simulation capabilities.
* Design comprehensive testing: Review user stories, requirements, and design documentation for testability and develop functional, stress, performance, and end-to-end test scenarios aligned with engineering use cases.
* Develop and maintain test automation: Create, execute, and maintain automated tests using scripting and automation frameworks, while improving existing test suites and porting automation to high-performance systems where appropriate.
* Investigate complex technical issues: Go beyond identifying defects by reproducing issues, analyzing logs and system behavior, investigating root causes, and collaborating with Development and AI/ML teams to drive resolution.
* Improve quality engineering practices: Identify potential risks proactively, research complex problems, introduce effective solutions, and champion best practices in software quality, automation, and testing of Physics AI capabilities.
* Collaborate across engineering teams: Work closely with Development, AI/ML Engineering, DevOps, Product Management, Applications Engineering, and other teams in a globally distributed environment.

**Qualifications**

* 4–6+ years of relevant technical experience in CAE, engineering simulation, design verification, Physics AI, Engineering AI, or a related domain, along with hands-on experience in Software Quality Engineering or software validation.
* 1–3+ years of professional experience in Software QA, Quality Engineering, software testing, or test automation, preferably for complex engineering or desktop software products.
* Strong understanding of CAE and engineering simulation workflows, with the ability to analyze simulation results and assess their technical and physical reasonableness.
* Exposure to AI/ML or Engineering AI, with the ability to understand and validate AI-driven predictions against physics-based, simulation, or solver-generated reference results.
* Experience with desktop simulation or engineering software such as Simcenter, CAD/CAE applications, or similar products; experience with HyperView, Simcenter 3D Post, or equivalent post-processing tools is highly valuable.
* Proficiency in Python, C, or similar scripting/programming languages, with hands-on experience developing or maintaining automated tests using PyTest, Ranorex, Selenium, or comparable frameworks.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently, investigate complex technical issues, and contribute effectively in cross-functional teams.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience testing or validating AI/ML models, Physics AI, surrogate models, or AI-enabled engineering applications.
* Experience comparing AI predictions with traditional CAE/CFD/FEA solver results, experimental data, or other engineering reference data.
* Familiarity with Windows and UNIX/Linux environments and cross-platform desktop software testing.
* Experience with JIRA, Xray, Git, and modern test automation frameworks.
* Experience with functional, regression, stress, performance, and system-level testing.
* Strong attention to detail, curiosity, self-motivation, and the ability to quickly learn unfamiliar engineering and software technologies.

**Why Us**
At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work - hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
  
  
**Diversity & Inclusion**
We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities. At Siemens, we believe people who've had real experiences dealing with being different will excel as leaders. Let's foster a culture of creativity and innovation. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

title: RCM Quality Auditor - Payment Posting
description:
In office - Shift hours M-F 730pm IST to 430am IST
  
  
The RCM Quality Auditor Payment Posting checks the work our Revenue Cycle Services teams produce, including coding, charges, claims, payment postings, AR follow-up and denial work, and catches errors before they cost our clients money or create compliance risk.
  
  
The role will score work fairly and consistently, explain clearly what went wrong and why, and help teams fix the underlying problem so it doesn't keep happening. The area you audit will depend on your background and where the business needs coverage, and you may audit more than one.
  
  
**Audit the work**

* Audit plan: Run audits against the approved monthly plan, including random samples, targeted samples (high-dollar accounts, complex specialties or remits, new payers and new clients) and 100% audits for new joiners or associates on a performance improvement plan.
* Source checks: Validate each audited item against source documents such as superbills, encounter forms, EMR notes, charge logs, ERAs/EOBs and payer correspondence.
* Coding and charge entry: Verify demographics, insurance, date and place of service, rendering/billing/referring provider, CPT/HCPCS and ICD-10-CM codes and linkage, modifiers, units, charge amounts and authorisation numbers, along with NCCI, MUE and LCD/NCD requirements.
* Payment posting: Verify billed, allowed and paid amounts, contractual adjustments, patient responsibility, group and CARC/RARC codes, PLB adjustments, secondary claim triggers and deposit reconciliation.
* AR and denials: Confirm that follow-up actions are correct, documented and on time, that denials land in the right work queue, and that appeals meet payer requirements.
* Rejections and exceptions: Review clearinghouse rejections, scrubber edits and auto-post exceptions, and confirm fixes were made correctly and on time.
* Gaps and leakage: Flag missed, duplicate or late charges, suspected underpayments, incorrect write-offs and unreconciled variances.

**Find the root cause and fix it**

* Error classification: Classify errors using the approved scoring matrix: critical or non-critical, financial or non-financial, process-based or knowledge-based.
* Feedback: Give associates and Team Leads clear, evidence-backed feedback within 24–48 hours, and track that it is acknowledged and closed.
* Root cause analysis: Dig into repeat or high-impact errors, find the root cause, and help build and track corrective actions (CAPA) such as retraining, SOP updates and checklist changes. Then check that the fix worked.
* Calibration: Run or join regular calibration sessions with peer auditors, Team Leads, operations and client QA so scoring stays consistent and defensible.
* Training support: Spot skill gaps from audit data, recommend refresher training, help onboard new joiners, and keep job aids and reference guides current.
* Trends: Share payer-level patterns, such as denial spikes, recoupments and underpayments, with the AR and Denial Management teams.

**Report, escalate and stay compliant**

* Records: Keep audit logs, error trackers, feedback sheets and calibration records complete, with evidence for every finding in an audit-ready file structure.
* Reporting: Publish daily, weekly and monthly quality reports and scorecards at associate, team and client level, including RCA reports and trend charts for leadership.
* Escalation: Escalate critical errors right away, especially anything with revenue, compliance or timely filing impact.
* Client support: Prepare quality summaries and action plans for client quality calls, answer client quality questions with data and clear timelines, and submit client scorecards on time.
* Compliance: Follow HIPAA, PHI handling standards, CMS rules and Veradigm information security policies at all times, and support internal and client compliance audits.
* Staying current: Track annual CPT, HCPCS and ICD-10-CM updates and payer policy changes, and flag any needed changes to SOPs and payer rule references.

**Help improve the process**

* Automation: Point out repetitive QA tasks that could be automated, and take part in Lean, Six Sigma and AI-assisted audit pilots.
* Transitions: Support new client transitions, process documentation and knowledge assessments.

**Benefits**
Veradigm believes in empowering our associates with the tools and flexibility to bring the best version of themselves to work. Through our generous benefits package with an emphasis on work/life balance, we give our employees the opportunity to allow their careers to flourish.
  
  

* Quarterly Company-Wide Recharge Days
* Peer-based incentive “Cheer” awards
* Tuition Reimbursement Program

* Also, the individual will be responsible for analysing application behaviour and identify performance bottlenecks across application, database, infrastructure, and network layers.

**Technical Environment**

* Performance Testing Tools: Jmeter
* API/Application: REST APIs, JSON/XML, HTTP/HTTPS, Web applications, Microservices, Postman
* Scripting & Development: JavaScript, Groovy, Python, Shell scripting
* Databases: Oracle, MariaDb; SQL query analysis and database performance analysis
* Database Performance: Oracle AWR/ASH, execution plans, SQL tuning, database CPU/memory/I/O analysis
* Application & JVM Monitoring: JVM, Garbage Collection (GC), Heap/Thread Dumps, JProfiler, Eclipse MAT or equivalent tools
* Infrastructure & Monitoring: Linux, Kubernetes, Docker, OCI/Azure, CPU/Memory/Disk/Network monitoring, Grafana, OEM
* DevOps/Agile: Git, Jenkins
* Cloud: OCI/Azure integrations
* Others: RDP/SSH, Linux command-line utilities, log analysis, performance profiling, capacity planning, and production performance monitoring.

**What You’ll Do**

* Design and execute performance, load, stress, endurance, and scalability tests for enterprise applications.
* Develop and maintain JMeter/API performance test scripts, workload models, test data, and execution scenarios.
* Analyse application performance across application, database, JVM, infrastructure, and network layers.
* Monitor system behaviour during load tests and identify CPU, memory, database, JVM, I/O, and response-time bottlenecks.
* Perform root-cause analysis of performance issues using application logs, monitoring tools, AWR/ASH reports, thread dumps, heap dumps, and GC logs.
* Work closely with Developers, QA, DBAs, DevOps, and Infrastructure teams to troubleshoot and resolve performance issues.
* Analyse test results and prepare performance reports, dashboards, and recommendations for stakeholders.
* Support capacity planning, scalability assessment, and production-readiness reviews.
* Identify opportunities to automate performance testing, monitoring, and reporting to improve efficiency and repeatability.
* Participate in release planning and provide performance assessment and recommendations for production deployment.
* Communicate performance findings, risks, and recommendations clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, or related field.
* 1-3 years of experience in Performance Testing / Performance Engineering.
* Strong hands-on experience with JMeter and performance test scripting.
* Good understanding of load, stress, endurance, scalability, and volume testing.
* Strong experience in API performance testing using REST/HTTP, JSON/XML, and Postman.
* Good understanding of Java/JVM, including heap, threads, GC, and JVM tuning.
* Experience with JProfiler, Eclipse MAT, thread/heap dumps, and GC logs.
* Experience with Linux/Unix, shell scripting, and application/log analysis.
* Good knowledge of SQL and database performance, preferably Oracle, including AWR/ASH and execution plan analysis on OEM.
* Experience with Grafana, Prometheus, InfluxDB, or equivalent monitoring tools.
* Understanding of Kubernetes/containerized environments and exposure to OCI/Azure is preferred.
* Strong performance troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, analytical, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple performance testing activities within timelines.

**Our Values**
If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success – and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

title: Sr. Analyst, Implementation
description:
What You'll Do
  
  
**Role Summary — The Why Now**
As Avalara scales its Go Live function to support New Product Introductions (NPI) and enterprise-level customer growth, we need Senior Analysts who do more than execute — they lead, design, and elevate. The Go Live Senior Analyst (I3) operates at the intersection of complex enterprise implementation delivery, cross-functional product collaboration, and practice development.
  
  
Where the I3 Analyst owns individual customer implementation success, the I3 Senior Analyst owns the quality and scalability of how implementations are delivered — for the most complex customers, across new and evolving products, and in close partnership with Product Management, Sales, Engineering, and Customer Success.
  
  
This role exists to accelerate Avalara's ability to onboard enterprise customers at scale, introduce new products effectively, and continuously raise the implementation standard across the Go Live team. The I3 is a force multiplier: their impact is felt not just in their own portfolio, but in the capability and quality of the broader team.
  
  
How This Role Elevates Avalara
  
  

* For customers: Enterprise and multi-product customers receive expert implementation guidance, proactive risk management, and deep technical partnership — resulting in faster time-to-value and stronger long-term adoption.
* For the team: The Senior Analyst sets the implementation quality standard — authoring playbooks, mentoring I3 analysts, and identifying process improvements that raise team-wide performance.
* For the business: Directly supports ARR growth by enabling complex enterprise wins, supporting the sales cycle with pre-sales expertise, and accelerating NPI readiness across implementation teams.
* For our AI-first strategy: Designs and deploys AI-driven implementation workflows at a team level — moving beyond personal productivity to scalable automation that benefits the entire Go Live function.

**What Your Responsibilities Will Be**
**Enterprise & Multi-Product Implementation Leadership**

* Lead customer implementations involving multiple Avalara products and enterprise-level platforms including complex ERP, POS, and ecommerce environments (e.g., NetSuite, Dynamics 365, Salesforce Commerce, SAP).
* Act as the primary implementation authority for high-complexity, high-stakes customer engagements — setting strategy, managing scope, and driving outcomes from kickoff to Go Live.
* Clearly define, articulate, and manage scope of work for client-initiated implementation and data service projects, including change management when scope evolves.

**New Product Introduction (NPI) Enablement**

* Partner with Avalara Product Management, Sales, and Customer Success teams to develop implementation approach documentation, onboarding frameworks, and training materials for new product launches.
* Serve as a subject matter expert during NPI cycles — identifying implementation risks, documenting configuration requirements, and ensuring Go Live readiness before product release.
* Identify bugs, integration gaps, or UX friction during NPI implementations and partner with Engineering to track and resolve them.

**Practice Development & Quality Elevation**

* Own and evolve Go Live practice standards — documenting business processes, designing implementation playbooks, and proposing best practices for sales and use tax automation onboarding.
* Develop and document business requirements related to implementation workflows, data transformation, and cross-system reporting.
* Lead testing plan design and execution for complex implementations, ensuring customers go live on validated, stable configurations.
* Mentor and provide structured guidance to I2 Analysts — reviewing implementation quality, sharing expertise, and accelerating the development of junior team members.

**Cross-Functional Stakeholder Partnership**

* Collaborate with Sales and Account Management to support pre-sales activities — including scoping, solution design input, and customer-facing technical presentations.
* Engage cross-functionally across Product, Engineering, Support, and Finance to resolve systemic implementation blockers and drive process improvements at scale.
* Represent the Go Live team's perspective in strategic planning discussions, NPI readiness reviews, and cross-departmental initiatives.

**Customer Success & Risk Management**

* Monitor project health across assigned accounts — proactively identifying risk factors, intervening early, and resolving escalations with speed and precision.
* Provide strategic guidance to customers on best practices and use cases across a range of business models and tax compliance needs.
* Support customers in developing and executing testing plans, ensuring technical readiness before Go Live.

**AI-Driven Practice Scaling**

* Design and deploy AI-powered workflows at a team level — building reusable Glean AI agents, prompt libraries, and automation tools that improve implementation quality and speed across the Go Live function.
* Share AI innovations, document their impact, and drive adoption across I2 and I3 peers.

**12-Month Success Signals**
A successful Go Live Senior Analyst (I3) at the end of 12 months will have:
  
  

* Led multiple enterprise or multi-product implementations to successful Go Live with measurably shorter cycle times and low escalation rates, demonstrating ownership at a higher complexity tier than I2.
* Delivered at least two NPI readiness contributions — documented implementation playbooks, training materials, or bug reports — that were formally adopted by the Go Live or Product teams.
* Authored or significantly improved at least two Go Live practice standards or playbooks, with measurable adoption and quality impact across the team.
* Mentored at least two I2 Analysts with demonstrable improvement in their implementation quality metrics or time-to-competency.
* Built and deployed at least one AI-powered workflow (e.g., a Glean agent, automation script, or prompt framework) that generated measurable time savings or quality improvements at a team level — not just personally.
* Supported at least one pre-sales engagement in partnership with the Sales or Account Management team, contributing to a customer expansion or new business outcome.

AI Expectations
  
  
Avalara is an AI-first company. The Go Live Senior Analyst (I3) is expected to operate as an AI Bar Raiser — not just embedding AI into their own work, but actively raising AI capability across the Go Live team.
  
  
**Specific Expectations Include**

* Design and build reusable AI tools — including Glean AI agents, automated documentation workflows, and AI-assisted risk detection models — that are shared and adopted across the team.
* Use AI to analyze implementation portfolio data at scale, identifying patterns in at-risk implementations, NPI friction points, or recurring ERP configuration issues, and translating insights into proactive action.
* Deploy AI to accelerate NPI documentation, training material generation, and business requirements capture — dramatically compressing the time from product release to team readiness.
* Use AI to support customer communication at scale — generating implementation status summaries, tailored onboarding guidance, and escalation documentation with speed and precision.
* Coach I2 Analysts on applied AI usage, sharing effective practices and helping peers move from casual familiarity to embedded, outcome-driven AI workflows.
* Apply AI responsibly and securely, in full compliance with Avalara's data governance and AI ethics policies.

Candidates must demonstrate specific, quantified examples of AI usage that improved team-level outcomes — not just personal efficiency. Senior Analysts who cannot clearly articulate their AI impact across a team or function do not meet Avalara's AI Bar Raiser standard for this level.
  
  
What You’ll Need To Be Successful
  
  
**Required**
Bachelor’s in computer science, Engineering, or equivalent technical discipline (BCA, MCA, B.Tech from an accredited institution). Open to hire from Commerce background given strong technical acumen or expertise of implementation.
  
  

* 4–7 years of software implementation or delivery experience, preferably within the B2B SaaS sector, with demonstrated progression in scope and complexity.
* Proven ability to lead complex, enterprise-level software implementations across multiple products and ERP/ecommerce environments.
* Strong ability to articulate process logic and technical architecture — including design and delivery of functional and technical presentations to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of accounting and tax processes, including sales and use tax compliance automation concepts.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional conversations and drive alignment.
* Experience contributing to practice improvement — documenting business processes, designing best practices, or owning team-level standards.
* Demonstrated ownership mindset — takes initiative at a team level, holds peers accountable with coaching (not criticism), and drives outcomes without requiring direction.
* Embodies Avalara's Success Traits: Ownership, Simplicity, Curiosity, Adaptability, Urgency, Optimism, and Humility.

**Preferred**

* Hands-on experience configuring or integrating enterprise ERPs such as NetSuite, Dynamics 365, SAP, Salesforce Commerce, Sage, or WooCommerce.
* Proficiency with Salesforce, Gong, Gainsight, Jira, or equivalent CRM and project tracking platforms.
* Prior exposure to tax automation software implementation or tax-related roles.
* Experience in NPI or product launch support — working alongside Product Management or Engineering to prepare implementation teams for new releases.
* Familiarity with APIs, webhooks, and integration architecture concepts.
* Demonstrated experience mentoring or developing junior team members.

**Bar Raiser Expectation**
At Avalara, We Hire Only Those Who Raise The Bar — Not Those Who Merely Meet It. A Go Live Senior Analyst (I3) Who Is a Bar Raiser
  
  

* Improves the average performance of the team simply by being present — through coaching, example, and a consistent commitment to quality.
* Brings data, structure, and strategic thinking to conversations about risk, prioritization, process design, and escalation.
* Challenges assumptions respectfully and proposes better approaches — even when it's uncomfortable.
* Leaves every customer engagement, process, team interaction, and system in a measurably stronger state than they found it.
* Continuously develops technical, functional, and AI capabilities — and actively helps peers do the same.
* Demonstrates strong judgment in tradeoff decisions, especially when they affect customers, timelines, or team capacity.

Being a Bar Raiser at the I3 level means raising the entire team's execution quality — not just excelling individually.
  
  
Avalara is an AI-first Company
  
  
AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
  
  

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We’ll Take Care Of You
  
  
Total Rewards
  
  
In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.
  
  
Health & Wellness
  
  
Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.
  
  
Inclusive culture and diversity
  
  
Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.
  
  
**What You Need To Know About Avalara**
We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.
  
  
We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.
  
  
We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.
  
  
**We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer**
Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Implementation Engineer III
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Implementation Engineer III is a senior technical delivery leader who partners with government customers to bring OpenGov cloud software to life, owning the most complex product configurations and the underlying data migrations across a portfolio of implementations. This role leads requirements validation, configuration and data reviews, platform configuration and testing, data migration and reconciliation, and user enablement, guiding customers through the full deployment journey from kickoff to go-live while setting the technical quality bar for the team.
  
  
Acting as a trusted advisor with deep product knowledge and advanced data and database expertise, the Implementation Engineer III understands each customer's goals, pain points, and workflows, and translates them into scalable, maintainable solutions. This role blends hands-on technical delivery, including data transformation and migration (ETL), and scripting, with a consultative, customer-first approach. It also mentors less-experienced engineers, reviews their configuration and data work, and drives the process and quality improvements that raise the standard of implementation delivery across the organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead the data migration, configuration, and testing of OpenGov cloud software for the most complex government implementations across the United States
* Perform configuration reviews across the team, validating that platform setup aligns with documented requirements, product best practices, and long-term maintainability before go-live
* Perform data reviews, validating migrated data for completeness, accuracy, and integrity, and reconciling source-to-target data so the product reflects trusted, audit-ready customer data
* Own complex customer data migration end to end, including database schema mapping, ETL tool configuration, and advanced scripting, to ensure the product is populated with accurate, validated data.
* Confirm and pressure-test customer requirements across both configuration and data, resolving ambiguity and advising customers on the optimal solution design.
* Design and execute comprehensive test scenarios that validate the configuration and migrated data produce accurate, expected outcomes prior to go-live.
* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for government / customer stakeholder like Budget Directors, IT personnel, and decision-makers, guiding them through the deployment and integration process.
* Identify recurring customer pain points and partner with cross-functional teams to simplify, enhance, and automate processes that improve customer workflows and delivery efficiency
* Mentor and coach Associate and mid-level Implementation Engineers, reviewing their configuration and data work and helping accelerate their technical growth.
* Define and improve implementation standards, templates, playbooks, and reusable tooling that increase the quality, consistency, and speed of delivery.
* Partner closely with the Project Management, Customer Success Management, Data/Integration, and Product teams to ensure a consistent customer experience, and channel field feedback into the product roadmap.

**Requirements And Preferred Experience**

* 6 to 9 years of experience in software implementation, data migration, or technical consulting, ideally with enterprise or SaaS products
* 5+ years of hands-on SQL scripting experience, including complex queries, data transformation, and reconciliation
* 3+ years of Python, or similar, scripting experience for automation and data processing
* Deep experience with database technologies and with ETL and data-migration concepts and tools, including schema design and performance considerations
* Experience implementing AI-driven solutions for automation, workflow optimization, and data-driven insights, leveraging modern frameworks and AI models
* Demonstrated ability to deliver complex implementations end to end and to mentor or provide technical guidance to less-experienced engineers
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, with a strong teamwork and customer-service mentality across executive and technical stakeholders
* Strong attention to detail, with the proven ability to validate, reconcile, and sign off on data and configuration for accuracy
* Ability to adapt to a rapidly changing product and respond strategically to evolving customer needs
* Bachelor's degree in a technical, or related field

**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.
  
  
**Opportunity to Innovate**
The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**
This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.
  
  
**A Place to Make Your Mark**
We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.
  
  
**Benefits That Work For You**
Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:
  
  

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

title: Manager – Quality Assurance
description:
**Job Description**
GMP Compliance – Drug Product Facility
  
  

* Monitor day-to-day activities and plan allocation of IPQA personnel as per batch schedule. Oversee critical manufacturing activities including dispensing, in-process checks, sampling, filling, sealing, visual inspection, and AQL.
* Coordinate with Drug Product (DP) teams for smooth batch execution from dispensing to dispatch.

Review technical documents related to drug product manufacturing.
  
  
Media Fill, Validation, and Qualification
  
  

* Review media fill protocols and reports in compliance with current regulatory guidelines. Ensure equipment and area qualifications, including periodic requalification for drug product facilities.
* Review process validation and cleaning validation protocols and reports.

Ensure availability of visual inspection qualification kits.
  
  
Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) Activities
  
  

* Ensure manufacturing and analytical activities at CMOs are conducted in compliance with Quality Technical Agreements and cGMP requirements.
* Coordinate and communicate with CMO manufacturing and analytical teams for timely execution and tracking of activities.
* Identify the need for new procedures and ensure their implementation; perform gap analysis of existing procedures.
* Review executed Batch Processing Records (BPR) and Analytical Records (AR) for batch release, and coordinate with CMOs to ensure compliance.
* Review and approve Annual Product Quality Review (APQR) reports for products manufactured at CMOs.

Market Complaint and Recall Activities
  
  

* Manage market complaints including registration, communication with complainants and DSRM, investigation, and implementation of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
* Notify stakeholders regarding product or batch recalls/market withdrawals.

**Work Experience**
10-15 Years of relevant work experience in Biopharma
  
  
**Education**
Masters in Biotechnology or Biopharmaceutics
  
  
Post Graduation in Pharmacy
  
  
**Competencies**

title: QA - Engineer/ Sr. Engineer
description:
**Job Title: QA - Engineer/ Sr. Engineer**

**Location:**
Pan India (Site-Based)

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience Level:**
3-5 Years

**About Company:**
DDE ULTRA is a leading provider of ultra-high purity utility systems for Semiconductor, Solar, and High-Tech industries, with strong expertise in turnkey solutions.

We are looking for a Detail-Oriented QA Engineer to ensure quality standards across projects. The role involves implementing QA processes, conducting inspections, maintaining documentation, and ensuring compliance with industry and client requirements. The ideal candidate should have a strong eye for detail, knowledge of quality standards, and the ability to coordinate effectively with cross-functional teams.

**Responsibilities:**

•Prepare, review & approve of the Project Quality Plan (PQP), Work Method statement (WMS), ITP (Inspection test plan), Installation & Operational Qualification protocol, Quality Management System (QMS) SOP’s, HIRA (Hazard identification and risk assessment documents), checklists and project-specific quality requirements.

•Ensure compliance with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 and customer quality requirements.

•Review welding qualification documents including WPS, PQR, WPQ and WOPQ.

•Coordinate internal quality audits and support external/customer audits.

•Ensure implementation of material traceability requirements throughout project execution

•Review and verify Material Test Certificates (MTCs), Certificates of Conformance (CoC), surface finish certificates, cleaning certificates and other manufacturer quality documents for project materials and components.

•Perform components technical specifications verification to ensure compliance with approved specifications.

•Review and approve vendor quality documents, inspection records and manufacturing documentation.

•Coordinate vendor evaluations, supplier quality assessments and quality issue resolution.

•Ensure all required quality documents and inspection records are available prior to fabrication, installation and dispatch activities.

•Conduct final quality walkdown of completed assemblies, skids, manifolds and systems prior to dispatch.

•Support FAT (If applicable), IOQ, customer inspections and project quality reviews.

•Coordinate dispatch clearance activities by verifying inspection status, documentation completeness, punch point closure and customer-specific quality requirements.

•Review engineering documents from a quality compliance perspective.

•Ensure effective implementation of document control processes and maintenance of quality records.

•Drive continual improvement initiatives within the organization.

•Interface with clients, EPC contractors and consultants on quality-related matters.

•Conduct quality awareness and training programs for project teams.

•Review and approve quality dossiers, manufacturing record books (MRBs), test reports, calibration certificates and turnover documentation prior to release.

•Coordinate with Engineering, Procurement, Manufacturing and Project teams for closure of quality-related issues.

•Manage Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) and ensure timely closure, Lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and implementation of Corrective & Preventive Actions (CAPA).

•Periodical clean room requalification and maintaining records.

**Qualification and Skills:**

•Bachelor’s degree in mechanical / production / industrial engineering.

•
**3–5 years of experience**
in QA for Process Equipment, Gas Systems, Semiconductor, EPC projects.

•Knowledge of ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 requirements.

•Familiarity with ASME B31.3, SEMI Standards, ASTM standards and welding quality requirements.

•Experience in NCR, CAPA, RCA and Internal Audits.

•Strong documentation and customer interaction skills.

**Note:**
Preference will be given to candidates with experience in semiconductor fabs, ultra-high purity gas systems, and cleanroom projects. Exposure to process piping, orbital welding quality systems, and high purity stainless steel tubing systems will be an added advantage.

title: Senior Software Quality Assurance Engineer – Medical Device Integration & Connectivity
description:
**Role Summary**
Arthrex seeks a highly motivated, technically skilled Senior Software Quality Assurance Engineer to join the Software Quality Assurance team in Pune, India.
  
  
This position focuses on testing medical device software, connected devices, healthcare interoperability, and network-based applications. The ideal candidate will have strong technical expertise in HL7, DICOM, .NET/C#, device networking, IoT technologies, and Modality Worklist (MWL) integration.
  
  
The role requires a proactive, detail-oriented engineer who owns software quality, demonstrates strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, and can work independently while collaborating effectively with global development and SQA teams.
  
  
This is a full-time, on-site position at the Pune office, where hands-on access to medical devices and test equipment is essential. Employment type: Full-Time (1 FTE).
  
  
**Role Description**

* Develop, execute, and maintain test plans, test cases, and test procedures for medical device software and connected systems.
* Perform functional, integration, system, regression, and end-to-end testing across software and hardware environments.
* Validate communication between medical devices, hospital systems, and enterprise applications.
* Identify, document, investigate, and troubleshoot software defects in collaboration with developers.
* Identify quality risks, testing gaps, and opportunities to improve test coverage.
* Participate in requirements reviews, technical discussions, and software design reviews.
* Test healthcare interoperability protocols, including HL7 and DICOM, and validate DICOM Modality Worklist (MWL) and imaging workflows.
* NoSQL distributed database
* Healthcare IT, medical imaging, and connected-device environments are suitable
* People overlap with ACT hours, working to 10 am PST. We will try to make all meetings between 8 a.m. and 10 a.m. PST. We will also like this person to come to the office each day to work with the devices.
* Validate connectivity with PACS, RIS, HIS/EMR, and other healthcare information systems.
* Test IoT-connected devices, cloud-connected applications, and device-to-server communication.
* Analyze network traffic, application logs, and protocol messages to diagnose integration issues.
* Develop and maintain automated test scripts and utilities using C# and .NET.
* Perform API, database, and backend integration testing.
* Configure and troubleshoot networks involving TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, HTTP/HTTPS, and related protocols; use Wireshark and other diagnostic tools.
* Support physical medical device setup, configuration, firmware/software updates, and network connectivity testing.
* Use AI-assisted testing tools where appropriate to improve test design, automation, defect analysis, and testing efficiency while maintaining reliability and traceability
* Collaborate with developers, systems engineers, product owners, and global SQA teams; communicate progress, defects, and quality risks clearly.
* Maintain accurate test documentation, execution evidence, and defect records in line with quality processes for regulated medical device software.
* Take ownership of assigned testing activities and drive issues through resolution.

**Skill Requirements**
**PRIMARY SKILLS (MUST HAVE SKILLS):**

* 5+ years of experience in software QA, software testing, or software development.
* Hands-on experience with HL7, DICOM, and DICOM Modality Worklist (MWL).
* Proficiency in C# and .NET for software testing, automation, or development.
* Strong understanding of computer networking, TCP/IP, and network troubleshooting.
* Experience testing network-connected devices, embedded systems, or IoT applications.
* Experience with integration and end-to-end testing across multiple software and hardware components.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and technical problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; able to work independently and prioritize effectively.
* Ability to work full-time on-site at the Arthrex Pune office.

**Secondary Skills (good To Have)**

* Experience in the medical device industry or regulated healthcare software environments.
* Familiarity with FDA software quality expectations, IEC 62304, ISO 13485, and software design controls.
* Experience with PACS, RIS, HIS, EMR/EHR, and medical imaging workflows.
* Experience with HL7 v2 messaging, DICOM networking services, and healthcare integration testing tools.
* Knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, XML, SQL, and database validation; Couchbase/NoSQL knowledge.
* Experience with test automation frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, Git, Jira, Xray, or similar tools.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted test automation and AI-powered software development tools.

Experience with cloud platforms, connected medical devices, or remote device management systems.
  
  
**Qualifications And Education Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Biomedical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 5+ years of relevant experience in software QA, testing, or development.

title: Test Engineer
description:
**Location Name:**
Pune Corporate Office - Mantri
  
  
**Job Purpose**
To ensure the quality, reliability and compliance alignment of ServiceNow IRM and GRC solutions by planning and executing structured testing across functional workflows, integrations, data, roles and access controls, reports and releases, while maintaining complete test evidence and supporting timely defect resolution and production readiness.
  
  
**Duties And Responsibilities**
Review business requirements, functional specifications, user stories and acceptance criteria for ServiceNow IRM/GRC processes and identify test scenarios, dependencies, risks and coverage gaps.
  
  

* Prepare and maintain test strategy inputs, test plans, test scenarios, test cases, test data, requirement traceability matrices and execution evidence for assigned releases and enhancements.
* Execute functional, integration, system, regression, smoke, sanity, negative, role-based access and end-to-end testing across policy and compliance, risk, audit, issue, exception, control, evidence and remediation workflows.
* Validate ServiceNow forms, fields, workflows, approvals, notifications, business rules, SLAs, reports, dashboards, scheduled activities, import/data-load outcomes and interfaces against approved requirements.
* Test user roles, groups, access controls, segregation of duties, record visibility and confidential-data handling in coordination with functional, platform and information-security teams.
* Log defects with clear replication steps, expected and actual results, severity, supporting evidence and impacted requirements; coordinate triage, retesting and closure with development and functional teams.
* Support SIT, UAT, release validation and post-deployment verification; monitor testing progress, defect ageing, blockers and quality risks and provide timely status reporting and escalation.
* Maintain audit-ready QA documentation, test evidence, sign-offs and traceability in line with change management, release governance and IT compliance requirements.
* Contribute to test automation, reusable regression packs, data-quality checks and continuous improvement of QA standards, metrics and ServiceNow testing practices.

**Key Decisions / Dimensions**
Determine appropriate test scenarios, test depth, test data and regression coverage for assigned requirements based on risk and business impact.
  
  

* Assign an initial defect severity and priority recommendation based on impact, reproducibility and compliance risk, subject to the defined triage process.
* Recommend whether a test item is ready for UAT, release validation or closure based on execution results, evidence and unresolved risks.
* Identify requirements or acceptance criteria that are unclear, incomplete or not testable and escalate them for resolution before sign-off.
* Recommend improvements to test cases, regression packs, quality metrics, automation opportunities and release-quality controls.

**Major Challenges**
Understanding complex IT compliance, risk, control and audit requirements and translating them into complete and practical test coverage.
  
  

* Validating interconnected ServiceNow IRM/GRC workflows, integrations, role-based access, notifications, reports and data dependencies across multiple teams.
* Maintaining representative test data and end-to-end traceability without compromising confidential or production information.
* Balancing release timelines with adequate regression coverage, defect retesting, evidence preparation and production-readiness checks.
* Distinguishing configuration, code, integration, data and requirement defects and coordinating timely resolution across stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications And Experience**
Educational Qualifications Graduate degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems or equivalent. ServiceNow CSA, ATF, GRC/IRM, ISTQB or relevant testing certification will be an added advantage.
  
  
Experience 3-5 years of experience in software quality assurance, with hands-on functional testing of ServiceNow or comparable enterprise workflow platforms. Exposure to IT compliance, IRM, GRC, risk, audit, policy, control or third-party risk processes will be preferred.
  
  
Core Functional / Technical Skills Test planning, scenario and test-case design, requirement traceability, functional testing, system and integration testing, regression testing, smoke and sanity testing, negative testing, role/access testing, defect management, UAT support, release validation, test evidence and quality reporting. Working knowledge of ServiceNow IRM/GRC modules, workflows, reports and dashboards.
  
  
Additional Skills ServiceNow Automated Test Framework exposure, REST/SOAP API testing, import sets and data validation, SQL basics, JSON/XML, Postman or equivalent API tools, test-management and defect-tracking tools, Microsoft Excel . Understanding of Agile delivery, SDLC, STLC, change and release management will be beneficial.
  
  
Behavioral Competencies Strong attention to detail, analytical and structured thinking, ownership, professional scepticism, clear documentation, effective stakeholder communication, collaboration, prioritization, problem solving, timely escalation and ability to work across multiple releases and deadlines.

title: R&D Engineer (GEN AI/ ML)
description:
**Company Description**
Ubisoft is a global leader in gaming with teams across the world creating original and memorable gaming experiences, from Assassin’s Creed, Rainbow Six to Just Dance and more. We believe diverse perspectives help both players and teams thrive. If you’re passionate about innovation and pushing entertainment boundaries, join our journey and help us create the unknown!
  
  
**Job Description**
**Job Summary**
UBISOFT is seeking an Intermediate R&D Engineer to prototype and validate new technologies that improve game testing and quality control. This role focuses on building rapid prototypes and running experiments using GenAI, VLMs (Vision-Language Models), and AI/ML to explore automation opportunities across QC. You will work closely with the R&D Manager and cross-functional partners to translate ideas into measurable experiments, evaluate feasibility, and iterate toward proof-of-value prototypes. This role provides an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience in software development, automation, and quality control processes within the gaming industry.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**
**Job Duties / Responsibilities**

* Build rapid prototypes using GenAI/VLM/ML to address QC and testing pain points.
* Design and execute experiments: define hypotheses, datasets/inputs, evaluation criteria, baselines, and success metrics (accuracy, precision/recall, latency, cost, robustness).
* Implement data pipelines for experiments: data collection, cleaning, labeling support, and dataset versioning (as needed for proofs-of-concept).
* Explore and compare approaches and document trade-offs.
* Integrate prototypes with existing internal tools/test systems at a lightweight level (APIs, CLIs, plugins) to enable user trials and feedback.
* Analyze experiment results, identify failure modes, and iterate quickly based on findings and stakeholder input.
* Maintain reproducible research practices: experiment tracking, configuration management, and clear documentation of assumptions and limitations.
* Collaborate in agile workflows: estimate assigned tasks, provide status updates, and incorporate feedback iteratively.

**Learning Opportunities**

* Gain hands-on experience with software development and automation tools.
* Develop a deeper understanding of software testing lifecycles.
* Enhance coding and debugging skills in a collaborative environment.
* Learn about CI/CD pipelines and version control systems.

**Core Competencies**

* Eager to Learn: Highly motivated and quick to grasp new concepts.
* Experimental Mindset: Comfortable with ambiguity; able to form hypotheses and learn quickly through iteration.
* Pragmatic Engineering: Delivers prototypes that are usable and measurable, without over-engineering.
* Analytical Thinking: Interprets results critically; understands bias, variance, and common evaluation pitfalls.
* Collaboration: Works well with technical and non-technical stakeholders; communicates trade-offs clearly.
* Adaptability: Keeps pace with rapidly evolving AI/ML tooling and best practices.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Curiosity: Passion for exploring new technologies and their applications.
* Teamwork: Ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams.
* Adaptability: Willingness to take on new challenges and adapt to changing priorities.

**Qualifications**
**Seniority:**
Having at least
**5-8**
years of coding experience in above languages,
  
  
B.E/BTech/MTech/MS Computer Science in computer science or equivalent.
  
  
**Technical Competencies**

* Hands on Knowledge of Python programming.
* Good understanding of AI/ML concepts.
* Familiarity with software development and testing processes.
* Exposure to CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, TeamCity) and version control systems (e.g., Git).
* Solid understanding of debugging and troubleshooting techniques.

title: Engineer - V&V
description:
**What You’ll Do**
Eaton announced, on June 11, 20206, the intent to combine its Mobility Group (including both the Vehicle and eMobility segments) with a new company. We expect to complete this process by the end of the first half of 2027. The compensation and benefits that will initially be offered for this position are based on Eaton's plans, programs and practices. If you are offered and accept this position and are actively employed by the Mobility Group when the transaction closes, the new company will provide further details to employees concerning compensation and benefits at that time.
  
  
This position is part of the Vehicle Controls Product Line engineering team and supports verification and validation of rugged operator-control products for on-road and off-road vehicles and commercial mobile equipment. Products include rocker, toggle, push-button, key-lock, and rotary switches; indicators; multiplexed keypads and electronic switch modules; operator-control and human-machine interface products; and vehicle input/output modules. The engineer will translate customer, system, electronics, mechanical, software, environmental, reliability, safety, and regulatory requirements into traceable verification plans, test procedures, test setups, and objective evidence. The role supports the full product-development cycle—from requirements review and design-risk assessment through prototype evaluation, design verification, product validation, production launch, and lifecycle support—and may also support electronics hardware design, schematic review, component selection, circuit calculations, printed circuit board design reviews, bring-up, and debugging under guidance from senior engineers.
  
  
"What you’ll do:
  
  

* Review customer, system, hardware, software, mechanical, safety, environmental, reliability, and regulatory requirements and convert them into clear, measurable verification criteria.
* Develop and maintain requirements traceability, Design Verification Plans and Reports, test plans, test cases, procedures, acceptance criteria, schedules, and compliance evidence for Vehicle Controls products.
* Verify and validate rocker, toggle, push-button, key-lock, and rotary switches; indicators; multiplexed keypads and electronic switch modules; operator-control and human-machine interface products; and vehicle input/output modules.
* Plan and execute functional, electrical, electronic, mechanical, environmental, electromagnetic compatibility, ingress-protection, vibration, shock, thermal, durability, operating-force and travel, tactile-response, communication, and fault-insertion testing, as applicable.
* Design, assemble, commission, and troubleshoot test fixtures, wiring harnesses, loads, instrumentation, data-acquisition systems, and automated or semi-automated test setups.
* Select suitable internal and external laboratories, coordinate test readiness and sample availability, witness testing when required, and drive accurate, on-time completion of planned activities.
* Analyze test data, determine pass/fail status, document observations and conclusions, and communicate coverage, progress, risks, and results to project stakeholders.
* Investigate failures using structured problem-solving methods; reproduce issues, isolate root causes, support corrective actions, and verify their effectiveness.
* Participate in design reviews, requirements reviews, design failure mode and effects analysis, test-readiness reviews, and product-release reviews; provide testability, robustness, and risk-reduction recommendations.
* Support electronics hardware design activities, including schematic and bill-of-material reviews, component selection and derating, circuit calculations and simulation, printed circuit board layout reviews, prototype bring-up, bench debugging, and design documentation.

**Qualifications**
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechatronics, Automotive Engineering, or a related discipline; a master’s degree is preferred.
  
  
0–2 years of relevant experience with a master’s degree, or 2–4 years with a bachelor’s degree, in product verification and validation, electronics testing, or electronics hardware design. Automotive, off-highway, or vehicle-control product experience is preferred.
  
  
**Skills**
"
  
  

* Experience or academic exposure relevant to rugged Vehicle Controls products such as switches, indicators, multiplexed keypads, electronic switch modules, human-machine interfaces, and vehicle input/output modules.
* Working knowledge of verification and validation planning, requirements traceability, test-case development, acceptance criteria, test execution, defect reporting, and technical report preparation.
* Understanding of analog and digital electronics, microcontroller-based circuits, power supplies, communication interfaces, sensors, actuators, protection circuits, and electronic components.
* Ability to read and review electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, printed circuit board layouts, bills of material, component data sheets, mechanical drawings, and interface-control documents.
* Hands-on familiarity with oscilloscopes, digital multimeters, power supplies, electronic loads, signal generators, data-acquisition systems, environmental chambers, and automated test tools.
* Ability to develop and troubleshoot test fixtures, wiring harnesses, loads, instrumentation, and basic automation using tools such as LabVIEW, Python, or equivalent platforms.
* Knowledge of functional, electrical, environmental, vibration, shock, thermal, ingress-protection, durability, electromagnetic compatibility, communication, and fault-insertion testing, as applicable.
* Familiarity with circuit calculations, component selection and derating, simulation, schematic review, printed circuit board design review, prototype bring-up, and bench debugging.
* Working knowledge of design failure mode and effects analysis, root-cause analysis, structured problem solving, corrective-action verification, configuration management, and engineering change control.
* Awareness of automotive product-development and quality practices; familiarity with Automotive SPICE, ISO 26262, electromagnetic compatibility standards, and applicable customer or industry standards is preferred.
* Sound analytical skills and the ability to document assumptions, data, test evidence, risks, and technical conclusions."

"
  
  

* Clear written and verbal communication, including concise test reports, technical presentations, and timely status updates.
* Collaboration across electronics, systems, software, mechanical, manufacturing, quality, sourcing, laboratory, supplier, customer, and global engineering teams.
* Learning agility and willingness to seek guidance while building technical depth.
* Ownership of assigned deliverables, attention to detail, disciplined follow-through, and effective time management.
* Data-based problem solving, sound judgment, curiosity, and timely escalation of risks.
* Customer focus, integrity, inclusion, and a strong commitment to safety and quality."

Advanced cybersecurity incident triage, investigation and prioritisation.

Risk and business-impact assessment.
