title: SAP Test Manager
description:
Job Description: SAP Test Manager / Test Lead
  
  
**Position:**
SAP Test Manager / Lead
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-time
  
  
**Experience Level:**
Senior Level
  
  
**Job Overview**
We are seeking an experienced
**SAP Test Manager / Test Lead**
to oversee and manage end-to-end testing activities across complex SAP implementation and rollout programs. In this role, you will define comprehensive test strategies, coordinate test planning and execution, and drive quality assurance standards. You will leverage
**SAP Cloud ALM (CALM)**
and
**Jira**
for complete test lifecycle management, defect tracking, and governance while serving as a primary point of contact for key client stakeholders.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Test Strategy & Planning: Design, implement, and maintain overall SAP Test Strategies, Test Plans, and Governance Frameworks tailored to client requirements and project scope.
* Test Execution Management: Drive end-to-end test phases including Integration Testing, System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and Cutover / Go-Live testing.
* Tool & Process Management: Utilize SAP Cloud ALM (CALM) and Jira to create test cases, track execution progress, manage defects, build quality dashboards, and deliver regular status reports to senior management.
* Stakeholder Management: Manage direct relationships with client leadership, functional leads, business users, and third-party vendor teams to align on test scope, schedules, risks, and acceptance criteria.
* Defect & Risk Governance: Facilitate daily defect triage meetings, establish clear SLAs for defect resolution, manage escalation paths, and proactively address quality risks to keep project schedules on track.

**Required Qualifications & Mandatory Skills**
  
  

* SAP Testing Leadership:

+ Proven expertise as an SAP Test Manager or Test Lead with a strong track record in Test Strategy, Test Planning, Test Coordination, and Test Execution Management across SAP landscapes.

* Tools Expertise (CALM & Jira):

+ Hands-on proficiency with SAP Cloud ALM (CALM) and Jira for end-to-end test planning, defect management, metrics tracking, and governance reporting.

* Client-Facing & Stakeholder Management:

+ Exceptional customer-facing communication and interpersonal skills, with demonstrated experience interacting with client executives, managing business expectations, and facilitating user training/UAT sessions.

**Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills**

* Test Automation: Exposure to or experience with automated testing tools and methodologies within SAP environments (e.g., TOSCA, Worksoft Certify, Selenium, or native SAP automation capabilities).

**Key Competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Leadership skills with a collaborative approach to leading cross-functional delivery teams.
* Capability to thrive in high-pressure project delivery environments.

title: Architect – AI-Powered Performance Verification Automation
description:
NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself. Our invention of the GPU sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. Today, research in artificial intelligence is booming worldwide, which calls for highly scalable and massively parallel computation horsepower that NVIDIA GPUs excel.
  
  
NVIDIA is a “learning machine” that constantly evolves by adapting to new opportunities that are hard to solve, that only we can address, and that matter to the world. This is our life’s work , to amplify human creativity and intelligence. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join our diverse team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world. As part of this team, you would be working on projects that will help make our next generation visual computing, automotive, GPU, HPC systems better. You will get to work on high performance CPU and Memory sub-systems, Next-Gen GPUs , NOC based Interconnect Fabric etc. Make the choice to join us today.
  
  
We are looking for a motivated engineer to drive the transformation of performance verification workflows through AI and automation. In this role, you will design, develop, and deploy solutions that accelerate verification cycles, improve coverage, and reduce manual effort across hardware performance verification project lifecycles. You will be at the forefront of redefining how performance verification is done at scale — replacing repetitive manual analysis with intelligent, self-improving automation that helps engineers focus on what matters most.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Automate verification workflows by building AI/ML-based tools that generate, triage, and analyse performance test cases and results
* Develop intelligent agents that can identify performance regressions, root-cause failures, and recommend corrective actions
* Integrate LLM-based assistants into existing verification infrastructure to enable natural-language querying of results, specs, and coverage data
* Design data pipelines to collect, curate, and label verification data for model training and continuous improvement
* Collaborate with verification engineers to understand pain points, define automation priorities, and validate AI-driven solutions against real-world workflows
* Establish metrics and dashboards to measure automation impact (cycle time reduction, coverage improvement, engineer productivity)
* Stay current with state-of-the-art techniques in generative AI, reinforcement learning, and formal methods as they apply to hardware verification

**What We Need To See**

* B.Tech/M.Tech/PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
* 3+ years of experience in hardware verification, performance validation, or EDA tool development
* Strong programming skills in Python; familiarity with C/C++, SystemVerilog/UVM is a plus
* Hands-on experience with ML/AI frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn) or LLM APIs (OpenAI, NVIDIA NIM/NeMo)
* Understanding of performance verification methodologies (benchmarking, profiling, regression analysis)
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Experience applying ML to EDA or verification problems (e.g., coverage closure, bug prediction, test generation)
* Familiarity with RAG architectures, prompt engineering, and agentic AI frameworks (LangChain, CrewAI, etc.)
* Knowledge of NVIDIA GPU/SoC architecture or similar complex hardware platforms
* Published work or patents in AI-for-verification or related domains

title: Functional Engineer Reporting
description:
**About AkzoNobel**
Since 1792, we’ve been supplying the innovative paints and coatings that help to color people’s lives and protect what matters most. Our world class portfolio of brands – including Dulux, International, Sikkens and Interpon – is trusted by customers around the globe. We’re active in more than 150 countries and use our expertise to sustain and enhance the fabric of everyday life. Because we believe every surface is an opportunity. It’s what you’d expect from a pioneering and long-established paints company that’s dedicated to providing sustainable solutions and preserving the best of what we have today – while creating an even better tomorrow. Let’s paint the future together.
  
  
For more information please visit www.akzonobel.com
  
  
© 2026 Akzo Nobel N.V. All rights reserved.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
Data and Reporting team is focused on unlocking the value of data as it exists within AkzoNobel systems. We're an eclectic team of data-oriented doers who love to take on new challenges, are always learning, and looking for ways to improve decision-making.
  
  
**POSITION OVERVIEW:**
Design, develop, test, and implement IT solutions and processes in IT systems like applications, platforms and networks through IT changes, projects in line with global Information Technology (IT) and security guidelines, to support company business requirements to create company value.
  
  
The
**Functional**
**Engineer in Application Delivery**
is responsible for detailing design and hardwiring business requirements as per Architectural and Security guidelines. This is done through projects, changes and increasingly more through Agile Devops teams. This requires high quality Stories (change specifications) and projects changes which will allow Engineers and/or Developers to translate into code/configuration. The Functional Engineer sees to properly coordinate, review, approve and execute stories/project changes and has an active role monitoring status, in (unit)testing and change management once developed, including organizing sign-off after testing.
  
  
The Functional Engineer has an active role in the preparation and execution of the actual changes together with our partners and external consultants where applicable.
  
  
On request, a Functional Engineer can be asked to be involved in solving urgent high priority incidents and plays a role in process improvements alongside with business.
  
  
Depending on the domain and the progress of IT Fusion in our organization, the work is either done in agile teams under the leadership of a Scrum Master or in the case of a waterfall under the leadership of the Project Manager. Depending on the seniority of the Engineer, he/she will also assume these project management activities as a role or will take lead in delivery of end-to-end changes.
  
  
**Key Activities**
**Story specification**
Translate business requirements into clear detailed designs. Own and develop high quality Stories (change specifications) and project changes for Engineers and External Consultants to then translate into code or config and a proposal on a change implementation.
  
  
**Development & delivery**
Guide, coordinate and oversee the preparation and execution and implementation of the (project) changes and the development of the code/config of Stories. Ensure that all partners follow established standards (process- & documentation standards, coding and testing standards, naming conventions etc.). Review, Approve and control the implementation and/or embedding of new, enhancements and/or modifications of applications, systems and/or solutions.
  
  
This results in building sustainable and stable first-time right solutions in a very collaborate team spirit (also with external service providers) and in an engaging way with stakeholders and consumers of the solutions. Solutions are built according to the Architectural and Security principles and changes are timely & adequately prepared & documented and/or code works as intended.
  
  
**Testing**
Own testing of changes or stories, and/or actively oversee testing by business. Develop test scripts, examine test outcomes, sign off for unit testing and coordinate business sign off for Application Delivery related testing. Contribute to test planning and test management for a specific release.
  
  
Resulting in, changes and/or code are properly and timely tested.
  
  
**Incident management**
Perform functional or technical problem analysis in case of incidents or issues as needed depending on the severity of the problem. Perform root cause analysis, document these and share findings. Deploy (or oversee deployment) of updates and fixes. To ensure that issues, incidents and problems are swiftly and effectively resolved.
  
  
**Process management and improvement**
Monitor, guard, test and analyze that the use and security of applications and systems regarding the functional and performance aspects are in line with the agreed performance indicators, and if necessary, take measures. Actively contribute to process improvement: e.g. tool development, dashboard/insight development and visualization, script automation. Has a good view of the technical state of the application (technical debt) and regularly discuss and works seamlessly together with the (domain)Architect to develop plans to resolve the technical debt.
  
  
Resulting in, available and optimally performing applications and IT infrastructure for the business and, DevOps process, tooling and dashboards are continuously improving.
  
  
**Project support**
Support a project manager by taking ownership of specific project deliverables (specifications, config, testing, etc). Define, plan, manage and participate in assigned project deliverables from the own functional or technical domain, in accordance with the IT project manager and involved business project owners. Resulting in, efficient and effective realization of project deliverables.
  
  
**Experience**
**Business partnering**
with all the stakeholders in the organization to determine opportunities / requirements for Data analytics solutions that can drive revenue growth, operational efficiencies, customer value etc.
  
  
**Project Management:**
Should be able to independently manage several projects, track actions and reach out to stakeholders when needed.
  
  
**Solution design & development:**
Develop new solution using BI Tools (Power BI)
  
  

* Translate business logic to technical calculations that will help the technical team to build the metrics
* Fetch and embed data from SAP HANA, BW, Azure SQL, Excel, flat files, Sharepoint list etc.
* Perform data transformation, engineering, [joint, exclusion, enrichment, pivoting, etc.] using SQL, Databricks Pyspark(Good to have)
* Integrate & prepare multi sourced - complex data efficiently
* Automate tools/ data flow using best practices in collaboration with internal teams and Data Engineers.

**Improve and maintain existing solutions:**

* Suggest technical improvements / automation ideas for existing Analytics solutions
* Test and ensure compatibility of existing solutions upon new software version release
* Improve and safeguard dashboards performance (latency, downtime)
* Educate and train a variety of stakeholders about the dashboard technicalities & features
* Keep detailed technical documentation complete and up to date

**Academic and professional background:**

* Bachelors or master’s degree in analytics, Business, or finance from a premier institute
* Minimum 6+ years work experience in Data analytics & visualization roles in a global or multinational environment

**Skillset and professional experience:**

* Highly skilled in communication and collaboration, with experience in working with cross-functional teams and presenting data insights to executive stakeholders.
* Capable of working independently to identify business problems and opportunities that can be addressed through data analysis.
* Highly skilled in data analysis and modeling, with the ability to work with large datasets and complex data structures.
* Exceptional in creating visualizations in PowerBI (+DAX) that effectively communicate complex data insights to non-technical audience.
* Proficient in using SQL, and other data analysis tools.
* Good to have skills such as PySpark for Databricks, Python or R, with experience in data wrangling, data cleaning, and statistical analysis. Has a deep understanding of data modeling and can work with complex data structures.
* Experience in developing and implementing predictive models to forecast business outcomes and support decision-making.
* Excellent Presentation & PowerPoint skills

title: Quality Engineering Lead – Data & Reporting Platforms
description:
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced
**VP, Quality Engineering Lead**
to define, build, and drive our automated data and report testing strategy. In this role, you will lead the Quality Engineering (QE) initiatives for our next-generation, AI-powered data and reporting ecosystem.
  
  
As a hands-on leader, you will design robust automated test suites to validate complex data architectures—specifically focusing on data virtualization, massive data federation, data contract testing, and the verification of emerging natural language/conversational AI query interfaces. You will manage a talented team of quality engineers, establish testing standards, and collaborate closely with engineering, and product teams to ensure high-quality, secure, and performant data and report delivery.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Test Strategy & Quality Leadership
* Data & Reporting Test Strategy: Architect and execute a comprehensive, end-to-end automated testing strategy covering data virtualization, federated queries, BI/reporting, and AI-enabled analytical interfaces.
* Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and functionally manage a specialized team of Data & Report Quality Engineers, fostering a culture of modern Quality Engineering (QE) and continuous improvement.
* Governance & Compliance: Define operating standards, automated quality gates, and data verification protocols across the analytics and reporting delivery lifecycle.
* Stakeholder Management: Own the reporting of quality metrics, pipeline coverage, and test automation maturity to senior global technology and engineering leaders.
* Data Virtualization & Federation Testing
* Federated Query & Virtualization Validation: Develop automated testing frameworks to validate query execution, latency, and data integrity across massive federated query engines and data virtualization platforms (e.g., Starburst, Trino, Presto, Denodo, Dremio, AWS Athena, or Apache Drill) connecting dozens of heterogeneous catalogs without physical data movement.
* Data Contract & Schema Validation: Implement automated schema validation and data contract testing to ensure curated, virtualized data products strictly adhere to published business definitions and system requirements.
* Access Control & Security Testing: Design data-driven security tests to verify that centralized data access governance (e.g., Apache Ranger, role/attribute-based access controls) and data masking are flawlessly applied.
* AI & Conversational Intelligence Testing
* Natural Language Query Testing: Establish frameworks to test conversational AI interfaces that allow users to query data using natural language. Validate natural language processing (NLP) models, intent recognition, NLP-to-SQL translation logic, and the accuracy of the underlying datasets returned.
* Autonomous Agent Verification: Design testing patterns for non-deterministic AI agents (e.g., automated alerting systems and contextual research assistants), validating logical outputs, threshold actions, and boundary limits.
* Big Data & Reporting Platform Testing
* Report & Dashboard Verification: Devise automated strategies to test visual correctness, performance, and backend data reconciliation for BI platforms (e.g., Tableau, custom web-based dashboards) during large-scale migration phases of legacy systems (comprising hundreds of reports).
* Data Lakehouse & Pipeline Testing: Lead automation efforts validating complex data pipelines across hybrid databases (Oracle, SQL Server) and modern analytical lakehouses.
* Data Reconciliation: Design and automate source-to-target data reconciliation, schema drift detection, and data lineage validation to ensure reports match underlying source systems perfectly.
* CI/CD & Test Automation Engineering
* Continuous Quality Pipelines: Seamlessly integrate data and report automation suites into enterprise CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Tekton, GitLab, etc.) to trigger continuous verification with each deployment code path.
* Triage & Defect Management: Champion structured defect triage, prioritizations, and root cause analysis across complex, multi-tiered data and reporting infrastructure environments.

Technology Skills
  
  
**Required Technical Skillsets**

* Data Virtualization & Federation: Hands-on experience with enterprise data virtualization or query federation platforms, such as Starburst, Trino, Presto, Denodo, Dremio, AWS Athena, or Apache Drill.
* BI & Reporting Platforms: Deep expertise in testing BI and reporting platforms (e.g., Tableau, custom web-based dashboards, Aspose, or similar reporting engines).
* Database Querying & Testing: Advanced SQL expertise with hands-on experience testing relational databases (Oracle, SQL Server) and NoSQL databases.
* Programming Languages: Proficiency in Python or Java to build, maintain, and scale custom test automation frameworks.
* API Testing: Strong experience with API testing (REST/SOAP) and data contract validation using tools like Postman, RestAssured, or custom scripts.
* CI/CD Integration: Experience integrating automated data test suites into enterprise CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, Tekton, GitLab CI) to enable continuous testing.
* Test Methodologies: Deep understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies, functional, integration, regression, and parallel-run testing for large-scale migrations.

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skillsets**

* Modern Lakehouse & Warehouse Platforms: Familiarity with cloud-native data platforms, such as Databricks or Snowflake (experience with Google BigQuery is also valued).
* Distributed Data Processing Engines: Familiarity with distributed compute engines, specifically Apache Spark (PySpark, Spark SQL) or Apache Flink for large-scale data processing.
* Data Quality Automation: Experience implementing automated data quality frameworks using industry-standard tools such as Great Expectations, dbt test, Soda / SodaCL, or Deequ / PyDeequ.
* AI/ML & NLP Testing: Experience testing LLM-backed applications, validating Natural Language-to-SQL engines (e.g., conversational query interfaces), prompt validation, and autonomous agent testing.

Leadership & Methodology
  
  

* Agile QE Leadership: Strong experience running QA cycles within Scrum/Kanban frameworks, managing sprint closures, and collaborating with cross-functional Dev/Product leads.
* Test Strategy Design: Proven track record of designing multi-layered testing strategies (unit, integration, regression, system, and regression parallel runs for migrations).

**Experience & Qualifications**

* Total Testing Experience: Minimum 10-12 years of relevant experience in software testing, quality engineering, or data engineering.
* Data Automation Experience: Minimum 5-8 years of hands-on experience in automated data testing, ETL testing, or data pipeline quality engineering.
* BI & Analytics Verification: Minimum 5-8 years of experience in report/BI testing, data reconciliation, and source-to-target data validation.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent engineering field.

title: E Trading Quality Assurance Lead - Assistant Vice President
description:
Citi is looking for an experienced e-Trading Technology Quality Assurance (QA) Senior Analyst to play a pivotal role in safeguarding the integrity of electronic trading platforms within a high-velocity, globally connected Capital Markets technology environment. In this role, you will own quality assurance across the full testing lifecycle — from UAT strategy through to production rollout — directly influencing the reliability and regulatory compliance of trading systems used at scale. You will operate as a senior quality leader, mentoring colleagues, shaping testing standards, and coordinating across global technology and business teams to drive consistent, measurable quality outcomes.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end quality assurance across UAT and production rollout cycles for electronic trading platforms, including validation of Futures and Options products, algorithmic Trading and Execution Platform, and electronic order management workflows.
* Design, execute, and maintain automated test suites using Java and Cucumber within a Behavior-Driven Development framework, ensuring test coverage aligns with system and regulatory requirements.
* Define and enforce quality standards and testing procedures across the software development lifecycle, conducting annual reviews and recommending improvements to keep practices current and effective.
* Monitor products and processes for conformance to established standards, identify quality risks, perform root cause analysis, and deliver clearly documented remediation recommendations.
* Validate system behavior against FIX protocol specifications and electronic trading regulatory obligations, ensuring trading platform outputs meet both technical and compliance benchmarks.
* Act as a quality advisor and mentor to junior team members, providing guidance on testing approaches, standards adherence, and professional development within IT Quality.
* Assess quality-related risks in business and technology decisions, escalating control issues transparently and ensuring all corrective actions are assigned, tracked, and resolved to completion.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* 9-13 years experience in an IT Quality or software quality assurance role, with demonstrated ownership across the full testing lifecycle from test strategy through to production validation.
* Must - Hands-on experience testing electronic trading platforms, including a solid working knowledge of Futures and Options products, Capital Markets and Derivatives domains, order types, and electronic trading processes.
* Must - Demonstrated experience testing e-Trading lifecycles and workflows as well experience of trading algorithms such as TWAP, VWAP, Iceberg etc. with the ability to validate algorithmic behavior against defined specifications.
* Proficiency in test automation using Java and Cucumber within a BDD Behavior-Driven Development framework, including the ability to write, modify, and execute complex automated test scripts independently.
* Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, container environments such as ECS, and version control using GitHub, enabling effective integration of quality practices into modern delivery workflows.
* Good understanding of the FIX protocol and regulatory obligations for electronic trading, with the ability to validate system behavior against these standards in a structured and auditable way.
* Strong stakeholder communication and coordination skills, with the ability to align project teams, vendors, and global counterparts on quality outcomes across complex, multi-geography programs.

**Beneficial Skills & Qualifications**

* Project management experience in a fast-paced, time-to-market driven technology environment, with the ability to manage quality workstreams across concurrent deliverables.
* Experience contributing to the development of new testing standards and procedures in collaboration with cross-functional technology teams.
* Familiarity with process audit methodologies and the ability to conduct structured product evaluation and conformance assessments.

**Job Title: MDM Quality Engineer / Test Engineer –**
****Role Overview****
 We're looking for a detail\-oriented Quality Engineer with experience in Master Data Management testing to ensure the reliability, accuracy, and performance of our MDM platform. You'll be responsible for designing and executing comprehensive test strategies across data models, integrations, match \& merge rules, workflows, and data quality processes — ensuring that master data is accurate, consistent, and fit for business use.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
* Design, develop, and execute test strategies and test plans for MDM implementations, including unit, functional, integration, regression, and performance testing.

* Test match \& merge rules, survivorship logic, and deduplication processes to ensure golden record quality meets business expectations.
* Validate integration pipelines (batch and real\-time) between Reltio and source/target systems (ERP, CRM, data lakes, APIs) for data accuracy, completeness, and timeliness.
* Perform data quality testing — profiling, validation, and reconciliation — across source systems and the Reltio MDM hub.
* Test Reltio workflows, business rules, stewardship processes, and exception handling scenarios.
* Develop and maintain automated test scripts for regression and data validation testing using tools such as Python, SQL, or Selenium.
* Perform API testing of Reltio REST APIs using tools like Postman, REST Assured, or similar.
* Conduct performance and load testing on Reltio integrations and platform configurations.
* Log, track, and manage defects through the full lifecycle using JIRA or similar tools, working closely with developers to ensure timely resolution.
* Collaborate with business analysts, data stewards, and developers to understand requirements and define acceptance criteria.
* Validate data migration activities — pre\-migration, mid\-migration, and post\-migration — ensuring data integrity and completeness.
* Participate in UAT (User Acceptance Testing) and support business stakeholders during testing cycles.
* Develop and maintain test documentation including test cases, test scripts, test data, and test summary reports.

* Hands\-on understanding of Reltio MDM concepts — entities, relationships, match \& merge, survivorship, hierarchies, and workflows — sufficient to design meaningful test cases.
* Strong SQL skills for data validation, reconciliation, and querying across relational/cloud databases.
* Experience testing REST APIs using Postman, REST Assured, or similar API testing tools.
* Experience with test management tools (JIRA, TestRail, Zephyr, or similar).
* Familiarity with ETL/integration testing (validating data pipelines, transformation logic, and data flow accuracy).
* Experience with data quality testing concepts — completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and uniqueness.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to define test scenarios from complex business and data requirements.
* Good understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and experience working within sprint\-based delivery teams.


****Preferred Qualifications****
* Experience with test automation frameworks (Selenium, PyTest, or similar) and scripting in Python or Groovy.
* Exposure to performance/load testing tools (JMeter, Gatling, or similar) for MDM and integration pipelines.
* Reltio platform certification or formal training is a plus.
* Experience testing Snowflake, AWS, Azure, or GCP data platforms integrated with Reltio.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, etc.) for automated testing workflows.
* Experience with data migration testing in large\-scale MDM implementation projects.
* Knowledge of data privacy/compliance frameworks (GDPR, HIPAA) and their impact on data quality and testing requirements.
* Experience in industries such as Manufacturing, life sciences, healthcare, retail, or financial services.

description:
**Job Summary** 




 The Quality Analyst \& Trainer is a dual\-role professional responsible for maximizing the performance of the appointment generation team. This role involves monitoring, evaluating, and scoring customer interactions to ensure compliance and quality standards. Simultaneously, you will design, deliver, and refresh training programs that equip agents with the skills needed to overcome objections, build pipelines, and book high\-quality appointments.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Quality Assurance \& Monitoring** 



* Evaluate Interactions: Monitor recorded and live outbound/inbound calls, emails, and chat interactions to evaluate communication skills, script adherence, and lead qualification accuracy.
* Calibrate Standards: Participate in regular calibration sessions with team leaders and management to ensure consistent grading across the department.
* Provide Feedback: Conduct regular, constructive 1\-on\-1 coaching sessions with agents to review performance, highlight strengths, and address areas for improvement.
* Analyze Trends: Identify common performance gaps, compliance risks, or script bottlenecks and report findings to operations management.



  





**Training \& Development** 



* Onboarding Delivery: Lead new\-hire training batches, focusing on product/service knowledge, pitch delivery, objection handling, and CRM navigation.
* Continuous Learning: Create and deliver refresher training modules, workshops, and huddles based on QA data trends and changing campaign requirements.
* Content Creation: Develop and update training materials, including playbooks, call scripts, objection\-handling guides, and multimedia learning tools.
* Performance Tracking: Measure the effectiveness of training interventions by tracking the "nesting" performance and ramp\-up time of new hires.



  





**Required Qualifications \& Skills** 




  





**Experience** 



* Proven Track Record: Minimum 2–3 years of experience as a Quality Analyst, Trainer, or Team Lead specifically in an appointment setting, lead generation, or outbound sales BPO environment.
* Domain Knowledge: Deep understanding of the appointment generation sales funnel, including gatekeeper navigation, cold calling strategies, and qualifying criteria (e.g., BANT).



  





**Core Skills** 



* Communication: Exceptional verbal and written English communication skills with a neutral or highly adaptable accent.
* Coaching \& Facilitation: Strong public speaking and classroom management skills, with the ability to deliver constructive feedback without demoralizing agents.

* Technical Proficiency: Hands\-on experience with QA software, Call Center Dialers (e.g., Five9, Vicidial), CRMs (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot), and Learning Management Systems (LMS).

title: Sr. Engineer Reliability Engineering XI
description:
**Job Summary**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 The Sr. Engineer – Reliability Engineering will be responsible for managing and executing
 **product reliability testing and validation activities within the Reliability Lab** 
 . The role will ensure that products, components, and systems meet defined reliability, durability, performance, and quality requirements through structured testing, data analysis, failure investigation, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 The role will work closely with
 **Product Design, Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, and other cross\-functional teams** 
 to plan and execute reliability tests, identify failure modes, determine root causes, and recommend design or process improvements.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Plan, coordinate, and execute reliability, durability, life\-cycle, and qualification testing in the Reliability Lab.
* Develop test plans, test procedures, test setups, and test schedules based on product and customer requirements.
* Operate and ensure proper utilization of reliability laboratory equipment, test rigs, instrumentation, and data\-acquisition systems.
* Conduct reliability testing under thermal, mechanical, electrical, environmental, and other relevant stress conditions.
* Monitor tests, capture test data, identify abnormalities, and ensure timely escalation of test failures.
* Perform detailed analysis of test failures and support Root Cause Analysis (RCA), FMEA, 8D, and corrective actions.
* Work with Design Engineering to investigate failures and recommend design improvements to enhance product reliability.
* Ensure proper documentation of test results, observations, failures, corrective actions, and final conclusions.
* Prepare test reports, reliability reports, qualification reports, and technical presentations for engineering and leadership teams.
* Support new product development by providing reliability inputs during design verification and validation (DV/PV) activities.
* Support qualification and validation of design changes, components, materials, and suppliers.
* Ensure calibration and preventive maintenance of laboratory equipment and test infrastructure.
* Maintain laboratory standards, safety requirements, testing protocols, and documentation.
* Coordinate with external laboratories and testing agencies whenever specialized testing is required.
* Analyze reliability data and identify trends, recurring failures, and opportunities for improvement.
* Support development and improvement of reliability test methodologies and laboratory capabilities.
* Mentor junior engineers/technicians on reliability testing, instrumentation, data analysis, and troubleshooting.


 Key Technical Skills
   

  

* Strong knowledge of Reliability Engineering and Reliability Testing.
* Hands\-on experience with reliability and environmental testing.
* Knowledge of FMEA, FTA, RCA, 8D, Weibull analysis, life testing, and accelerated life testing.
* Understanding of thermal, mechanical, electrical, and environmental stress testing.
* Experience with data acquisition systems, sensors, instrumentation, and test equipment.
* Ability to troubleshoot test setups and identify test\-system vs. product failures.
* Strong data analysis and interpretation skills.
* Knowledge of relevant industry/testing standards and engineering practices.
* Good understanding of product design and manufacturing processes.
* Strong technical documentation and reporting skills.


 Education \& Experience
   

  

* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, or related Engineering discipline.
* Typically 5–8 years of relevant experience in Reliability Engineering, Product Validation, Testing, or Engineering Laboratory functions.
* Hands\-on experience working in a Reliability/Test/Validation Lab is preferred.
* Experience in HVAC, thermal management, cooling systems, data\-center equipment, power electronics, or similar engineered products will be an advantage.


 Key Competencies
   

  

* Reliability \& Failure Analysis
* Laboratory \& Test Management
* Technical Problem Solving
* Data Analysis
* Root Cause Analysis
* Product Testing \& Validation
* Project Ownership
* Cross\-functional Collaboration
* Attention to Detail
* Technical Documentation
* Decision Making


 Key KPIs
   

  

* On\-time completion of reliability and qualification testing
* Reliability test execution quality and accuracy
* Reduction in repeat/recurring test failures
* Timely identification and closure of reliability issues
* Effectiveness of RCA and corrective actions
* Laboratory equipment availability and utilization
* Compliance with testing, calibration, safety, and documentation requirements

title: Data Quality Officer
description:
**About The Role**
**As a
 **Data Quality Officer for HR \& Reference Data** 
 , you will be the key enabler in maximizing the value and trustworthiness of our most critical enterprise domains: our workforce information and core reference datasets.**
**You will act as a proactive partner, collaborating closely with business and technical teams. A critical part of your role is bridging perspectives—from HR business partners to IT architects—into clear, actionable data analysis.**
**Your mission is to resolve data issues and nurture a proactive prevention mindset across the organization. You will translate HR processes and Reference Data requirements into formal data quality policies, rules, and governance standards. By storylining data health metrics and serving as a data provocateur when needed, you will drive the continuous improvement of our core data foundation.**
****Key Responsibilities****
* Domain\-Specific Insight Generation \& Profiling:
+ Perform deep\-dive root cause analysis on HR datasets (e.g., employee lifecycle, payroll interfaces, org structures) and Reference Data (e.g., enterprise code tables, locations, job classifications, cost centers) to isolate systemic, process, or integration issues.
+ Conduct thorough data profiling on critical master and reference datasets to detect anomalies, cross\-system discrepancies, orphan records, and data drift.
+ Document findings and quantify the business impact of poor data quality on operational HR, compliance, reporting, and downstream integrations.

* Stakeholder Collaboration \& Standard Setting:
+ Work closely with HR Data Stewards, Data Governance, and IT to define, document, and enforce clear data quality rules and reference data standards.
+ Translate HR business rules and Reference Data governance policies into precise technical specifications for automated validation and monitoring tools.
+ Act as the primary liaison between business domain owners and technical teams, ensuring alignment on data lineage and data definitions.

* Monitoring, Reporting \& Governance:
+ Maintain domain\-specific Data Quality Dashboards (e.g., tracking HR data completeness, reference data synchronization) for clear visibility across business units.
+ Track and report HR and Reference Data quality KPIs to leadership, driving transparency and accountability.
+ Support reference data management processes, ensuring code values, mappings, and taxonomies remain synchronized across target applications.

* Remediation \& Prevention:
+ Collaborate with IT and HR Tech teams to define requirements for data cleansing, automated enrichment, and exception management.
+ Support business teams at the point of data entry/creation to improve source data quality and minimize manual workarounds.


****Your Profile****
* Boundary Spanner: Ability to connect HR business processes and enterprise reference data structures with backend technical architectures.
* Influencer \& Storyteller: Skilled at translating complex data anomalies into compelling narratives for HR leadership and business managers.
* Collaborator: A strong team player dedicated to building cross\-functional alignment across HR Operations, Enterprise Data Management/Governance, and IT.
* Mindset: Detail\-oriented, persistent, and proactive about driving data transparency and operational excellence.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Statistics, HR Analytics, or a related field.
* 3\+ years of experience as a Data Quality Officer, Data Governance Analyst, or Data Steward, with direct experience handling HR data, Master Data Management (MDM), or Reference Data domains.
* Essential: Strong proficiency in SQL for complex data querying, profiling, and joining datasets across multi\-table environments.
* Hands\-on experience with modern HR Information Systems (e.g., Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM) and Reference Data concepts (code lists, hierarchies, mapping tables).
* Fluent in English with excellent verbal and written communication skills to interact effectively with global teams.


**Preferred Skills**
* Familiarity with Data Governance frameworks (Metadata Management, Data Lineage, Data Cataloging).
* Experience using scripting languages (e.g., Python) for automated data checks or profiling is a plus.
* Knowledge of global HR data privacy standards (e.g., GDPR, local DPDP regulations).

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.

The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 This role offers the opportunity to work within EY’s Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group, supporting leading global financial institutions in identifying, measuring, and managing risk including trading‑book market risk \& counterparty credit risk, banking‑book credit risk, operational risk, and regulatory requirements. As part of the Quantitative Trading Book (QTB) team within FSRM, you will contribute to strategic and functional transformation across risk, treasury, and front‑to‑back\-office functions. You will apply quantitative skills to enhance risk and valuation processes, support regulatory compliance, and develop analytics that drive better decision‑making for clients with capital‑markets activities. This is an opportunity for quant professionals looking to work on models, regulatory initiatives, and high‑impact capital‑markets engagements across global banks, broker‑dealers, asset managers, and insurance institutions.
   

  

 EY is seeking a highly skilled Generative AI Specialist with expertise in developing / validating AI models. The successful candidate will be instrumental in driving innovation and enhancing our AI capabilities across various domains.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Demonstrate deep technical capabilities and industry knowledge of financial products
* Lead components of large\-scale client engagements and/or smaller client engagements while consistently delivering quality client services
* Understand market trends and demands in the financial services sector and issues faced by clients by staying abreast of current business and industry trends relevant to the client's business
* Manage risk, and effectively communicate with key stakeholders regarding status, issues and key priorities to achieve expected outcomes.
* Responsible for decision\-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* MRM (SR 11\-7 experience) / Model Audit / Model governance along with Gen AI / Traditional AI
* Deep understanding of various neural network architectures, including convolutional neural networks (CNNs), recurrent neural networks (RNNs), transformers, and generative adversarial networks (GANs), along with their applications in supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning.
* Proficiency in the development / validation of state\-of\-the\-art generative AI models, including RAG structures, as well as experience with natural language processing (NLP) and large language models (LLMs), with skills in data preprocessing, model training, hyperparameter tuning, and evaluation metrics specific to generative tasks for creative content generation and data synthesis.
* Utilize leading AI platforms like OpenAI, Azure GPT, Google Gemini, LLaMA, or Mistral, with proficiency in at least one platform.
* Conduct comprehensive testing and evaluation of AI models on tasks such as text summarization, content generation, and other NLP applications.
* Experience in performance testing of AI models, including evaluation for hallucinations, toxicity, bias, robustness, adversarial attacks, and cybersecurity vulnerabilities.
* Knowledge of responsible AI practices, ensuring fairness, transparency, and accountability in AI model development and deployment.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
Senior QA Engineer
 



  





**Team:** 
 Healthcare EHR product engineering ·
 **Work model:** 
 WFO ( 5 days )·
 **Level:** 
 Senior individual contributor ·
 **Focus:** 
 test automation and AI\-augmented quality
 



  





 Role summary
 



  





 A senior QA engineer who builds automated test suites, embeds quality in an AI\-augmented (AI\-PDLC) delivery model, and drives the move from manual to automated testing for a healthcare EHR platform.
 



  





 Key responsibilities
 



  




* Build and maintain automated test suites (for example Playwright) integrated into CI/CD.
* Convert manual regression into reliable automated coverage on the critical paths.
* Embed in a squad: help write and refine acceptance criteria during the working session, and start testing as soon as the first build is ready.
* Use AI to generate tests, then validate that output rigorously — catching false positives and coverage gaps.
* Test AI\-backed product features: design evaluation checks for non\-deterministic behavior, including scenarios exercised from outside the code under test.
* Manage test data, including compliant synthetic data for a regulated (HIPAA) domain.



  





 Required skills and experience
 



  




* 5\+ years in software QA / test automation, with hands\-on framework build and maintenance (not only test execution).
* Proficiency with a modern automation framework (Playwright or equivalent, such as Selenium or Cypress) integrated into CI/CD.
* Programming for test automation in JavaScript/TypeScript or Python.
* Strong test strategy and risk\-based design, with fluency across API, UI, and integration testing.
* Hands\-on AI\-assisted or prompt\-driven test generation, plus the discipline to validate what the AI produces.
* Experience testing AI, machine\-learning, or LLM\-backed features — handling non\-determinism and designing evaluation/oracle checks such as golden sets and groundedness.
* A track record of converting manual regression into reliable automated coverage (shift\-left), working embedded in a cross\-functional team.



  





 Preferred qualifications (nice to have)
 



  




* ISTQB Foundation (CTFL) or AI Testing (CT\-AI) certification.
* Healthcare or other regulated\-domain testing, and synthetic test data (for example Synthea/FHIR).
* Performance testing, contract testing, or self\-healing test tooling.



  





 What a strong candidate looks like
 



  





 Has personally built automation up from a low baseline, can show AI\-assisted tests they wrote and then validated, and has tested at least one AI or machine\-learning feature with an evaluation harness rather than manual spot\-checks.
 



  





 Location and work model
 



  





 Hybrid, working within the product engineering team on its collaboration hours. This role is early in an automation\-first transition, so you will be building coverage from a modest baseline — a chance to set the standard rather than inherit it.
 



  





 Compensation
 



  





 Competitive compensation for a senior QA engineer, benchmarked to the local market. Specific range shared early in the process and in line with applicable pay\-transparency requirements.
 



 Equal opportunity and accommodation
 



 We are an equal\-opportunity employer and evaluate candidates on their ability to perform the essential functions of the role. We provide reasonable accommodation for applicants and employees with disabilities — please let us know if you need one during the process.

title: SAP CML Test Engineer
description:
**Position Overview**
**Job Title: SAP CML Test Engineer**
**Corporate Title:** 
**Assistant Vice President**
**Location: Pune, India**
**Role Description**
* As an SAP CML Test Engineer, you will be a crucial member of our cross\-functional team, ensuring the quality, stability, and performance of our core Lending applications. You will leverage your expertise in both mortgages business processes and SAP CML to design, execute, and document comprehensive testing strategies. You will collaborate closely with Requirements Engineers, Developers and Application Managers in both Pune and Frankfurt to verify and secure the technology solutions that support Deutsche Bank's lending operations.
* The Lending Platforms team is a global unit responsible for the development, enhancement, and maintenance of Deutsche Bank's core lending systems. As a critical function within our Private Bank Technology division, we manage the lifecycle of loan products on the SAP CML (Consumer and Mortgage Loans) platform. Our team is strategically located in Frankfurt and Pune, fostering a collaborative, multinational environment to deliver robust and innovative solutions for our business partners.


**What We’ll Offer You**
 As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy,
   

  

* Best in class leave policy.
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance
* Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above


**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Test Strategy and Planning: Deliver a strong contribution with the test team, which will develop, document, and maintain functional and non\-functional test plans, test cases, and test scripts based on business requirements and technical specifications.
* Test Execution: Execute manual and automated tests for SAP CML and integrated systems, covering all phases of testing including System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and Regression Testing.
* Defect Management: Identify, log, and track defects with precision. Collaborate with development teams to analyze root causes and ensure timely resolution and re\-testing.
* Domain Expertise: Apply your in\-depth knowledge of the mortgages business lifecycle (origination, servicing, closure) to create/manage realistic and effective test scenarios.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Work in close partnership with a multi\-national team of Requirements Engineers, Developers and Application Managers across Pune and Frankfurt to ensure a shared understanding of requirements and quality standards.
* Reporting and Documentation: Contribute to providing clear, concise, and timely reporting on test progress, defect status, and overall quality to project stakeholders. Maintain comprehensive test documentation.
* Process Improvement: Contribute to the continuous improvement of our testing processes, methodologies, and tools.


**Your Skills And Experience**
* SAP CML Expertise: Proven, hands\-on experience in testing SAP Consumer and Mortgage Loans (CML) module. Strong understanding of CML configuration, processes, and integration points.
* Testing Proficiency: Minimum of 2\+ years in a dedicated software testing role with a strong grasp of QA methodologies, tools, and processes (STLC, SDLC).
* Mortgages Domain Knowledge: Solid understanding of the end\-to\-end mortgage lending business process, from application and underwriting to servicing and securitization.
* Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a distributed, multi\-national team environment across different time zones.
* Analytical Mindset: Analytical and problem\-solving skills with meticulous attention to detail.


**Advantageous / Nice to Have**
* Test Management Tools: Familiarity with test management tools, particularly Tricentis Test, for planning and tracking test execution.
* Test Automation Tools: Hands\-on experience with test automation frameworks, especially Tricentis Tosca, for creating and maintaining automated test suites.
* Certifications: ISTQB/ISEB or other relevant software testing certifications.
* Agile Experience: Experience working in an Agile/Scrum development environment.
* Broader SAP Knowledge: Experience with other SAP Banking Services modules (e.g., SAP BP, BCA) or FI/CO is a plus.
* German language skills: would be regarded as a plus point.


**Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.**
**How We’ll Support You**
* Training and development to help you excel in your career.
* Coaching and support from experts in your team.
* A culture of continuous learning to aid progression.
* A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs.


**About Us And Our Teams**
 Please visit our company website for further information:
   

  

**https://www.db.com/company/company.html**
 We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.
   

  

 Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.
   

  

 We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

title: Sr Test Engineer
description:
Join us as a Sr Test Engineer at Barclays where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting\-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.
   

  

 To be successful as a Sr Test Engineer
 **,** 
 you should have experience with:
   

  

  

* Expert in BDD/Gherkin (Cucumber, Selenium) and UI automation frameworks using Java, with ability to design scalable E2E test solutions across MQ, Kafka, and file\-based integration patterns.
* Strong functional testing across ST/SIT/E2E with robust defect management, test strategy design for distributed systems in regulated banking environments, aligned to Agile and STLC best practices, and proficiency in JIRA for test management and defect tracking.
* Deep knowledge of Trade Finance (LC, Bank Guarantees, SWIFT messaging) with proven ability to define quality gates, drive shift\-left practices, and lead testing teams through complex transformation programs.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* Experience with AI/ML tools for test optimization, intelligent test generation, and predictive analytics to improve efficiency and coverage .
* Exposure to testing complex environments combining SaaS platforms and internally built applications with hands\-on experience in Kafka, Spring, OpenShift, Angular, and Corporate Banking systems.
* Expertise in ETL testing capabilities, MongoDB experience, API automation, test environment management, and performance testing using JMeter/LoadRunner.

They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.

* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.

* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Application Development & Support Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
 Position Overview
   

  

 The MDM Developer is a solid, independent contributor who builds and supports MDM platform features end\-to\-end. Owns features from development through production support under the “you build it, you support it” model. Works with moderate guidance from senior team members on complex design decisions but independently delivers sprint commitments and resolves production issues within their domain.
   

  

 Platform Development \& Enhancement
   

  

* Build and configure MDM platform features across assigned domains
* Implement match/merge/survivorship rules based on design specifications
* Build and maintain hierarchy structures and relationship configurations
* Build stewardship workflows and business rules per design specifications
* Implement region\-specific configurations including conditional attributes, validation rules, and approval routing per design specifications
* Build and maintain custom data entry screens and validation rules per design specifications
* Execute data mapping and onboarding for new sources per established patterns
* Execute data migrations and bulk operations per migration plans
* Implement platform enhancements and optimizations
* Participate in design discussions and raise technical concerns


 Platform Modernization
   

  

* Execute modernization tasks per established plans and timelines
* Implement data mapping per specifications during modernization phases
* Perform regression testing and report discrepancies during modernization


 Production Support, Troubleshooting \& Incident Resolution
   

  

* Own production support for features you built — resolve incidents within SLAs
* Resolve data issues within your domain; escalate cross\-system issues with root cause context
* Analyze application and database logs to identify issue root cause
* Identify patterns in recurring issues and propose permanent fixes
* Debug data flows within your domain to identify where failures occur
* Resolve defects in match/merge configuration and data processing logic
* Execute data reconciliation tasks and validate synchronization
* Collaborate with adjacent teams (data lake, ERP) when issues span system boundaries
* Share knowledge on resolved issues through documentation and team sessions


 Testing \& Quality
   

  

* Develop and execute test cases for SIT and UAT
* Perform system integration testing for assigned features
* Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback
* Refactor code to improve readability and performance
* Address technical debt in assigned areas
* Use CI/CD pipelines for deployments and troubleshoot pipeline failures
* Perform post\-production validation for your releases; execute rollback procedures per established plans
* Participate in DR testing and validate recovery procedures


 Security \& Compliance
   

  

* Working knowledge of data security, information security practices, and SOX compliance procedures


**Required Qualifications**
* 6\+ years hands\-on MDM platform experience (e.g., Informatica MDM, Reltio, SAP MDM, Semarchy, Profisee)
* 6\+ years advanced SQL experience — complex queries, joins, subqueries, data analysis (e.g., Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL)
* 4\+ years hands\-on coding — write, debug, and refactor code (e.g., Java, Python, PL/SQL, shell scripting)
* 3\+ years experience with match/merge, survivorship, and stewardship workflows
* 3\+ years experience with data migrations and bulk operations
* 3\+ years experience with data mapping and integration tools (e.g., Informatica PowerCenter, IICS, Talend, MuleSoft)
* 3\+ years experience using CI/CD pipelines and troubleshooting failures (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps)
* 2\+ years experience with log analysis and monitoring tools (e.g., Splunk, ELK Stack, Datadog, CloudWatch)
* 2\+ years experience with incident management using ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira)
* Experience working across at least 2 MDM domains
* Strong knowledge of SDLC: requirements, development, testing (unit, SIT, UAT), CI/CD, change management, release management


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Multi\-domain MDM experience
* Manufacturing industry experience
* Informatica MDM or Reltio platform experience
* Familiarity with event\-driven architecture and APIs
* Awareness of AI/ML applications in MDM
* Familiarity with graph database concepts
* Familiarity with workflow orchestration
* Experience working with adjacent data teams
* Agile/Scrum delivery experience

title: QA Engineer, Trading Systems
description:
QA Engineer, Trading Systems
 



  





**Location** 
 : Pune 
 



**Experience** 
 : 1 \- 3 years
 



**Engagement** 
 : Full\-time, in\-house
 



**Reports To** 
 : Head of Algo Trading / Founder
 



  





**About AJ Algo** 




  






 AJ Algo
 
 runs a portfolio of automated trading bots across Forex (MT4/MT5\), crypto exchanges, and equity/F\&O broker APIs. We build and operate systems that don't just generate trading signals, they execute them reliably, enforce risk discipline in code, and stay resilient around the clock. We're a small, hands\-on team where engineering rigor and calibrated scepticism matter as much as trading performance.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 You will own quality across our trading infrastructure, where bugs don't just break a feature, they can cost real money. Your job is to make sure every order, every risk check, and every model deployment has been genuinely tried to break before it touches a live account.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




 Test the full order lifecycle: signal generation, risk checks, order routing, fill confirmation, and position tracking
 



 Validate risk management logic: position sizing, daily loss limits, drawdown stops, and margin safeguards, including edge cases like non\-USD\-quoted symbols and correlated exposure
 



 Test failure scenarios explicitly: rejected orders, partial fills, requotes, slippage, disconnects, and stale prices
 



 Verify reconciliation logic between bot\-held positions and broker/exchange records
 



 Test across multiple venues (MT4/MT5, crypto exchange APIs, equity/F\&O broker APIs) and catch behaviour that doesn't generalise across them
 



 Build and maintain automated test suites for money\-touching code, including unit tests for risk calculations
 



 Test monitoring and alerting: confirm the right severity triggers the right alert, and that silent failures don't slip through
 



 Validate ML model deployments: check that walk\-forward or purged cross\-validation was used correctly, and that shadow to small\-allocation to full\-allocation rollouts are gated properly
 



 Test server and terminal recovery scenarios: restarts, reconnections, and failover, confirming positions are reconciled before new trading resumes
 



 Log clear, reproducible bugs with steps, expected versus actual, and evidence
 



 Own the release checklist and sign off before anything ships to a live trading account
 



  





**Must\-Haves** 




 Manual testing fundamentals: test cases, regression suites, bug reporting
 



 Hands\-on automation experience (Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or Python\-based test frameworks like pytest)
 



 API testing and comfort reading JSON responses; experience with Postman or similar
 



 Basic SQL for verifying trade and position data
 



 Comfort with financial/numerical edge cases: rounding, lot sizing, tick values, and precision errors
 



 Ability to work directly with developers rather than throwing bugs over a wall
 



 A conservative, sceptical mindset: comfortable blocking a release when something is ambiguous rather than assuming it's fine

title: Software Test Lead Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**
 Quality
   

  

* Own end\-to\-end quality for software applications.
* Drive test planning, estimation, risk identification, and release readiness.
* Define and execute test strategy across releases, covering functional, integration, system, performance, and automated testing.
* Establish scalable test frameworks, tools, and best practices.
* Ensure clear traceability between requirements, risks, test cases, and results.
* Use of risk\-based testing to focus effort on high\-impact areas.
* Make quality\-based recommendations for releases.
* Ownership of defect triage, prioritization, and root cause analysis.


 Test Architecture \& Automation
   

  

* Define the overall test strategy and automation approach for projects based on product architecture, risks, and release goals.
* Expand automation coverage and improve efficiency of validation processes.
* Integrate testing into CI/CD pipelines and development workflows where applicable.
* Review test plans, test cases, and automation code for completeness and effectiveness.
* Mentor and coach junior test engineers on test design, automation, and quality thinking.
* Identify gaps in test processes and lead improvements.


 Cross\-Functional \& Stakeholder Collaboration
   

  

* Work closely with development leads, product owners, cybersecurity teams, and global stakeholders.
* Participate in architecture and design reviews from a quality and risk perspective.
* Communicate project status, quality metrics, and improvement initiatives to leadership.


**Who You Are:**
 You balance planning with actions. You stay aligned with your goals and stay productive. You take time to ask questions and define the problem and make learning a priority and a goal. You try different solutions for problems and learn from the results. You make new connections and build relationships in other areas and teams but can be an independent self\-starter as needed. You are comfortable reaching out to experts on topics you may not fully understand yet.
   

  

**For This Role, You Will Need:**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer engineering or computer science
* Overall, 8 to 10 years of experience in software testing


**Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:**
 Strong background in software testing and quality engineering for product development.
   

  

* Solid understanding of software testing principles and test design techniques for both functional and non‑functional testing.
* Experience leading testing planning or managing test activities.
* Ability to plan, prioritize, and deliver work effectively under deadlines.
* Experience working with windows and web applications including knowledge of .NET, React, Angular, JavaScript and other windows and web application technologies
* Strong experience with programming and scripting languages (E.g. Python, Java, C\#, JavaScript)
* Hands‑on experience in developing and maintaining automation frameworks.
* Experience with API testing and performance testing tools (E.g. Postman, JMeter).
* Familiarity with test management tools (e.g., Azure DevOps).
* Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
* Experience with Agile/Scrum environments.
* Hands\-on exposure to CI/CD and DevOps practices.
* Experience with Stage\-gated NPD (New Product Development) processes
* Exposure to cybersecurity practices.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders, and technical risks effectively.
* Strong communication, coaching, and problem\-solving skills.


**Our Culture \& Commitment to You:**
 At Emerson, we are committed to fostering a culture where every employee is valued and respected for their unique experiences and perspectives. We believe a diverse and inclusive work environment contributes to the rich exchange of ideas and diversity of thoughts, that inspires innovation and brings the best solutions to our customers. This philosophy is fundamental to living our company’s values and our responsibility to leave the world in a better place. Learn more about our Culture \& Values and about Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion at Emerson.
